jobs.title: Operations & Strategy Internship (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

We are looking for an Operations & Strategy Intern on a rolling basis, with a minimum commitment of six months. Are you a motivated student nearing the end of your studies or a recent graduate with a structured mindset, a proactive attitude, or a passion for detail? Do you want to experience how the private markets actually work and help shape how they operate at scale? Then this is your chance to join one of Berlin’s hottest startups in the FinTech space. 

Your Mission

As an Operations & Strategy Intern, you’ll become part of our core Ops team - solving real problems across private market investing. You’ll take ownership in one of four focus areas depending on your strengths and interests, and support process execution, improvement, and scale. While track placement will reflect business needs, you’ll remain part of the broader Ops team with opportunities to explore other areas during your time with us. This is your opportunity to learn fast, work hard, and make your mark.

Focus Areas

Investor Due Diligence
Help us maintain trust with our clients by supporting robust investor onboarding and compliance processes. You’ll work within clearly structured workflows (like KYC/AML checks), flag inconsistencies, and keep our controls running smoothly. Ideal for detail-oriented individuals with a calm, structured working style - and the ability to speak up when it matters.

➡️ Previous experience in banking, law, or regulatory settings is a plus.

Where this can take you: Careers in compliance, risk operations or legal/finance operations.

Fund Administration
Support our fund onboarding process by coordinating investor support, client onboarding, document preparation, and troubleshooting operational issues as funds transition onto our platform. You’ll liaise with internal and external stakeholders, map fund structures, and help ensure a smooth and scalable onboarding experience. . This focus is ideal for structured, proactive problem-solvers who enjoy bringing clarity to complexity and improving systems sustainably.

➡️ A background in VC, high-growth startups or consulting is a plus.

Where this can take you: Careers in fund administration or client and investor operations.

Venture Operations
Get a front-row seat to how unregulated investment vehicles are executed on our platform. You’ll manage investor onboarding, investment documentation, capital calls, and more - helping us scale deal execution with quality and speed across jurisdictions, focusing on process efficiency and end-to-end automation across jurisdictions. This is for you if you’re a fast learner, clear communicator, and want to work at the intersection of product and operations.

➡️ A background in VC, high-growth startups or consulting is a plus.

Where this can take you: Careers in venture capital operations, business development or project management.

Fund Accounting
Take ownership of investor reporting cycles, a regulatory requirement for funds in each of our jurisdictions. You’ll work with large datasets, external accountants and our product team to help ensure that investors receive accurate, timely, and clear reports. Perfect for structured and detail-driven minds who can turn complex data into meaningful, compliant communications.

➡️ Strong Excel skills and a background in finance or or accounting are a plus.

Where this can take you: Careers in fund accounting, financial reporting or finance operations.

What You Bring

  • Previous experience in a fast-paced environment (VC, consulting, investment banking, business law, etc.) or an operations-related role, ideally in a fast-paced setting

  • You are a recent graduate or nearing the end of your studies

  • Reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership

  • Curious and proactive mindset - you like to ask “why” instead of just accepting things

  • Understanding of basic private market fundamentals and an interest to dive deep into private asset investing

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Familiarity with automation and project management tools like Notion, Make, Asana or Retool is a plus

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Make your mark in a mission-driven FinTech startup that values each of its bunchies

  • Be mentored by experienced operators and founders, that take your development seriously

  • Work from an amazing office right in Berlin-Mitte and be part of a welcoming and motivated team

  • Learn fast in a culture that values ownership, creativity, and trust and always strives to empower others

  • Additionally enjoy benefits in mobility, food and learning

  • Take part in a network of people passionate about investment and work closely with the most interesting players in the private market.

  • Benefit from working with a diverse mix of talents, unrivalled energy, and team spirit within a culture of drive and ownership

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid office setup (3 days/week in office)

About bunch

bunch is building the operating infrastructure for the next generation of private markets. We combine AI-powered automation with deep regulatory expertise to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual processes with one integrated platform across the fund lifecycle, purpose-built for private markets heading toward $32 trillion in Assets Under Management.

We've 4x our ARR in 2025, crossed 150 fund managers and 12,000 LPs on the platform, and just closed our $35M Series B in May 2026. We're looking for ambitious people who want real ownership of hard problems, and who care about building infrastructure that actually matters to the people using it.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager: Agentic Integrations
jobs.description:
About Us

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first ecommerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

About the Role

As an Engineering Manager on the Agentic Integrations team, you’ll lead engineers building and scaling integrations for Constructor’s agentic products across our customer base. This team sits within the ML Journey chapter and operates at the intersection of customer needs, applied ML, product engineering, and production integration work.

Your team will work directly with customers and internal teams to bring agentic capabilities into real-world retail workflows, helping customers adopt, configure, extend, and scale these products in their environments. The work spans two fronts: delivering high-quality customer integrations for agentic products, and turning repeated implementation patterns into reusable tooling, frameworks, documentation, and platform capabilities that make future integrations faster and more reliable.

You’ll be responsible for setting the technical and operational direction for the team: how we engage customers, how we make integration work scalable, how we maintain quality across a growing number of deployments, and how we turn customer-specific learnings into product and platform improvements. Success in this role requires strong engineering leadership, customer empathy, excellent prioritization, and the ability to work effectively across Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and core Engineering teams.

Challenges you will tackle

  • Scaling agentic integrations: Be a part of building a new team that can take agentic capabilities from promising product functionality to reliable, production-grade customer deployments across many different customer environments.

  • Balancing customer delivery and scalable foundations: Allocate the team’s capacity across hands-on customer integration work and longer-term investments in reusable tooling, templates, documentation, automation, and platform improvements.

  • Cross-functional collaboration and prioritization: Work closely with Product, ML, Customer Success, Solutions, and other Engineering teams to prioritize customer needs, unblock adoption, and ensure integration learnings feed back into the product roadmap.

  • Technical direction and quality: Set a high bar for architecture, testing, observability, reliability, and maintainability in customer-facing integrations, especially where agentic systems interact with customer data, workflows, and business-critical experiences.

  • Operational excellence in customer work: Create lightweight but disciplined processes for scoping integrations, managing commitments, handling escalations, tracking risks, and ensuring customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

  • Developer and implementation experience: Improve the internal and external developer experience for agentic integrations by driving clear documentation, reference implementations, reusable components, integration playbooks, and debugging tools.

  • Recruiting and hiring: Own the hiring process for your team end to end, from defining the right profile for forward-deployed engineers to building a strong pipeline, running effective interview loops, and closing candidates.

  • Career growth: Coach and develop engineers who need to be strong both technically and in customer-facing contexts, giving direct feedback, creating growth opportunities, and helping them navigate ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years directly leading an engineering team.

  • Strong technical background in backend, full-stack, platform, or applied ML product engineering.

  • Experience leading teams that build customer-facing, production-grade systems or integrations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to triage ambiguous customer issues and translate them into clear technical plans.

  • Comfort working directly with customers, including technical discovery, scoping, expectation-setting, troubleshooting, and communicating tradeoffs.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, ML/Data Science, Customer Success, Solutions, and Engineering stakeholders.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Good product judgment and customer empathy, with a bias toward solving real customer problems while preserving long-term technical leverage.

  • Experience with LLMs, agentic systems, ML-powered products, recommendations, search, personalization, or data-heavy SaaS products is a strong plus.

  • Experience building reusable tooling, frameworks, SDKs, integration templates, or internal platforms is a plus.

  • English on B2 level (CEFR) or higher.

  • Able to attend regular meetings between 1300 and 1700 UTC.

  • Passion to help fuel the continued success of our high-growth startup.

Benefits

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all employees to take at least 3 weeks per year

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend - we want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget - refreshed each year for every employee

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

  • 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • 💵 Base salary: $80k–$110k USD, depending on knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results

  • 📈 Stock options - offered in addition to the base salary

  • 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

Studies have shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply for jobs unless they meet every one of the qualifications listed. Our primary interest is in finding the best candidate for the job. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of our listed qualifications.

Your responsibilities

We're looking for Plato's first GTM Engineer: the person who brings RevOps to Plato as a discipline and builds our revenue engine as a product, not a ticket queue. Pipeline, conversion, and revenue per headcount are your metrics.
You're inheriting real infrastructure - HubSpot as our source of truth, a custom-built deal-scoring app, call intelligence via Grain, and company-wide AI access - but the layers underneath are still unbuilt: clean data, automated process, real forecasting rigor, AI-driven workflows. That's the job.
This is a team-of-one role that's essentially a sandbox: a direct line to the founders, a mandate to change how we work, and no playbook telling you what to build first. If you want to build the infrastructure behind a revenue engine from the ground up and see your own builds move real numbers, let's talk.
What you'll actually do:

  • Get the data foundation trustworthy: CRM hygiene, field governance, deduping, enrichment on create
  • Automate the revenue process: lead routing, SLAs, stage criteria, clean handoffs across teams
  • Build the pipeline generation stack: signal-based outbound (ICP scoring, enrichment waterfalls, orchestration) so effort goes into conversations, not list-building
  • Bring AI into daily workflows: call-intelligence automation, research agents, health/churn scoring
  • Get forecasting and reporting to a place leadership can steer from weekly
  • Make sure what you ship gets used: instrument adoption, train the team, iterate


Your qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Hands-on experience architecting a CRM like HubSpot from the ground up - how objects, properties, and data structure are set up - not just administering one that's already built
  • Practical, production experience with outbound/enrichment tooling (e.g. Clay or similar)
  • You've built with AI/LLMs - prompt design, agents, or AI-powered workflows - in real production work
  • Strong data rigor: you can read a funnel, spot where the data is dirty, and quantify the impact of a fix before you build it
  • You think in systems and sequencing, not tickets - and can defend your reasoning under real pushback

Nice-to-haves:
  • Experience as an early GTM-Ops/RevOps hire at another startup
  • Familiarity with our stack or similar: Grain, Sales Navigator-style outbound tooling
  • Comfort with unit economics (CAC, ACV, payback)
  • Experience with mid-market, multi-stakeholder B2B deal cycles


Why us?

You'd be Plato's first-ever GTM Engineer - not inheriting someone else's system, but building the one that doesn't exist yet, and introducing RevOps as a discipline at a company that's never had one. A direct line to the founders, real budget for tooling, and a mandate to change how the revenue team works, from day one. 
This is an individual contributor role today - you'll be doing the building yourself, not managing a team. If this function grows as Plato scales, you'd be the one shaping what it becomes, not stepping into a structure someone else already defined.
Because the function touches everything - data, process, automation, AI - you won't be boxed into one lane. If you want to see your own build move a real number within your first 90 days, this is that role.

Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr.

Bist du dabei?


Deine Rolle

  • Strategisch und themensicher: Du entwickelst individuelle PR Strategien für Kunden aus dem B2B- und B2C-Bereich – mit klarem Fokus auf Themenplatzierung in relevanten Medien. Dabei bringst du journalistisches Denken und strategische Kommunikation zusammen.
  • Beratend auf Augenhöhe: Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit deinen Kund*innen professionell, planst vorausschauend (z. B. mit Quartalsplänen & KPIs) und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du bringst proaktiv Themen ein – und entwickelst die Kommunikation deiner Kund*innen kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Sparringspartner*in auf C-Level-Augenhöhe, nicht Auftragsempfänger*in.
  • Teamorientiert & offen: Du teilst dein Wissen, gibst und nimmst Peer-to-Peer-Feedback über alle Erfahrungslevel hinweg, ohne Gatekeeping, mit echtem Interesse an gemeinsamer Weiterentwicklung.
  • Vorne auf der AI Welle: Du arbeitest aktiv mit unserem internen AI-Stack. Recherche, Pitch-Vorbereitung, Themen-Scouting – wo Maschinen schneller sind, lassen wir sie machen. Du investierst die gewonnene Zeit in Substanz, Beziehungen und Kreativität.
  • Aktives Netzwerken: Du baust und pflegst belastbare Beziehungen zu Journalist*innen aus den wichtigsten Medien im DACH Raum und Europas.


Wer du bist

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast Kund*innen nachweislich eigenständig in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert.

  • Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.


Dein Profil

  • Excellent language skills in English and German (both written and spoken)


Benefits

  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Senior Finance Coordinator & PMO Manager 
(Finance Office Manager) 
About the role 
We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and commercially minded Senior Finance Coordinator & PMO Manager to support and coordinate a broad Finance function of more than 50 colleagues across Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, Credit Control and related areas. 
This is not a pure administrative role. You will act as the operational backbone of the Finance organisation: ensuring that priorities are clear, deadlines are tracked, meetings result in action, cross-functional projects move forward and the CFO office runs effectively. 
You will work closely with the CFO and senior Finance leaders, combining project management, stakeholder coordination, governance support and hands-on operational follow-up.


Key responsibilities

Finance leadership coordination

  • Support the CFO and Finance leadership team in organising priorities, meetings, decision-making and follow-up.
  • Prepare leadership meetings, agendas, briefing materials and action trackers.
  • Ensure decisions, open points, deadlines and ownership are clearly documented and followed through.
  • Coordinate communication across Accounting, Tax, FP&A, Treasury, Credit Control and other Finance teams.
  • Act as a central point of contact for internal stakeholders on Finance-related coordination topics.

Project and transformation management

  • CoordinateFinanceprojects,includingprocessimprovements,systemsimplementations,reportingenhancements, organisationalchangesandtransformationinitiatives.
  • Maintain project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, decision logs and status reporting.
  • Challenge delays or unclear ownership constructively and escalate where appropriate.
  • Support project teams in structuring workstreams, preparing workshops and ensuring delivery against agreed milestones.
  • Help turn broad strategic initiatives into clear workplans and practical next steps.

Governance, planning and reporting support

  • Coordinate key Finance calendar activities, including budgeting, forecasting, monthly reporting, audit preparation and year-end processes.
  • Support the preparation and coordination of management presentations, board materials and internal reporting packs.
  • Maintain a clear overview of recurring deadlines, governance requirements and deliverables across the Finance function.
  • Support documentation of Finance processes, policies, responsibilities and decision rights.
  • Assist with the preparation of presentations, summaries and high-quality communication for senior stakeholders.

Operational effectiveness

  • Identify recurring inefficiencies, unclear interfaces or bottlenecks across the Finance organisation.
  • Propose and implement practical improvements to ways of working, communication flows, meeting structures and reporting routines.
  • Establish simple, reliable tools for tracking priorities, projects and commitments.
  • Help create a structured, collaborative and accountable Finance culture.
  • Support onboarding, team events and internal communications where relevant to the Finance organisation.


Dein Profil

  • Several years of experience in a Finance PMO, Finance Business Management, Chief of Staff, consulting, audit, controlling or comparable coordination role.
  • Strong understanding of Finance functions and core processes, ideally including accounting, forecasting, budgeting, audit or reporting cycles.
  • Proven experience managing complex cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with a strong ability to create structure in fast-moving or ambiguous environments.
  • Confident working with senior leaders and able to communicate clearly, diplomatically and assertively.
  • Highly reliable, discreet and comfortable handling sensitive information.
  • Strong PowerPoint, Excel and Microsoft 365 skills; experience with project-management or collaboration tools is an advantage.
  • Fluent English required; German is highly desirable.

What success looks like

Within the first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Created a transparent Finance leadership and project calendar.
  • Established clear action tracking and follow-up routines across the Finance leadership team.
  • Improved visibility over key Finance projects, risks, dependencies and deadlines.
  • Reduced unnecessary coordination burden on Finance leaders and the CFO.
  • Helped improve collaboration and execution across the wider Finance organisation.
  • Become a trusted point of contact for turning plans and decisions into delivered outcomes.

Personal qualities

You are structured without being rigid, diplomatic without avoiding difficult conversations, and hands-on without losing the bigger picture. You enjoy bringing order to complexity, working with different personalities and ensuring that important work does not get lost between teams.


Warum wir?

What we offer:

  • 30 days of vacation /5 working days per week

  • Various online language courses and opportunities to participate in online collaboration courses
  • Numerous campus events from the fields of art, culture, business and science

jobs.title: Magazijn / Receptie
jobs.description:
Als Magazijnier / Receptionist(e) ben je een belangrijke schakel binnen de organisatie. Je combineert logistieke taken in het magazijn met een professionele ontvangst van bezoekers, klanten en leveranciers.

Ben je magazijnier en een administratieve ervaring achter de rug, onze klant is op zoek naar jou!



Magazijn

Ontvangen en controleren van inkomende goederen.
Klaarzetten en verwerken van uitgaande bestellingen.
Beheer van de voorraad en magazijnorganisatie.
Laden en lossen van goederen.
Zorgen voor orde, netheid en veiligheid in het magazijn.


Receptie & Administratie

Ontvangen van bezoekers, chauffeurs en leveranciers.
Beantwoorden van telefoons en doorverbinden naar de juiste contactpersoon.
Verwerken van transport- en leveringsdocumenten.
Ondersteunen van administratieve taken.
Fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt van het bedrijf.

Je bent klantvriendelijk, communicatief en behulpzaam.

Je werkt nauwkeurig en georganiseerd.

Je houdt van een gevarieerd takenpakket.

Je bent hands-on en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

Je kan zelfstandig werken, maar bent ook een teamspeler.

Je hebt ervaring opgedaan binnen een logistieke omgeving, magazijn en ervaring met administratieve taken. 

Een heftruckattest is een troef, maar geen must.

Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands.

jobs.title: Operator
jobs.description:
Dit internationaal gekend bedrijf staat in voor het ontwerp en de productie van prototypes en elektronische onderdelen voor applicaties in diverse sectoren.


Jobomschrijving

Als operator m/v/x op de chemische afdeling is het jouw taak om de galvanische lijnen te bedienen en de parameters in te stellen op de computergestuurde machines. Je zorgt ervoor dat de machines de juiste hoeveelheid chemicaliën toevoegen aan de baden en dat ze de juiste temperaturen en tijden aanhouden om het gewenste resultaat te bereiken.

Daarnaast is het ook jouw verantwoordelijkheid om stalen te nemen van de chemische baden en deze te analyseren.

Dit is belangrijk om de kwaliteit van het eindproduct te garanderen en ervoor te zorgen dat de producten voldoen aan de vereiste specificaties en kwaliteitsnormen.

Om deze taken goed uit te voeren, is het belangrijk dat je nauwkeurig en zorgvuldig werkt, en dat je in staat bent om problemen snel te herkennen en op te lossen. Je moet ook goed kunnen samenwerken met andere teamleden, en bereid zijn om je kennis en vaardigheden voortdurend bij te werken en te verbeteren om aan de veranderende behoeften van het bedrijf te kunnen voldoen.

  • Je hebt een technische opleiding gevolgd.
  • Je kan vlot met de PC werken.
  • Fysiek zwaar werk schrikt jou niet af.
  • Je bent op zoek naar een functie in 2 ploegen.
  • Ervaring met chemie is een pluspunt.
  • Je kan je werk goed organiseren.

jobs.title: Monteur Metaalconstructie - Gentse Zeehaven
jobs.description:
Vander Plaetsen Construct is een sterk groeiend metaalconstructiebedrijf uit Assenede, actief in industriële montage en constructiewerken. Als monteur metaalconstructie speel je een sleutelrol in het realiseren van technische installaties en constructies op onze werd bij Arcelor Mittal in Gent-Zeehaven. Je werkt mee aan uiteenlopende projecten waarin je zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband aan de slag gaat. Je krijgt te maken met zowel kleinere herstellingen als grotere industriële constructies, waarbij kwaliteit, veiligheid en precisie centraal staan.

Jouw takenpakket

  • Lassen met elektrode – bij voorkeur op hoog niveau
  • Monteren van metaalconstucten volgens technische plannen
  • Werken met slijp- en boormachines
  • Knippen, zagen en plooien van planten
  • Zelfstandig interpreteren en uitvoeren van technische tekeningen

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je hebt minstens 2 jaar relevante ervaring als monteur/lasser
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van elektrode lassen
  • Je kan goed overweg met slijp-en boormachines
  • Je bent vaardig in het lezen van plannen en technische tekeningen
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van het Nederlands
  • Je beschikt over een rijbewijs B

jobs.description:
Functie

Voor een bouwbedrijf regio Leuven, zijn wij op zoek naar een gemotiveerde grondwerker/ handarbeider.

 Als grondwerker / handarbeider zal je worden ingezet bij onderstaande werkzaamheden:

  • Assisteren van de machinist bij het openbreken van verharding, controleren op aanwezigheid van kabels en leidingen in de grond, samenwerken met de machinist die bijvoorbeeld verhardingen kapotschiet en hierbij instructies geven om schade te voorkomen

Profiel

Persoonlijkheidsvereisten

jobs.title: Productie operator
jobs.description:
Nauwkeurige productie, duidelijke processen en zicht op resultaat? Deze rol laat je meebouwen aan producten die kloppen.

In deze functie werk je mee aan een vlot productieproces bij een van onze klanten. Je focust op kwaliteit, veiligheid en tempo. Je bedient machines, volgt aantallen op en zorgt ervoor dat elk product correct verpakt en gelabeld vertrekt. Je krijgt duidelijke instructies, werkt met vaste processen en ziet meteen het effect van je werk op de lijn.

- Je haalt afgewerkte producten en onderdelen uit de lijn en controleert de staat
- Je pakt in, labelt correct en bereidt orders verzendklaar
- Je telt aantallen en registreert alles nauwkeurig in de voorziene lijsten of systemen
- Je houdt je werkplek veilig en ordelijk en meldt onveilige situaties meteen
- Je stelt de zaagmachine in volgens opdracht en bedient ze zelfstandig
- Je volgt de zaagmachine tijdens het proces op en bewaakt de kwaliteit
- Je grijpt doordacht in bij storingen en koppelt terug aan de verantwoordelijke
- Je bedient de plooibank volgens de werkinstructies en maatvoorschriften

Je werkt in een productieomgeving met duidelijke procedures en praktische begeleiding op de werkvloer. Je leert de machines stap voor stap kennen en kan rekenen op heldere afspraken rond kwaliteit en veiligheid. Onze klant zet in op proper materiaal, duidelijke werkinstructies en een werkritme dat haalbaar blijft, ook wanneer het tempo stijgt. Je start via interim met zicht op vaste indienstname bij goede evaluatie. Reden van de vacature: [Provide:{MOTIEF}]. Werkregime: Dagploeg.

Kan je niet wachten om hier te starten? Solliciteer vandaag — we leren je graag kennen!

jobs.title: PLC programmeur - mooi loon + bedrijfswagen
jobs.description:

  • Je programmeert en configureert aandrijvingen, safety en automatisatie
  • Je analyseert en verbetert bestaande softwarestructuren

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Our mission is to radically accelerate the pace of software development by empowering every engineer to ship at the speed their agents write code. We’re building the last piece of the puzzle to enable this - the part that makes it actually safe to ship.

AI is enabling engineers to write code faster than ever before. But software review and testing hasn’t caught up. Engineering leaders are drowning in long software review cycles and more bugs than ever. The bottleneck isn’t writing code anymore, it’s everything that comes after it.

We spent 3 years building patented foundational technology to solve this. Our CTO, Quentin, spent over a decade at Palantir, where he led the 0 to 1 of core products that insiders credit as the primary value drivers behind Gotham and Foundry. Since then, we’ve grown 5x year-on-year and now work with top engineering orgs - Notion, ElevenLabs, Mercor, Dropbox, Discord, LaunchDarkly, Wiz, CoreWeave, Wealthsimple, and more.

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time. We’ve raised $20m from Chemistry, Menlo and Coatue, the same investors behind Twilio, Twitch, Intercom and PagerDuty and are backed by angels including the founders of Vercel, Datadog, Segment, Dropbox, the CTO of GitHub, CPO of Adobe, head of engineering at Cursor and many more.

This is an opportunity to join a company going through hypergrowth as we scale from millions of annual recurring revenue to $100m ARR.

If this excites you, come help us build it!

What is the opportunity?

Join us as a Founding AE hire in London and own the full sales motion end-to-end, from first discovery to strategising pilot deployment to closing the deal.

Most AEs work a narrow slice of the stack, repeating the same sales scripts and motion deal after deal and handing off to a sales engineer the moment a conversation turns technical. Here, you’ll own the sales cycle from discovery to pilot, then stay on as deployment lead to make sure it actually succeeds. You’ll own technical conversations, building real technical authority with engineering leaders and understand exactly what their software development workflow looks like, why they buy and what they’d like to see different about the product.

This is an IC role, there is no team beneath you and no one to delegate work to.

Examples of what you will work on

  • Own end-to-end cycles: You’ll build and manage your own sales pipeline, win pilots and close deals, growing to lead a geography or sector or team as we scale

  • Lead enterprise sales: Navigate complex sales cycles with the world’s leading mid-market and enterprise tech businesses (up to $XXX BN market cap), initially securing low-six then mid-six figure deals

  • Strategise complex deployments: Work alongside our engineers on pilots to figure out how to make them successful, run training sessions and build strong relationships at the user level

  • Help steer our roadmap: You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining and pitching the product and can take specific customer feedback back to our product teams

  • Events: You’ll network with CTOs & engineering leaders, attend our dinners and conferences across the US, and become well-known in this space

You will love this role if

  • ⭐ You learn fast and want to dive deep into the product - you have strong analytical thinking and can work from first principles; ambiguity / lack of experience in a technical domain doesn’t faze you / you are excited to learn!

  • ⭐ You are highly agentic - you have a bias to action, move fast, take ownership without being asked (e.g. if you need sales collateral you build it yourself!)

  • ⭐ You’re a hunter - chasing down revenue feels energizing, not exhausting or stressful, you create your own pipeline if there isn’t one!

  • ⭐ You want to work with engineers - you will spend most of your time externally and internally with developers, and this excites you!

This role is not for you if

  • You expect to work regular working hours and to travel infrequently; our teams, customers, investors span SF, London, NY

  • You need a team of BDRs, RevOps and Marketing to support you across the sales motion

  • You expect to lean entirely on engineers for technical demos and discovery calls

  • You expect never to have to build your own pipeline

Requirements

  • STEM degree

  • 3-7 years of work experience outperforming in a B2B SaaS sales, strategic deployment or adjacent role

  • Experience with outbound-led sales

  • Bonus if you have experience selling a deeply technical product to senior engineering leaders or have been an early GTM hire (< #20) at a fast growing startup

  • If you were previously or are currently a software engineer with strong commercial acumen looking to pivot into tech sales, we’d strongly encourage you to apply!

You may look like this

  • Ex-STEM: You were always on the STEM track but realised being around people is what drives you! You are currently an AE but want to go back to doing something that is a bit more technical.

  • Builder: You are an AE but were previously a founder, have been part of an incubator (YC, EF, Antler) or want to be a future founder. You spike at commercial work but want to build knowledge outside of that to be a more well rounded leader in the future.

  • Early-stage operator: You have been or want to be an early founding hire to help shape what sales looks like and work to build up the processes, materials and strategy that will help us win!

  • AI lover: You work in b2b sales but feel like AI is developing so quickly you’re being left behind and want to build out a more technical skillset

Perks ♥️

  • Competitive comp + significant equity

  • 🍲 Unlimited food & drinks in office - including daily lunch as a team, and your own Amazon business account to buy whatever snacks you want for the office.

  • 💻 A setup you’ll love - everyone has a standing desk, brand new Macbook, your choice of ergonomic peripherals, and a £2k WFH budget to make home just as good

  • 🏄‍♀️ £300 monthly wellness stipend - Third Space gym, reformer pilates, cold plunge, however you want to keep your best

  • 🎁 We celebrate you - £400 in gifts on your birthday and work anniversary every year

  • 🌴 Team offsites - we work and play hard, we’ve done offsites in Italy, Abu Dhabi and local 5-star resorts

  • 📚 Unlimited book budget - we have a growing in-office library and actively encourage everyone to add to it, whether you want to ramp up your knowledge of software testing, or become a better startup operator!

  • 📌 In-person, 4 days a week - at our office in Shoreditch

  • many more!

People behind Meticulous

Guillermo Rauch (founder of Vercel), Jason Warner (CTO of GitHub), Calvin French-Owen (founder of Segment), Jared Friedman (YC partner and founder of Scribd), Scott Belsky (CPO of Adobe), Arash Ferdowsi (founder of Dropbox) and many others are all personal investors in Meticulous.

Compensation: £100K – £200K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As a Technical Account Manager at Happl, you’ll be the person customers trust to turn their ambitions into reality. You’ll own the technical implementation of Happl across a portfolio of accounts, designing the architecture, building the integrations, and making sure every deployment is intelligent, scalable, and set up to grow.

This role sits at the intersection of customer success, product, and engineering. You’ll work directly with HR, Finance, and key stakeholders to understand what they actually need, then translate those requirements into solutions that genuinely change how their teams experience benefits. You’ll be equally comfortable presenting an architecture to a CTO, configuring a complex data integration, and jumping into a troubleshooting session to get a customer unblocked.

We’re still building this function. That means there’s no rigid playbook to follow, you’ll help write it. If you’re energised by that kind of ownership, and want to shape how a category defining product gets deployed across the world, this is the role for you.


What you’ll be doing

  • Leading end-to-end customer implementations, from discovery and scoping through to go-live and long-term optimisation, taking full ownership of the technical relationship throughout

  • Designing AI-powered solutions tailored to each customer’s benefits structure, HRIS landscape, and people strategy — turning complex requirements into clean, scalable deployments

  • Running structured technical discovery sessions and solution workshops, mapping customer needs to Happl’s capabilities before a single line of configuration is written

  • Owning integrations with HRIS, payroll, and third-party platforms (including REST APIs and webhooks), ensuring seamless, reliable data flows across every customer’s tech stack

  • Building and automating implementation workflows using AI tools, reducing manual effort and raising the consistency and quality of every deployment

  • Acting as the technical escalation point during and after go-live, diagnosing root causes quickly and partnering with Engineering to drive permanent fixes

  • Translating what you learn across implementations into reusable assets — architecture blueprints, playbooks, and internal tooling — that make every future deployment faster and smarter

  • Partnering with Customer Success to ensure adoption is strong post-launch, identifying configuration gaps and opportunities that drive retention and expansion

  • Feeding implementation insights back to Product and Engineering with clarity and evidence, directly influencing the roadmap

  • Analysing configuration and usage data across your account portfolio to spot patterns, flag risks early, and surface opportunities to improve customer outcomes

  • Championing AI-first ways of working — actively exploring tools like Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and bring smarter thinking to every customer engagement

  • Staying genuinely curious about HR tech, benefits trends, and the evolving AI landscape, bringing ideas that keep Happl and its customers ahead of the curve


What we’re looking for

jobs.title: Global Onboarding
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

First impressions matter - especially at a company growing as fast as ElevenLabs. As our dedicated onboarding owner, you'll be responsible for the end-to-end new joiner experience globally: from the moment an offer is signed to the point a new hire is fully ramped and connected to the company. You'll partner across People, Talent, Finance, IT, and the broader business to design a globally consistent onboarding journey that reflects who we are - high-velocity, ambitious, and caring. This is a systems-building role: you'll create the infrastructure that ensures every new joiner, in every timezone, hits the ground running.

  • Own the global onboarding program end-to-end - pre-boarding communications, first day experience, first-30/60/90 day frameworks and onboarding feedback.

  • Partner with People Operations & IT to ensure all operational onboarding steps (system access, equipment, compliance documentation) are completed seamlessly across every region.

  • Collaborate with Leads to build team-specific onboarding guides that complement the company-wide program.

  • Design and maintain onboarding materials - welcome tasks, wiki documentation, Leads resources - that stay current as the company evolves.

  • Track and analyze new joiner feedback to continuously improve time-to-productivity and early engagement metrics.

Requirements

We do not require any formal experience, certifications or degrees. Instead we are seeking individuals who can demonstrate impact in fast-moving environments. We do require:

  • Demonstrated experience owning or significantly contributing to onboarding programs at a fast-growing company, ideally with a global or multi-regional workforce.

  • Strong operational instincts - you enjoy building processes that scale, not just one-off experiences.

  • Highly organised with excellent attention to detail; you can manage multiple simultaneous new joiner cohorts without anything slipping.

  • Collaborative and empathetic communicator - you understand that great onboarding is as much about how people feel as what they know.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
jobs.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

Position Summary

The Associate Director, Transportation for the UK & EU is accountable for the performance, cost, and future-readiness of our regional transportation network. This role owns the day-to-day service levels our retail partners and consumers expect, while continuously reviewing and challenging the cost base, and — critically — developing the strategy that ensures our 3PL and carrier capacity can absorb the rapid growth ahead.

Sitting in London and reporting to the US-based Associate Director of Transportation, you will be the regional leader who bridges global strategy with local execution. You will partner closely with our 3PL providers, internal commercial and supply chain teams, and the US transportation function to deliver a network that is reliable, cost-efficient, scalable, and aligned to e.l.f.'s values.

Responsibilities:

Service Level Management

· Own end-to-end transportation service performance across the UK and EU, including on-time delivery, order fulfillment accuracy, and transit-time reliability for retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

· Define, track, and publish transportation KPIs and SLAs; lead monthly and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with 3PL and carrier partners to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

· Serve as the primary escalation point for transportation service failures; root-cause issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

· Ensure transportation execution meets the requirements of key retail partners (e.g., compliance with retailer routing guides, delivery windows, and ASN/labeling standards).

Cost Review & Optimization

· Own the regional transportation budget and freight spend; forecast, monitor, and explain variances monthly, identifying trends and driving corrective action.

· Conduct regular cost-to-serve analysis across lanes, modes, and channels; identify and implement opportunities to reduce cost per unit without compromising service.

· Lead carrier rate negotiations, spot-market management, and freight procurement in coordination with the US Director of Transportation and procurement team.

· Evaluate mode and lane optimization, consolidation, and network design changes to deliver year-over-year cost savings.

3PL Capacity & Growth Strategy

· Develop and maintain a forward-looking transportation capacity strategy that aligns with e.l.f.'s aggressive international growth plans, modeling 1-, 3-, and 5-year volume scenarios against 3PL and carrier capability.

· Assess the scalability of existing 3PL partners — across warehousing throughput, outbound capacity, peak-season flex, and geographic coverage — and recommend capacity additions, alternate partners, or network changes ahead of need.

· Lead or support RFPs, partner selection, onboarding, and contract governance for new or expanded 3PL and carrier relationships across the UK and EU.

· Build peak-season and surge-readiness plans in partnership with 3PLs, ensuring capacity, labor, and equipment commitments are secured well in advance of demand spikes (e.g., holiday, promotional events, new-retailer launches).

· Identify and mitigate supply chain risks — carrier concentration, single-lane dependency, customs/border exposure — with documented contingency plans.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Compliance

· Partner with the US Associate Director of Transportation to ensure regional execution aligns with global transportation strategy, systems, and standards (e.g., TMS, visibility platforms, carrier scorecards).

· Collaborate with Supply Planning, Demand Planning and Commercial Operations to align transportation capacity with forecasted demand and product launch timelines.

· Ensure full compliance with UK and EU transportation, customs, and trade regulations, and partner with customs brokers to maintain efficient and compliant cross-border movement.

· Champion e.l.f.'s sustainability commitments in transportation decisions, including modal shift, emissions reduction, and carrier sustainability standards.

Requirements:

· Lead the transportation strategy working with the other operations team professionals, building capability and a culture of continuous improvement.

· Act as the regional transportation subject-matter expert and represent the function in cross-functional initiatives and leadership reviews.

· Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

· 5+ years of progressive experience in transportation, logistics, or 3PL management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience managing 3PL relationships and carrier networks at scale, including SLA governance, QBRs, and performance management.

· Strong financial acumen — proven ownership of a transportation or freight budget, cost-to-serve analysis, and rate negotiation.

· Deep working knowledge of UK and EU transportation markets, carrier landscapes, customs/trade compliance, and retail routing-guide requirements.

· Experience planning capacity or network strategy to support significant volume growth.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (all genders) – Robuste Feed-Forward-3D-Rekonstruktion für dynamische Szenen
jobs.description:
Kurzbeschreibung

Feed-Forward-Modelle zur 3D-Rekonstruktion können Szenengeometrie direkt aus Bildern oder Videos vorhersagen, ohne eine aufwendige szenenspezifische Optimierung zu benötigen. Durch die Kombination von großskaligem Pre-Training, Multi-View-Reasoning und starken geometrischen Priors stellen sie eine effiziente Alternative zu klassischen Rekonstruktionsverfahren wie Structure-from-Motion, NeRF und optimierungsbasiertem 3D Gaussian Splatting dar.

Trotz aktueller Fortschritte reagieren bestehende Modelle weiterhin empfindlich auf anspruchsvolle reale Bedingungen. Verdeckungen, bewegte Objekte, wechselnde Beleuchtung, Nachtaufnahmen, Reflexionen, Regen, Nebel und Schnee können zu unvollständiger Geometrie, unzuverlässigen Korrespondenzen und zeitlich inkonsistenten Vorhersagen führen. Eine höhere Robustheit unter solchen Bedingungen ist daher insbesondere für autonomes Fahren und robotische Wahrnehmung von großer Bedeutung.

Als Werkstudent*in unterstützt du die Entwicklung robuster Feed-Forward-Rekonstruktionsmodelle für dynamische Szenen. Du untersuchst Methoden zur Behandlung von Verdeckungen, Beleuchtungsänderungen und widrigen Wetterbedingungen. Darüber hinaus erforschst du, wie große Rekonstruktionsmodelle als universelle geometrische Backbones für nachgelagerte Aufgaben des 3D-Szenenverständnisses eingesetzt werden können, insbesondere für Semantic Occupancy Prediction und 4D Occupancy Forecasting.


Diese Aufgaben interessieren Dich

  • Entwicklung und Evaluation von Feed-Forward-Modellen zur Rekonstruktion dynamischer 3D-Szenen aus monokularen oder Multi-View-Bildsequenzen.
  • Untersuchung der Rekonstruktionsrobustheit bei partiellen und langfristigen Verdeckungen, bewegten Objekten und unvollständigen Beobachtungen.
  • Entwicklung von Methoden zur Verbesserung der geometrischen Konsistenz bei wechselnder Beleuchtung, schlechten Lichtverhältnissen, Schatten und Reflexionen.
  • Evaluation und Verbesserung der Modellleistung unter widrigen Wetterbedingungen wie Regen, Nebel, Schnee und eingeschränkter Sicht.
  • Vergleich der entwickelten Methoden mit relevanten Baselines sowie Dokumentation technischer und experimenteller Ergebnisse.


Das zeichnet Dich aus

  • Du absolvierst gegenwärtig einen Studiengang im Bereich Informatik, Künstliche Intelligenz, Robotik, Elektrotechnik, Data Science oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Du hast sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie praktische Erfahrung mit PyTorch.
  • Du besitzt ein gutes Verständnis von Computer Vision, Deep Learning, 3D-Geometrie oder Multi-View Vision.
  • Erfahrung mit Tiefenschätzung, Optical Flow, Punktwolken, Kameraposenschätzung, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting oder 3D-Rekonstruktion ist von großem Vorteil.
  • Deine Sprachkenntnisse machen es Dir möglich, deine Rolle auf Englisch (mind. C1-Niveau) auszuüben. Deutschkenntnisse sind wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.


Gehaltsinformationen

Innerhalb unseres einheitlichen und transparenten Gehaltsframeworks liegt die Vergütung für diese Position zwischen 15,50 € und 19,50 € pro Stunde und orientiert sich an verschiedenen Faktoren, wie Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Als verzorgende help je zorgbehoevende thuis om zo zelfstandig, comfortabel en veilig mogelijk te wonen. Je ondersteunt hen bij huishoudelijke taken, boodschappen, administratie en persoonlijke verzorging. Je werkt met respect en oog voor de wensen van elke cliënt, en past je aanpak aan op wat zij nodig hebben. Sociaal inzicht, zelfstandigheid en nauwkeurigheid zorgen ervoor dat je je werk professioneel en met plezier uitvoert.

Je bent betrokken, betrouwbaar en kan goed plannen. Met jouw praktische aanpak en gevoel voor kwaliteit maak je echt het verschil in het dagelijks leven van je cliënten.

Diploma in een zorgrichting (bijvoorbeeld verzorgende of zorgkundige);
Zelfstandig en planmatig kunnen werken;
In het bezit van een wagen
Zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands omdat je met mensen moet kunnen communiceren want zijn steeds aanwezig;

jobs.title: Poetshulp Thuiszorg - Regio Willebroek
jobs.description:
Als medewerker van onze poetsdienst bied je ondersteuning aan zorgbehoevenden die, omwille van gezondheidsredenen, niet meer zelf kunnen instaan voor het onderhoud van hun woning. Je draagt bij aan een nette, hygiënische en aangename leefomgeving bij de zorgbehoevende thuis, wat een groot verschil maakt in hun dagelijks leven.

Jouw dagelijkse bezigheden zijn:

  • je maakt de woning schoon (stofzuigen, dweilen, afstoffen en algemeen onderhoud);
  • je reinigt keuken en sanitair en zorgt voor hygiëne en orde;
  • je maakt bedden op en ververst lakens volgens afspraak;
  • je helpt bij opruimen en het ordelijk houden van leefruimtes;
  • je verlucht kamers en draagt bij aan een frisse woonomgeving;
  • je doet afwas en bergt de vaat op indien dit binnen het takenpakket valt;
  • je werkt discreet en respectvol, met aandacht voor de gewoontes van de cliënt.

Voor deze functie van Poetshulp verwachten wij van jou:

  • Motivatie maar geen specifiek diploma;
  • Dat je betrouwbaar en respectvol bent;
  • Dat je een hart hebt voor zorgbehoevenden;
  • Dat je zelfstandig kan werken en initiatief toont;
  • Een flexibele, gedreven en sociaal voelende ingesteldheid;
  • Dat je over een wagen beschikt.

jobs.title: (Zelfstandig) thuisverpleegkundige – regio Berchem
jobs.description:
Heb jij het hart op de juiste plek en wil je zelfstandig werken met impact? Dan ben jij de thuisverpleegkundige die we zoeken!

Als (zelfstandig) thuisverpleegkundige bied je kwalitatieve en persoonlijke zorg aan cliënten in hun vertrouwde omgeving. Je werkt autonoom, maar steeds in nauwe samenwerking met andere zorgverleners.

Bij ons doe je écht mee:

  • je voert verpleegkundige handelingen uit zoals wondzorg, inspuitingen en medicatietoediening;
  • je schat de zorgbehoefte van cliënten in (klinisch, psychisch en sociaal);
  • je stelt zorgplannen op en volgt deze op;
  • je observeert de gezondheidstoestand van cliënten en stuurt bij waar nodig;
  • je registreert zorg en houdt patiëntendossiers correct bij;
  • je overlegt met huisartsen en andere zorgprofessionals;
  • je begeleidt cliënten en mantelzorgers en stimuleert zelfredzaamheid.

Je wordt voornamelijk ingezet in de regio Berchem afhankelijk van jouw mobiliteit.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar bent altijd verbonden met een betrokken team en organisatie die jou ondersteunt.

Klinkt dat als jouw manier van werken? Join ons netwerk!

Ben jij een (zelfstandige) verpleegkundige met een hart voor zorg? Dan pas je perfect bij ons.

  • Je beschikt over een diploma verpleegkunde en een RIZIV-nummer;
  • Je bent bereid je te conventioneren;
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar hecht ook belang aan samenwerking;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk, nauwkeurig en betrouwbaar;
  • Je communiceert vlot met cliënten, mantelzorgers en zorgpartners;
  • Je bouwt sterke relaties op met huisartsen en andere zorgverleners;
  • Je denkt mee in het belang van de patiënt en stimuleert zelfzorg;
  • Je kan je vinden in een mensgerichte zorgvisie zoals Positive Care;
  • Nederlands spreken en begrijpen? Helemaal in orde.

jobs.title: Zorgkundige - WZC Seniorplaza
jobs.description:
Bij Seniorplaza draag je als zorgkundige bij aan een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat. Je bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor bewoners en maakt het verschil in kleine momenten van aandacht. Je werkt nauw samen met verpleegkundigen en collega’s om kwaliteitsvolle, persoonsgerichte zorg te bieden.

Jouw dagelijkse bezigheden bestaan uit:

  • je voert gedelegeerde verzorgende en verpleegkundige handelingen uit;
  • je staat in voor dagelijkse verzorging en hygiëne;
  • je biedt comfortzorg en preventieve zorg;
  • je observeert en rapporteert veranderingen;
  • je ondersteunt bij maaltijden, medicatie en dagelijkse activiteiten;
  • je draagt bij aan orde en netheid op de afdeling.

Als zorgkundige draag je bij aan dagelijkse verzorging, hygiëne, comfortzorg en preventieve zorg, met aandacht voor orde en netheid op de afdeling. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een huiselijke sfeer en zorg op maat, elke dag opnieuw. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten betrokkenheid, nauwkeurigheid en teamgerichtheid centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je kwaliteitsvol werkt, veranderingen observeert en samen met verpleegkundigen de zorg afstemt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • diploma en visum zorgkundige;
  • ervaring: niet vereist;
  • correct uitvoeren van gedelegeerde handelingen + observeren/rapporteren;
  • goede kennis Nederlands;
  • flexibel en stressbestendig.

jobs.title: Regioverantwoordelijke Provincie Antwerpen flex / huisbezoeker
jobs.description:
Als regioverantwoordelijke flex zorg je mee voor de continuïteit van de werking binnen thuiszorg in de provincie Antwerpen. Je springt in waar het druk is of waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is, en je ondersteunt teams vanuit ons kantoor in Willebroek. Je combineert organisatie en people management met een mensgerichte aanpak: je motiveert medewerkers, bewaakt planningen en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Dankzij jouw overzicht blijft de dienstverlening betrouwbaar en goed afgestemd op de klant.

Jouw dagelijkse taken zijn:

  • je zorgt mee voor de continuïteit van onze werking gezinszorg/poetsdienst waar een collega tijdelijk afwezig is of waar het extra druk is;
  • je maakt planningen op en volgt verlof, bezetting en inzetbaarheid op voor een team van 30-35 medewerkers;
  • je voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit en afstemming van de dienstverlening;
  • je voert gesprekken met medewerkers rond functioneren, welbevinden en ontwikkeling;
  • je motiveert, enthousiasmeert en stuurt bij waar nodig, met aandacht voor teamdynamiek;
  • je speelt in op noden en wensen van cliënten vanuit het volledige aanbod van Korian Home Care;
  • je onderhoudt contacten met medewerkers, cliënten en doorverwijzers;
  • je volgt opleiding en inwerktrajecten vanuit de kantoren in Willebroek.

Als regioverantwoordelijke flex draag je bij aan de continuïteit van de gezinszorg of poetsdienst binnen jouw regio. Je maakt planningen op, ondersteunt medewerkers, voert huisbezoeken uit en bewaakt de kwaliteit van dienstverlening. Je motiveert teams en onderhoudt contacten met cliënten en doorverwijzers. Samen met je collega’s zorg jij voor een betrouwbare en mensgerichte dienstverlening. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten organisatorisch sterk, communicatief en mensgericht binnen jouw functie centraal. Die heb je nodig omdat je teams aanstuurt en dienstverlening op elkaar afstemt.

Verder vragen wij:

  • je beschikt over minimaal een bachelor diploma (bij voorkeur zorg gerelateerd);
  • je kan zelfstandig werken en initiatief nemen;
  • je bent flexibel en betrokken;
  • je kan zeer goed plannen en denkt oplossingsgericht;
  • je beschikt over een rijbewijs en eigen wagen;
  • je kan vlot communiceren in het Nederlands (mondeling en schriftelijk).

jobs.title: Arbeider wegenbouw
jobs.description:
Dit bouwbedrijf is op zoek naar een arbeider wegenbouw regio Diest. Ze zijn actief in de bouwsector en het onderhoud van vervoersinfrastructuur. Ze werken aan oplossingen voor mobiliteit, urbanisatie en milieu-uitdagingen bij lokale overheden. De kernactiviteiten zijn: aanleg en onderhoud van wegen, spoorwegen, luchthaven- en haveninfrastructuur en industriële en logistieke sites. Hun projecten omvatten: (snel)wegen, tramlijnen, luchthavenbanen, havenplatformen en parkings. In België zijn er vestigingen in Antwerpen, Brussel, Limburg, Luik en Henegouwen, met samen meer dan 1000 medewerkers. Het bedrijf maakt deel uit van een internationale bouwgroep.


Jobomschrijving

Als arbeider wegenbouw regio Diest voer je dagelijks wegenwerken uit op de werf, met focus op veilige en duurzame uitvoering.

  • Uitvoeren van wegenwerken zoals asfalt- en betonherstellingen, volgens de planning op de werf.
  • Voorbereiden en plaatsen van wegbedekkingen op basis van technische plannen.
  • Aanbrengen van markeringen en signalisatie om de verkeersveiligheid te ondersteunen.
  • Bedienen van werfmachines en -materiaal, waaronder trilplaten, graafmachines en gereedschap.
  • Monteren van stootbanden en andere veiligheidsvoorzieningen, en materiaal en gereedschap onderhouden in overleg met collega’s.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Ben jij iemand die graag buiten werkt en de handen uit de mouwen steekt? Dan is dit jouw job!

  • Je bent bekend met het uitvoeren van wegenwerken omdat je hier al ervaring in hebt.
  • Je werkt graag buiten en hebt geen probleem met wisselende werkomgevingen.
  • Je wil zelfstandig werken zodra de verwachtingen duidelijk zijn en je lost praktische problemen op de werf op.
  • Je werkt vlot samen in het team om deadlines te halen.
  • Je werkt veiligheidsbewust en volgt werf- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.
  • Technisch inzicht is hier een meerwaarde.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag buiten is en zich goed voelt in een werkomgeving met wisselende weersomstandigheden.
  • Iemand die flexibel omgaat met werkuren en vlot schakelt tussen verschillende opdrachten op de werf.
  • Iemand die veiligheidsbewust en nauwkeurig werkt en werf- en veiligheidsvoorschriften consequent volgt.
  • Iemand die duidelijk communiceert en actief afstemt met collega’s en de ploegbaas.
  • Iemand met een hands-on mentaliteit die collegiaal samenwerkt en openstaat voor opleiding en begeleiding om nieuwe technieken aan te leren.

jobs.title: Poetshulp - regio Mechelen
jobs.description:
Als poetshulp in regio Mechelen ondersteun je cliënten die door gezondheidsredenen het huishouden niet meer volledig zelf kunnen doen. Jij helpt hen om in een nette, veilige en aangename thuisomgeving te blijven wonen. Je werkt zelfstandig bij mensen thuis en zorgt met jouw hulp voor comfort, rust en meer levenskwaliteit in het dagelijks leven. Jouw nieuwe taken:

Je helpt met huishoudelijke taken zodat mensen veilig en aangenaam thuis kunnen blijven wonen. Samen met je cliënten zorg jij voor netheid, rust en een verzorgde thuisomgeving. Daarnaast staan de kwaliteiten zelfstandig, betrouwbaar en sociaal voelend binnen jouw functie centraal. jobs.title: Grondwerker Boringen
jobs.description:
Grondwerker boringen gezocht

Werk mee aan boorprojecten en ondersteun de boorploeg in een veilige en efficiënte werkomgeving.

Je werkt als grondwerker binnen een ervaren team aan diverse boor- en infrastructuurprojecten.

Vanuit Gent vertrek je dagelijks met je team om ter plaatse manuele grondwerken uit te voeren en de boorploeg te ondersteunen.

Veiligheid, kwaliteit en samenwerking staan centraal in je dagelijkse taken.

- Uitvoeren van manuele graafwerken en andere fysieke werkzaamheden op de werf
- Ondersteunen bij het opstellen, afbreken en onderhouden van de boorinstallatie
- Helpen bij het koppelen van boorstangen en bedienen van de zeefinstallatie
- Zorgen voor een veilige en ordelijke werkomgeving
- Signaleren van technische problemen en bijdragen aan oplossingen
- Nauw samenwerken met collega’s en duidelijke communicatie over de voortgang

Je werkt in dagploeg en maakt deel uit van een stabiele onderneming met vaste indienstname na interim.

Kan je niet wachten om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer vandaag, we kijken uit naar je reactie! - Vaardigheden:
Wie ben jij?

Je bent gemotiveerd en leert snel nieuwe vaardigheden aan.

Ervaring met boorwerken is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste.

Je hebt technisch inzicht. Een achtergrond als mecanicien of elektricien is mooi meegenomen.

Je werkt graag in teamverband en communiceert vlot met je collega's.

Veiligheid staat voor jou altijd op de eerste plaats en je volgt de veiligheidsvoorschriften nauwgezet.

Je woont bij voorkeur in Gent



Opleiding: Geen specifiek diploma vereist. Een technische opleiding is een pluspunt.

Vakkennis: Technisch inzicht. Ervaring met grondwerken of boorwerken is een meerwaarde.



Attesten: Een geldig VCA-attest is een pluspunt of je bent bereid dit vóór opstart te behalen.
Je beschikt bij voorkeur over een rijbewijs B of je gaat dit heel binnenkort behalen

- Attesten:
VCA-attest (te behalen voor opstart - via ASAP (1 dag opleiding met een examen )
Rijbewijs B

- Opleidingsvereisten:
Bij voorkeur heb je een opleiding mechanica/ lassen/ elektriciteit/ hydraulica gevolgd

- Vakkennis:
Technisch inzicht. Ervaring met grondwerken of boorwerken is een meerwaarde.

- Talenkennis:
Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en of Frans.
