jobs.title: Recepcionista (Empfangskraft)
jobs.description:
Recepcionista

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

El objetivo de este puesto es ofrecer una atención profesional a nuestros huéspedes, desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta una bonita despedida en el check-out. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:

- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out
- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones
- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo
- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)
- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturales

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

Tanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:

- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional
- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera
- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés
- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

jobs.title: Barman/Barmaid de 2ª (Barmixer/in, Barkeeper/in)
jobs.description:
Barman/Barmaid de 2ª

Descrição da empresa

You create experiences for our guests. As an employer, we create experiences for you. How? At The Cloud One, every day is unique. Never same-same, always thrillingly different. With us, you have the freedom to be who you are – or who you want to be. Because here, individuality is what matters. With equal – and exciting – opportunities for all. We believe in an inclusive culture that puts people like you at the heart of what we do, because we know that you’re the ones who make the difference. For us, respect and success go hand in hand. We’re locally rooted: connected to the city, its culture and its people. Are you with us?

Descrição do emprego

Estamos à procura de um(a) Barman/Barmaid de 2ª com atitude positiva, espírito de equipa e paixão por hospitalidade para se juntar à nossa equipa. Se gostas de criar experiências memoráveis através de cocktails e bom serviço, esta oportunidade é para ti!

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Preparar e servir bebidas alcoólicas e não alcoólicas com criatividade e atenção ao detalhe.
- Criar cocktails clássicos e de autor, garantindo qualidade e apresentação.
- Proporcionar um atendimento simpático, profissional e personalizado aos clientes.
- Manter o espaço do bar limpo, organizado e em conformidade com as normas de higiene e segurança.
- Trabalhar em equipa com os colegas de F&B para garantir um serviço fluido e eficiente.
- Sugerir bebidas e promover produtos de forma proativa.

Qualificações

Formação e Experiência:

- Experiência mínima de 1 ano como Barman/Barmaid (preferencialmente em hotelaria ou restauração).
- Formação na área de hotelaria, restauração ou mixologia (valorizada).

Competências Técnicas:

- Conhecimento sólido de bebidas, cocktails e técnicas de bar.
- Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de POS.
- Conhecimento das normas HACCP.

Competências Pessoais:

- Boa comunicação e simpatia natural.
- Proatividade, dinamismo e atenção ao detalhe.
- Espírito de equipa e flexibilidade para trabalhar por turnos, fins de semana e feriados.
- Fluência em português e inglês (outras línguas são uma mais-valia).

jobs.title: Guest Service Agent Bar (m/w/d) (Empfangsmitarbeiter/in (Hotel))
jobs.description:
Guest Service Agent Bar (m/w/d)

Stellenbeschreibung

Wir suchen eine:n Bar-Mitarbeiter:in im Gästeservice für unser Hospitality-Team in Wien, Österreich. In dieser Position sind Sie das Aushängeschild unseres Barbetriebs, bieten außergewöhnlichen Service und sorgen für unvergessliche Erlebnisse bei unseren Gästen. Sie arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem Ihr freundliches Auftreten, Ihre Liebe zum Detail und Ihr Engagement für die Kundenzufriedenheit entscheidend für unseren Erfolg sind.

- Begrüßen Sie die Gäste herzlich und bieten Sie einen zügigen, zuvorkommenden Service an der Bartheke sowie im gesamten Servicebereich - Nehmen Sie Getränkebestellungen präzise entgegen und bereiten Sie Getränke gemäß festgelegter Rezepte und Standards zu bzw. servieren Sie diese - Zeigen Sie umfassende Kenntnisse unserer Getränkekarte, einschließlich Cocktails, Weine, Biere und alkoholfreier Getränke, und geben Sie individuelle Empfehlungen
- Bedienen Sie Kassensysteme (POS) effizient und wickeln Sie Zahlungen und Transaktionen korrekt ab - Sorgen Sie für eine saubere, aufgeräumte und hygienische Umgebung an der Bar, einschließlich des Nachfüllens von Vorräten und der Bestandsverwaltung - Gehen Sie auf Gästeanfragen, Anliegen und Beschwerden einfühlsam und professionell ein und lösen Sie Probleme umgehend
- Mit Teammitgliedern zusammenarbeiten, um einen reibungslosen Serviceablauf zu gewährleisten, und Kolleg:innen in Stoßzeiten unterstützen - Verantwortungsbewusste Praktiken beim Ausschank von Getränken einhalten und bei Bedarf den Ausweis der Gäste überprüfen - Das Verhalten der Gäste beobachten und eine sichere, einladende Atmosphäre für alle Gäste aufrechterhalten - Dem Management Feedback zu den Vorlieben der Gäste und zu betrieblichen Verbesserungen geben

Benefits:

- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Barservice, im Gastgewerbe oder in kundenorientierten Funktionen - Hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, Gäste mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund anzusprechen - Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zum aktiven Zuhören und echtes Einfühlungsvermögen für die Bedürfnisse der Gäste - Sicherer Umgang mit Kassensystemen (POS) und Verfahren zur Bargeldabwicklung - Kenntnisse über Getränke, Cocktails und den Barbetrieb
- Fähigkeit, in einem stark frequentierten, schnelllebigen Umfeld effektiv mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu bewältigen - Problemlösungskompetenz und die Fähigkeit, herausfordernde Situationen gelassen zu meistern
- Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für Sauberkeit und Ordnung - Flexibilität für wechselnde Schichten, einschließlich Abend-, Wochenend- und Feiertagsdiensten - Mehrsprachigkeit (vorzugsweise Deutsch und Englisch) ist von Vorteil - Zertifizierung für den verantwortungsvollen Getränkeservice oder die Bereitschaft, diese zu erwerben - Professionelles Auftreten und eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsmoral

jobs.title: Senior Accountant Manager  (Leiter/in - Finanz- und Rechnungswesen)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.

- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

jobs.title: Assistant Comptable Polyvalent (H/F)
jobs.description:
Assistant Comptable Polyvalent (H/F)
Martinique - Secteur Sud

Vous êtes doué(e) pour l'organisation ? On vous propose un poste où ça compte vraiment.

- Votre quotidien ?

Vous contrôlez les factures fournisseurs, vous préparez les paiements et vous tenez les tableaux qui disent à la direction ce qui sort, de quelle société et quand. Vous pointez la banque, vous contrôlez les caisses, vous préparez les remises.
De l'autre côté, vous facturez : les clients, les collectivités via CHORUS Pro, et les sociétés du Groupe entre elles. Vous imputez les virements, vous établissez les avoirs, et vous relancez ceux qui ont oublié de payer.
Le reste du temps, vous êtes celle ou celui qui sait. Où est le contrat d'assurance. Quel véhicule passe au contrôle. Quel matériel doit sortir des immobilisations. Ce que l'expert-comptable va demander avant même qu'il le demande.
Et on ne vous le cachera pas : plusieurs sociétés, ça veut dire plusieurs calendriers, et des semaines où tout tombe en même temps. C'est exactement ce qui rend le poste intéressant, et exactement ce qui le rend exigeant.

- Votre profil :

Vous avez un BTS Comptabilité et Gestion, un BTS Gestion de la PME, un BUT GEA ou une expérience équivalente.
Une première expérience suffit. On ne cherche pas dix ans de métier : on cherche quelqu'un de fiable, à qui l'on peut confier les comptes de plusieurs sociétés. Le reste s'apprend, et vous serez accompagné(e) sur les outils et les procédures à la prise de poste.

Vous avez déjà pratiqué CHORUS Pro, la facturation tiers-payant, les dossiers d'importation ou le suivi des immobilisations ? Dites-le nous, ça compte vraiment.

- Ce que nous vous offrons : Contrat CDI à Temps plein, 35 heures hebdomadaires, à pourvoir le 1er septembre 2026. Poste sédentaire dans le Sud de la Martinique, non éligible au télétravail

- Rémunération : à partir de 12,52 € de l'heure, soit 1 898,90 € brut mensuel

Poste ouvert à toutes et tous, et accessible aux personnes en situation de handicap : dites-nous ce qu'il vous faut, on regarde ce qu'on peut aménager.

Vous avez le sens du détail ? Ne nous envoyez pas une lettre de motivation classique. Dites-nous simplement pourquoi vous êtes la bonne personne.

jobs.title: Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Kelvion

Unsere Mission ist es, mit Innovationskraft und Nachhaltigkeit die industrielle Transformation voranzutreiben. Ob bei der Optimierung von Rechenzentren, der Weiterentwicklung der Wasserstoffproduktion oder der Neugestaltung von Kühl- und Klimatechniksystemen – unsere thermischen Schlüsseltechnologien stärken zahlreiche Branchen weltweit. Als „One Kelvion“ arbeiten wir kontinuierlich an Lösungen, die unsere Kunden noch erfolgreicher machen und gleichzeitig zu einer nachhaltigeren Zukunft beitragen.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

Stellenbeschreibung

Ihre Aufgaben:

➢ Globale Supplier-Quality-Strategie: Definition und Umsetzung einer global ausgerichteten Supplier-Quality-Strategie im Einklang mit den Qualitätszielen, operativen Prioritäten und Wachstumsanforderungen von Kelvion.

➢ Standardisierung & Governance: Entwicklung, Einführung und Harmonisierung globaler Supplier-Quality-Prozesse über Produktionsstandorte, Regionen und Business Units hinweg.

➢ Lieferantenqualifizierung & -entwicklung: Aufbau durchgängiger Standards für Lieferantenqualifizierung, Onboarding, Audits, APQP, PPAP, Lieferantenänderungsmanagement, Wareneingangsqualität, Non-Conformance-Management, CAPA und Performance Monitoring.

➢ Supplier Performance Excellence: Durchführung und Steuerung von Lieferantenentwicklungs- und Recovery-Programmen zur Verbesserung von Qualität, Liefertreue, Prozessfähigkeit und nachhaltiger Lieferantenperformance.

➢ Präventive Qualitätsarbeit: Weiterentwicklung der Supplier-Quality-Organisation von einem reaktiven, prüfungsgetriebenen Ansatz hin zu einem präventiven, strukturierten und datenbasierten Qualitätsmodell.

➢ Problemlösung & kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Stärkung von Root-Cause-Analysen, 8D-Problemlösung, CAPA-Disziplin und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen innerhalb der Lieferantenbasis.

➢ KPI, Reporting & Transparenz: Definition von Supplier-Quality-KPIs, Reporting-Strukturen, Dashboards und Governance-Routinen zur Schaffung von Transparenz, Verbindlichkeit und kontinuierlicher Steuerung.

➢ Schnittstellenmanagement: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations sowie regionalen Quality-Teams zur frühzeitigen Identifikation und Reduzierung lieferantenbezogener Risiken.

➢ Audits & Compliance: Durchführung und Koordination von Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Performance Reviews und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten unter Berücksichtigung relevanter Kunden-, regulatorischer, Industrie- und Qualitätsmanagementanforderungen, insbesondere ISO 9001.

➢ Funktionale Führung: Fachliche Führung lokaler Supplier Quality Engineers und Förderung einer globalen Qualitätskultur, die auf Prävention, Verantwortung, kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und operativer Disziplin basiert.

Ihr Profil:

➢ Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

➢ Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung im Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Quality oder Quality Management in einem industriellen Produktionsumfeld.

➢ Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Weiterentwicklung oder Harmonisierung von Supplier-Quality-Organisationen über Standorte, Regionen oder Business Units hinweg.

➢ Fundierte Expertise in Supplier Quality Management, Lieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenaudits, Prozessaudits, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Performance Improvement.

➢ Praktische Erfahrung mit APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, Risikomanagement und Qualitätsmanagementsystemen.

➢ Erfahrung in globalen Produktions- und Lieferantenstrukturen; Erfahrung aus der Automobilindustrie oder einem vergleichbar reifen Qualitätsumfeld ist von Vorteil.

➢ Fähigkeit, in einer Matrixorganisation fachlich zu führen, Stakeholder über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg zu beeinflussen und globale Standards pragmatisch umzusetzen.

➢ Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Bereitschaft zu internationalen Reisen von ca. 30–50 %.

Unser Erfolg basiert auf Zusammenarbeit – wir fördern vielfältiges Denken, hören einander zu und schätzen jede einzelne Stimme. Kreativität entfaltet sich bei Kelvion dort, wo Menschen gehört, ihre Ideen willkommen geheißen und ihre Beiträge anerkannt werden.

Mit einem flexiblen Arbeitsansatz stellen wir das Wohlbefinden und die Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeitenden in den Mittelpunkt. Dies stärkt die Bereitschaft sich einzubringen und eröffnet damit neue Karrierechancen Wir ermutigen engagierte Persönlichkeiten ihre Entwicklung selbst in die Hand zu nehmen, neue Wege zu gehen und gemeinsam mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten.

Wir gestalten Zukunft – gemeinsam

English Version

Global Supplier Quality Manager (m/w/d)

Kelvion

Our mission is to lead the industrial transformation by championing innovation and sustainability. From optimising data centres and advancing hydrogen production to revolutionising refrigeration and HVAC systems, our mission-critical thermal solutions empower industries around the globe. United as “One Kelvion,” our global team delivers innovative solutions that drive customer success and support a sustainable future.

Together, We Shape the Future

Job Description

Your responsibilities:

➢ Global supplier quality strategy: Define and execute the global supplier quality strategy in line with Kelvion’s quality objectives, operational priorities and business growth requirements.

➢ Standardisation & governance: Develop, implement and harmonise global supplier quality processes across manufacturing sites, regions and business units.

➢ Supplier qualification & development: Establish end-to-end standards for supplier qualification, onboarding, audits, APQP, PPAP, supplier change management, incoming quality control, non-conformance management, CAPA and performance monitoring.

➢ Supplier performance excellence: Drive supplier development and recovery programmes to improve quality, delivery reliability, process capability and long-term supplier performance.

➢ Preventive quality approach: Further develop the supplier quality organisation from a reactive, incoming-inspection-driven approach towards a preventive, structured and data-driven quality model.

➢ Problem solving & continuous improvement: Strengthen root cause analysis, 8D problem solving, CAPA discipline and sustainable corrective action follow-up across the supplier base.

➢ KPIs, reporting & transparency: Define supplier quality KPIs, reporting structures, dashboards and governance routines to create transparency, accountability and continuous performance management.

➢ Stakeholder collaboration: Work closely with Procurement, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, Operations and regional Quality teams to proactively identify and mitigate supplier-related risks.

➢ Audits & compliance: Conduct and coordinate supplier audits, process audits, performance reviews and benchmarking activities, ensuring compliance with customer, regulatory, industry and quality management system requirements, including ISO 9001.

➢ Functional leadership: Provide functional leadership to local Supplier Quality Engineers and strengthen a global quality culture focused on prevention, accountability, continuous improvement and operational discipline.

Your profile:

➢ Master’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain or a related technical discipline.

➢ At least 6 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality or Quality Management within an industrial manufacturing environment.

➢ Proven experience in building, developing or harmonising supplier quality organisations across sites, regions or business units.

➢ Strong expertise in supplier quality management, supplier development, supplier audits, process audits, supplier qualification and performance improvement.

➢ Practical experience with APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, root cause analysis, risk management and quality management systems.

➢ Experience in global manufacturing and supplier environments; experience in the automotive industry or a similarly mature quality environment is an advantage.

➢ Ability to lead functionally in a matrix organisation, influence stakeholders across functions and regions and implement global standards pragmatically.

➢ Fluent English skills and willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30–50 %.

At Kelvion we thrive on collaboration, embracing diversity of thought, and valuing every voice. Within Kelvion creativity shines because people are listened to, their contributions recognised, and their ideas welcomed. Our flexible approach to the way we work places people’s health and satisfaction as a priority, enhancing engagement and fostering career opportunities. We empower engaged individuals to grow, progress and carve their own paths within the company.

Together, We Shape the Future

Nurse

Job Title: Nurse

International SOS is the world’s leading medical and security services company with over 12,000 employees working in 1,000 locations in 90 countries. International SOS Government Services administers the TRICARE Overseas Program providing high-quality, accessible health care services for U.S. Military service members, family members, retirees, and other eligible beneficiaries overseas.

About the role

- Perhaps you live abroad and would like to return to Poland?
- Do you have a Polish nursing license?
- Looking to apply your experience in a new environment?
- Is it time to move away from the demands of clinical care in a hospital environment?
- Do you speak Polish and English?

We are looking for a Nurse (known internally as a Near Patient Nurse) based in Poznan or within proximity, to support our global patient care program, TRICARE. You will be responsible for providing medical case management for patients, visiting them at healthcare provider sites, writing medical reports and providing medical updates.

This is a fantastic opportunity for nurses to move away from the demands of a clinical environment to an on-site case manager role using their medical expertise.

Key responsibilities

- The nurse would provide comprehensive in-patient clinical case management
- Develop and maintain effective relationships with providers, (medical and administrative) internal and external stakeholders and suppliers to ensure excellent delivery of service
- Regularly visit or contact the care providers (civilian and military treatment facility centers) to obtain updates for medical cases
- Liaise with patients to obtain detailed clinical information including past medical history to allow for accurate on-going case management
- Support the medical collection team in obtaining the discharge summary and medical records from the care provider

About you

- Registered General Nurse or equivalent with minimum 3 years of experience with registration to practice in Poland
- Recognized qualification to minimum diploma level or equivalence in practice demonstrated through portfolio/CV
- A demonstrable commitment to professional development
- Able to communicate Polish and proficiently in English
- Own a car and have a clean license
- Passionate about international healthcare

Benefits

- 15,900 PLN car allowance per annum
- 2,400 PLN home allowance per annum
- Structured career development track, with opportunities for progression and advancement
- Warm, supportive, and open company culture
- An opportunity to thrive in a global environment
- We celebrate diversity on a global scale and encourage every colleague to bring their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion and equal support

At International SOS, we offer a great working environment, thanks to our commitment to flexible working, diversity, and development.  We encourage every person to be their personal best by creating an environment of inclusion, equality and support.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst- Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn.

We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes.

You'll help answer questions such as:

  • Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value?
  • Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation?
  • What drives repeat usage, retention and churn?
  • Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance?
  • How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments?

If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding.
  • Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist.
  • Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics.
  • Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value.
  • Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities.

Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.

Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Drive Technical Excellence: Act as a subject matter expert, providing high-level reviews and technical advice across multiple teams.

Why Join Us?

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We’re looking for a Commercial Manager, Global Supply Chain to join our team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us establish a unified, highly efficient commercial approach for our physical goods, logistics, and courier equipment supply chains across global operations.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Global Supply Chain team, responsible for getting physical goods—courier apparel, equipment, in-store technology, and consumables—to our riders, merchants, and partners across every market. Sitting underneath the Senior Commercial Manager, you will build and execute sourcing strategies, lead complex international negotiations, and manage supplier performance across the DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt ecosystem.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

Sourcing Strategy & Execution

  • Translate category strategies into actionable sourcing plans across warehousing, last-mile fulfilment, apparel, manufacturing, and consumables, driving consolidation across our brands.

  • Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing events, utilizing spend analytics, market intelligence, and total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling to secure optimal commercial outcomes.

  • Build and execute robust negotiation positions, focusing on unit cost, freight, duty, quality protections, and working capital impact.

Contract & Supplier Management

  • Own the end-to-end contracting process in partnership with Legal, maintaining a complete contract register and enforcing lifecycle obligations, renewals, and rebates.

  • Drive day-to-day commercial supplier management, conducting structured performance reviews, establishing operational KPIs, and managing Joint Improvement Plans.

  • Mitigate supply chain risk and ensure continuity of supply, establishing dual-sourcing strategies, financial risk assessments, and strict ethical sourcing/modern slavery compliance across manufacturing partners.

  • Partner with operational and logistics leadership to align requirements, streamline specifications, and build credibility across historically independent regional teams.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Significant experience in supply chain sourcing, with a proven track record delivering measurable commercial value across logistics, 3PL, or manufactured goods categories.

  • Demonstrated ability in end-to-end competitive sourcing, including hands-on contract negotiation with major international suppliers and manufacturing partners.

  • Proven capability in supplier relationship and performance management, with experience handling complex commercial disputes and driving joint innovation.

  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with expertise in total cost of ownership (TCO) modeling, landed cost structures, and spend analytics.

  • Exceptional stakeholder influence, with the ability to bridge operational needs with commercial outcomes across multi-region or cross-brand environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience sourcing apparel or hardgoods manufacturing, including factory selection, quality control, and ethical audit frameworks.

  • Experience leading post-acquisition supplier consolidation or specification harmonisation.

  • Familiarity with direct/inventory-based supply chains, including international freight, customs/duty, and working capital dynamics.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

 

About the Role

As a Senior Corporate Security Engineer, you will lead the design and operation of security controls that protect our internal networks, workforce identities, endpoints and corporate systems. You will be working globally with security teams across US, EU and APAC, delivering against our goals and objectives - reducing risk and maturing controls.

 

As a Senior, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy. You will define technical direction, make architectural decisions, and deliver complex security initiatives end-to-end. You will be expected to balance risk reduction with usability, ensuring controls are robust without impeding employee productivity.

This role focuses on Identity and Access Management (IAM), Endpoint security (EDR), Network Security, logging and detection engineering, and secure SaaS enablement. You will work closely with IT, Legal, Privacy, Engineering and business stakeholders to embed security as a default practice across the organisation.

 

Security controls will be aligned to recognised frameworks such as the CIS Critical Security Controls and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF).

 
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Control Implementation: Design, deploy, and maintain core corporate security controls, including phishing-resistant MFA, Just-In-Time (JIT) access, strict role-based access control (RBAC), zero-trust architectures, device and identity bound proofing and modern network isolation.

  • Tooling Ownership: Serve as the technical owner for a broad suite of corporate security systems, managing deployments, configurations, and API integrations for tools across the corporate environment.

  • Technical Leadership: Lead and implement the technical strategy for Endpoint Device trust, Data Loss Prevention, Intellectual property storage, and SaaS application security. Alongside wider corporate security technical controls.

  • Automation & Engineering: Write scripts and build tools to automate security workflows, incident response tasks, and audit evidence collection for compliance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with IT and business operations to integrate security tools into everyday workflows. Guide non-security teams to adopt secure baselines (e.g., CIS Benchmarks) as standard practice.

  • Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years’ experience in Security Engineering, Corporate Security, Detection & Response, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace).

  • Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products

  • Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP)

  • Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform)

  • Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect).

  • Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling.

  • Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic.

  • Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance.

  • Ability to write production-quality automation scripts.

  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives.

 

Desirable Skills

  • Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms.

  • Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance.

  • Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development.

  • Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits.

  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC).

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Investor
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Role

9fin's buy-side clients are the capital behind the credit markets. Credit funds, CLO managers, private credit platforms, and distressed investors run research, underwriting, portfolio monitoring, and relative value workflows that are deep and specialised. They are actively excited about what AI can unlock. Our job is to make that potential real inside their investment teams.

The Forward Deployed Investor is the person who does it. You are a domain expert who has done the work yourself, and you can credibly sit across the table from a portfolio manager, a private credit underwriter, or a distressed analyst and say: "Here is how this changes the way you invest."

You will work with 9fin's most strategic buy-side clients, drive deep adoption of our existing AI capabilities across the investment process, and become a critical voice in shaping what we build next. Every client engagement is a source of product intelligence. The insights you bring back from the front line will directly influence 9fin's AI product roadmap and sharpen how we win the next generation of buy-side accounts.

 

What You Will Do

  • Map investment workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how sourcing, screening, underwriting, credit committee preparation, portfolio monitoring, and relative value work actually gets done end-to-end. Identify the three to five places where 9fin's AI can materially change the workflow. Co-author adoption success criteria with the client, tied to their investment outcomes.

  • Build 9fin's AI into those workflows. Take the identified insertion points and build them out using 9fin's toolkit: in-platform capabilities, MCP integrations, agents, and future capabilities as they ship. Weighted by workflow depth, not count. Iterate based on real usage behaviour, not intended usage.

  • Drive adoption at your served accounts. Onboard named users across investment, research, and risk. Run enablement sessions with power users, identify and support champions inside the client. Monitor active usage and address dormant seats before they become churn signals. Review adoption monthly with client champions and quarterly with the CIO, head of research, or equivalent sponsor.

  • Feed the field back into 9fin. Every deployment produces structured intelligence, fed to two consumers. First, product and engineering: prioritised requests tied to specific account and workflow context, patterns extracted across deployments. Second, the wider GTM cycle: case studies, demo assets, workflow evidence, and competitive intelligence that sharpen the next GTM cycle.

  • Spot expansion. Identify opportunities inside served accounts for new users, new use cases, new departments, or new products. Document with context and hand to Account Management for commercial follow-up.

 

What You Bring

You are a subject matter expert with 3+ years of practitioner experience at an asset manager, credit fund, or insurer, with fluency across end-to-end investment workflows in your area, not just the data those workflows consume. Specifically, in one or more of the following:

  • Credit portfolio management and research. High yield, leveraged loan, or multi-strategy credit investing, covering screening, underwriting, credit committee process, and ongoing portfolio monitoring

  • Private credit and direct lending. Origination, underwriting, documentation review, or portfolio monitoring at a private credit or direct lending platform

  • CLO investing. CLO management, warehouse and portfolio construction, or CLO debt and equity tranche investing

  • Distressed and special situations. Stressed and distressed credit analysis, restructuring and process tracking, documentation and covenant analysis, or capital structure work

  • Buy-side transformation, data, or research technology functions. Investment data, quantitative or systematic credit research, chief data office, digital transformation, or AI strategy roles where you have led or contributed to AI and workflow transformation projects specifically in credit investing

Beyond your domain expertise, you are:

  • Demonstrably interested in technology applied to your domain. For example: participation in an internal AI, data, or research technology working group; external vendor champion or evaluation lead for domain tech. You may have already moved to a technology company focused on credit markets.

  • Familiar with and hands-on with modern domain tooling. Direct user experience of Rogo, Hebbia, AlphaSense, Octus, or comparable AI-native platforms in your workflow. You can speak from experience about what works, what doesn't, and why.

  • Comfortable operating inside confidential investment processes. You will sit close to live pipelines, positions, and internal research. You are disciplined about what does and does not travel between accounts, and clients trust you quickly because of it.

  • A strong communicator across styles and audiences. Extremely comfortable with the analysts who will be the day-to-day platform users. Highly credible with portfolio managers, heads of research, and CIOs. Strong writing and in-person skills. Able to flex style for technical and business audiences.

  • Highly collaborative across a broad internal network. The function operates in close partnership with GTM, Product, Engineering, and other 9fin teams. You are energised by cross-functional work, you bring people with you rather than working around them, and you know how to translate what you are learning in the field into inputs that other teams can act on.

  • Outcome-oriented. You measure success by whether clients are actually using the platform differently, not by how many meetings you held or decks you delivered.

 

Why Join 9fin

  • Category leadership. 9fin is the reference platform for debt capital markets data and AI. Buy-side clients use us because there is no comparable alternative.

  • A genuine domain-expert role. You bring credit investing expertise; we back you with the platform, the product team, and the mandate to make it real inside client organisations.

  • Direct influence on the product. Field intelligence from your deployments feeds the product roadmap. What you learn on the ground shapes what 9fin builds next.

  • Series C stage, growing fast. Small enough that your work is visible, large enough to have the platform and customer base ready for real deployment.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Map bank workflows and find the highest-value insertion points. Embed with client teams to document how origination, structuring, syndication, and trading work actually gets done end-to-end. Möchtest du eine Schlüsselrolle in einem der größten und ambitioniertesten Unternehmen Dänemarks übernehmen – in einem eingespielten Integrationsteam, in dem du Verantwortung, Freiheit und echten Einfluss darauf erhältst, wie DLG sein digitales Geschäft in ganz Europa vernetzt?

In der DLG Group IT bringen wir Business und Technologie zusammen. Wir entwerfen, entwickeln und implementieren Integrationen, die Systeme über DLG und unsere europäischen Tochtergesellschaften hinweg nahtlos miteinander verbinden. Wir erweitern unser Team und suchen einen Integration Developer (m/w/d), der leidenschaftlich gerne elegante, effiziente und zukunftssichere Lösungen entwickelt.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

DLG befindet sich mitten in einer spannenden digitalen Transformation. Unsere hybride Integrationsplattform, aufgebaut auf SAP und Microsoft Azure, unterstützt unter anderem ReGen, ein strategisches Transformationsprogramm, in dem Daten, Automatisierung und Innovation Hand in Hand gehen.

Wir entwickeln aktiv unseren Digital Integration Hub weiter und bewegen uns in Richtung einer stärker ereignisgesteuerten Architektur. Als Integration Developer wirst du Teil des Teams, das diese Vision Realität werden lässt – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen, Business-Stakeholdern und Tochtergesellschaften in ganz Europa.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und Technologie und gestaltest mit, wie Daten und Prozesse innerhalb der DLG fließen. Deine Hauptaufgaben umfassen:

- Design, Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End‑Integrationen, die Systeme miteinander verbinden
- Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung des Digital Integration Hub sowie an ereignisgesteuerten Integrationsmustern
- Technischer Sparringspartner für Projekte und Tochtergesellschaften in der gesamten Organisation
- Mitgestaltung und Nutzung von KI‑gestützten Funktionen innerhalb der Integrationslandschaft

Profil

Du arbeitest gerne an der Schnittstelle von Technologie und Business und möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, in dem Integrationen eine zentrale Rolle bei der digitalen Transformation einer internationalen Organisation spielen. In dieser Rolle bringst du sowohl technisches Verständnis als auch eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise mit.

Wir stellen uns vor, dass du Folgendes mitbringst:

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Integrationsentwicklung oder in vergleichbaren Rollen
- Erfahrung mit dem Microsoft‑Azure‑Integrationsstack oder der SAP Integration Suite – und die Motivation, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen
- Sicherheit darin, Geschäftsanforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen
- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Stakeholdern
- Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse, in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG wirst du Teil eines kleinen, starken Integrationsteams, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Professionalität und Einfluss Hand in Hand gehen. Du bist weder ein kleines Zahnrad in einer großen Maschine, noch wirst du mit Verantwortung allein gelassen. Stattdessen arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen zusammen und spielst eine zentrale Rolle dabei, Systeme, Daten und Geschäftsprozesse in einer internationalen Unternehmensgruppe zu verbinden.

Wir bieten dir eine Rolle mit einer engen Verbindung zwischen Ideen und Umsetzung – in einem Umfeld, in dem Neugier, Feedback und Wissensaustausch zum Arbeitsalltag gehören. Konkret kannst du dich auf Folgendes freuen:

- Ein eingespieltes Team engagierter Integrationsspezialisten, das sowohl mit SAP‑ als auch mit Microsoft‑Azure‑Technologien arbeitet
- Breite technologische Einblicke über mehrere ERP‑Plattformen, Geschäftsbereiche und Integrationsmuster hinweg
- Die Möglichkeit, aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung des Digital Integration Hub beizutragen und den Weg hin zu einer stärker ereignisgesteuerten Architektur mitzugestalten
- Arbeitszeiten am Tag, keine Rufbereitschaft und ein gesundes Work‑Life‑Balance‑Umfeld
- Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen sowie attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen, einschließlich betrieblicher Altersvorsorge und weiterer Benefits

Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Mechatroniker/in (m/w/d); Elektroniker/in Automatisierungstechnik (m/w/d); Servicemonteur / Servicetechniker Wasseraufbereitung (m/w/d)

Stellenbeschreibung:
Du möchtest jeden Tag an etwas anderem arbeiten? Von Trinkwasseranlagen bis hin zu industriellen Prozesswasseranlagen bei namhaften Kunden aus der Lebensmittel-, Getränke- und Industriebranche? Du analysierst technische Störungen mit klarem Blick, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und möchtest eigenverantwortlich unterwegs sein?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

RWB Water ist Spezialist für industrielle Wasseraufbereitung und entwickelt, baut sowie betreibt Anlagen für Trinkwasser-, Prozesswasser- und Abwasseranwendungen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Serviceteams suchen wir einen engagierten Servicemonteur / Servicetechniker Wasseraufbereitung (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben

- Dein Arbeitstag beginnt direkt von zu Hause aus. Über das digitale Einsatzsystem erhältst du deine Aufträge und startest eigenständig zu unseren Kunden.
- Zu unseren Kunden gehören Wasserwerke, Krankenhäuser, Brauereien, Lebensmittelproduzenten sowie Industrieunternehmen.
- Durchführung von Wartungs-, Service- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen
- Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen beim Kunden vor Ort
- Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe neuer Anlagen
- Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungen gemäß Wartungsplänen
- Unterstützung bei Umbauten, Optimierungen und kleineren Modifikationen
- Dokumentation der Serviceeinsätze und technischen Arbeiten
- Technische Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden
- Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst im rotierenden System - einmal in 8 Wochen

Das bringst du mit

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, z. B. als Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker, Anlagenmechaniker oder Elektroniker
- Berufserfahrung im technischen Service oder Anlagenbau von Vorteil
- Technisches Verständnis in Mechanik, Pumpentechnik, Rohrleitungsbau oder Elektrotechnik
- Erfahrung im Bereich Wasseraufbereitung oder Verfahrenstechnik ist wünschenswert
- Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Kundenorientiertes Auftreten und Teamfähigkeit
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Sprachkenntnisse - Niederländisch auf mindestens B 2 Niveau
- Reisebereitschaft im regionalen Einsatzgebiet

Das bieten wir dir

- Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem international tätigen Unternehmen
- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
- Intensive Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Modern ausgestattetes Servicefahrzeug
- Attraktive Vergütung inklusive Zuschlägen für Bereitschaftsdienste
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel wie Laptop und Mobiltelefon
- Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
- Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe
- Attraktives Jahresgehalt von 36 T€ bis 60 T€ – entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Über uns

Die RWB Water Gruppe entwickelt nachhaltige Lösungen für industrielle und kommunale Wasseraufbereitung. Als Teil der internationalen METAWATER Group verbinden wir mittelständische Strukturen mit internationaler Technologiekompetenz.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von Teamgeist, technischem Know-how und praxisorientiertem Handeln.

Interesse geweckt?

Die Besetzung dieser Position erfolgt exklusiv über Tjellens Loopbaan Professionals.

Für erste Informationen steht dir                                            

Manfred Wiggering
Senior Interim Recruiter

Telefon: +49 160 9675 6944
E-Mail: manfred.wiggering@tjellens.de

jobs.title: Kok på Center Parcs Nordborg Resort (Koch/Köchin)
jobs.description:
Kok på Center Parcs Nordborg Resort

fastansættelse eller sæsonjob

Fuldtid / Deltid

Siden juni 2025 har vi været en del af Center Parcs Nordborg Resort med mange forskellige gastronomiske koncepter, og vi søger dig som kok! Vi søger et fast medlem til vores team – ikke kun for en sæson.

Leder du efter et job, hvor du kan være med til at forme en positiv virksomhedskultur, spille en afgørende rolle for gæsternes oplevelse og være en del af et spændende eventyr fra starten? Så bliv en del af vores team!

Vi kan tilbyde:

- Attraktiv løn : En løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer og din erfaring
- Spændende udfordringer : Bliv en del af en ny afdeling og vær med til aktivt at forme udviklingen og succesen af vores gastronomiske tilbud.
- Venlig teamatmosfære : Hyggelige kolleger
- Internationalt arbejdsmiljø : En pålidelig international virksomhed og en fast ansættelse eller også for sæsonen – alt efter hvad der passer dig bedst
- Medarbejderrabatter : Få bl.a. rabat på måltider i vores restauranter
- Muligheder for videreuddannelse : Din karriere, din fremtid – muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling på nationalt og internationalt plan

Dine opgaver:

Som kok er du en del af vores køkkenhold og sørger for, at vores gæster hver dag får et gastronomisk tilbud af høj kvalitet og med stor variation.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

- Tilberedning af retter til f.eks. morgenbuffet
- Kreativ tilberedning med både friske råvarer og convenience-produkter
- Planlægning og organisering af indkøb og opbevaring
- Tilberedning af à la carte-menuer

Din profil:

- En afsluttet uddannelse som kok eller tilsvarende erhvervserfaring inden for gastronomi
- Erhvervserfaring, f.eks. fra restaurant, hotel, kantine eller storkøkken, er en fordel
- Kvalitetsbevidsthed, ansvarsfølelse og glæde ved madlavning
- Et køligt hoved – også i stressede situationer
- Teamånd, pålidelighed og en struktureret arbejdsmåde
- Kreativitet og interesse for forskellige køkkenretninger
- Fleksibilitet og villighed til også at arbejde i weekender og på helligdage
- Gode danskkundskaber; engelsk- eller tyskfærdigheder er en fordel

Mere end 24.000 mennesker i 11 lande er allerede en del af Areas-familien. Vi brænder for det, vi laver, elsker rollen som værter og byder vores gæster velkommen med lækker og indbydende mad

Vi ser frem til at lære dig at kende! Ansøg nu via e-mail til: karriere@areas.com eller via online ansøgningsskemaet!

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, handicap, eller etnisk tilhørsforhold.

jobs.title: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): English or French (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)

We are partnering with a fast-growing European company in the e-mobility sector to recruit E-Bike Mechanics for its refurbishment centre in Mechelen.

This role is based in a modern workshop environment, where you will work alongside a team of experienced mechanics restoring a wide variety of electric bikes. The position offers the opportunity to develop your technical skills while working on diverse and increasingly complex mechanical and electrical repairs.

Your Role

- Inspect, service, and repair a wide range of electric bikes across different brands and models
- Follow structured quality control standards to ensure each bike meets high refurbishment requirements
- Diagnose and resolve mechanical and electrical issues, including components such as bearings, motors, and transmission systems
- Apply practical and creative solutions to ongoing technical challenges
- Collaborate closely with other mechanics to ensure efficient workshop operations
- Record and document all work carried out using internal digital tools

Your Qualifications

- At least 1 year of experience as a bicycle mechanic or in a similar mechanical role
- Strong technical skills in bike mechanics
- Interest in e-bikes and willingness to learn electrical components (previous e-bike experience is a plus, not mandatory)
- Hands-on, solution-oriented mindset with attention to detail
- Team player with a proactive and reliable working style

The Offer

- Permanent contract (CDI), full-time – 35 hours/week
- Working hours: Monday to Friday, 08:00 – 15:30
- Modern workshop equipped with high-quality tools and equipment
- Work alongside a team of 25+ experienced mechanics
- Exposure to a wide variety of e-bike models (city, mountain, cargo, speed bikes)
- Transportation cost support
- On-site parking available
- Easily accessible location (car, RER C, bike parking)
- Opportunity to grow within a fast-paced and innovative environment

jobs.title: E-bike Mechanic (m,w,d): French/ English in Paris (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
jobs.description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.
- Advise colleagues and customers on basic e-bike care, safe operation, and battery handling/storage best practices.
- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

jobs.title: Senior E-Bike Mechanic (m,f) (E-Bike-Servicetechniker/in)
jobs.description:
Start: asap

We are partnering with a fast-growing European startup that is building the largest marketplace for refurbished e-bikes globally. Having refurbished over 100,000 e-bikes in just a few years, the company is expanding rapidly and is now looking for a Senior E-Bike Mechanic to join its refurbishment centre in Amsterdam.

In this role, you will work exclusively with e-bikes in a modern workshop environment, restoring a wide range of models to excellent condition and ensuring consistently high quality standards.

Your Role

- Managing the entire refurbishment and repair cycle of e-bikes, from initial inspection and fault diagnosis to spare parts selection and repair execution
- Acting as a technical authority, determining the appropriate scope of repairs based on expertise and quality requirements
- Performing detailed quality controls to ensure all refurbished e-bikes meet high standards before delivery
- Contributing advanced technical knowledge in e-bike hardware and software systems
- Supporting continuous improvement initiatives to optimize repair processes and overall product quality
- Collaborating closely with the workshop team and contributing ideas to improve workflows and efficiency

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as an e-bike mechanic, bicycle mechanic, two-wheel mechanic, mechatronics technician, automotive mechanic, or in a comparable technical field
- Completed vocational training or apprenticeship in a relevant discipline is an advantage; experienced career changers with strong technical expertise are also welcome
- Highly organized, precise, and comfortable working independently
- Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset
- Good communication skills in English and/or Dutch

The Offer

- Work on a wide variety of e-bikes, including city, cargo, mountain, and speed models, across multiple brands and systems
- Modern workshop with state-of-the-art tools, diagnostic equipment, and electric work stands
- Experienced team environment with strong knowledge sharing
- No customer interaction — full focus on technical excellence
- Weekends off, with work scheduled only on weekdays
- Competitive fixed monthly salary
- Performance reviews every six months with clear opportunities for career progression
- Dynamic startup environment with long-term growth and development opportunities

Looking to build long term relationships as a trusted advisor? Do you have a passion to maximize sales opportunities over the long term? You'll deliver amazing customer service and uncover sales opportunities for our technology client's customers. - Bring your passion to negotiate with brand knowledge to close a sale, handle objections and rebuttals during customer interactions

- Bring your curiosity to stay on top of the trends in the technology industry

What You Bring to the Role

- Experience prospecting, developing accounts, negotiating, and closing deals
- Develop partnerships and communicate with high-level decision makers to assess needs
- Some understanding of cloud-based software
- Verbal and written proficiency in both German (minimum B2+/C1 level) and English (minimum B2 level)
- 1+ years demonstrated sales experience
- A solution-oriented mindset and comfortable working to resolve issues before escalating to the next level
- Reside in or able to relocate to the Krakow area

What You Can Expect

- Generous relocation package of 2000 PLN net
- 11000 PLN gross Base salary plus performance-related bonuses opportunities
- MyBenefit - cafeteria
- PPK Plan
- Additional days of annual leave
- Private Luxmed medical care including dental care and eye care plan (glasses reimbursement)
- Multisport Card
- Flexible working hours Monday - Friday and additional days of annual leave
- Partial language course reimbursement program as well as tuition program for sales courses and studies

jobs.title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

jobs.title: ZIMMERMÄNNER/BAUZIMMERER 100% (CH-Deutsch-Schweiz) – per sofort/fortlaufend (Zimmerer/Zimmerin)
jobs.description:

Wir sind eine private Personal- und Arbeitsvermittlung in der Region Stuttgart und suchen für unsere Schweizer Partner/Auftraggeber ständig gute Fachleute aus den Bereichen Bau & Handwerk, u.a. Holzbau, Zimmerei, Schreinerei.

- Ausführung diverser Holzbau-/Innenausbau-/Fassadenarbeiten

jobs.title: Lärare i engelska
jobs.description:
Lekeberg ligger mitt emellan storstadens utbud och landsbygdens idyll!
Vi vill vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare där medarbetarskap och ledarskap präglas av delaktighet och påverkansmöjligheter.  Vi strävar efter att vara en effektiv, hållbar och trygg kommun för våra kommuninvånare och medarbetare.

Positiv utveckling och framtidssatsningar kännetecknar Lekeberg och vi styr mot nya och spännande utmaningar! Vill du vara med på resan? Läs mera om vår kommun på www.lekeberg.se

Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen omfattar förskola, grundskola, anpassad grundskola, fritidshem, gymnasium samt vuxenutbildning. I vår förvaltning arbetar för närvarande drygt 200 medarbetare.

Vi lägger grunden för det livslånga lärandet genom att erbjuda trygg omsorg och stimulerande lärmiljöer. Vi arbetar aktivt med vägledande samspel och utgår från barnens och elevernas förutsättningar och deras personliga förmågor.

Vi arbetar för en hög måluppfyllelse och för att varje elev ska få bästa möjliga förutsättningar för en trygg och lyckad skolgång. Vi erbjuder våra barn och ungdomar en meningsfull fritid genom våra fritidsverksamheter.

Lekebergsskolan 7–9 är en högstadieskola i centrala Fjugesta med cirka 330 elever. Hos oss arbetar vi för att skapa en trygg, inkluderande och utvecklande lärmiljö där alla elever ges möjlighet att lyckas.

Vi tror på betydelsen av goda relationer, tydlighet och höga förväntningar. På skolan finns ett nära samarbete mellan lärare, elevhälsa och skolledning och vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att utveckla undervisningen genom kollegialt lärande och systematiskt kvalitetsarbete.

Övrigt: Vi kräver utdrag ur belastningsregister. Giltig legitimation ska uppvisas om du blir kallad till intervju.

Vi har aktivt valt våra rekryteringskanaler och undanber oss därför direktkontakt med rekryterings-och bemanningsföretag samt annonsförsäljare i samband med denna rekrytering.

1 plats(er).


Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som lärare på Lekebergsskolan 7–9. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 100 procent där undervisningen framför allt kommer att vara i engelska.

Vi är öppna för olika ämneskombinationer och ditt andra undervisningsämne kan därför variera beroende på din behörighet och erfarenhet.

Som lärare hos oss blir du en del av ett arbetslag där ni tillsammans arbetar för elevernas kunskapsutveckling, trygghet och trivsel. Vi värdesätter samarbete och ser det som självklart att vi hjälps åt och tar ett gemensamt ansvar för våra elever.

Arbetsuppgifter

I tjänsten ingår att planera, genomföra och följa upp undervisning i engelska samt ytterligare ämne utifrån din behörighet. Du arbetar aktivt för att skapa en undervisning som är tydlig, strukturerad och tillgänglig för elever med olika behov och förutsättningar.

Mentorskap ingår i tjänsten. Tillsammans med övriga mentorer och kollegor arbetar du för att skapa en trygg och fungerande skoldag för eleverna och har en löpande kontakt med vårdnadshavare.

Du förväntas också bidra till skolans gemensamma utvecklingsarbete och vara en aktiv del av både arbetslaget och skolans kollegiala arbete.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker i första hand dig som är legitimerad lärare med behörighet att undervisa i engelska för årskurs 7–9. Behörighet i ytterligare ämne är meriterande och vi är öppna för olika ämneskombinationer.

Vi söker dig som:

    har ett tydligt ledarskap i klassrummet och förmåga att skapa struktur och studiero
    bygger goda och förtroendefulla relationer med elever
    har höga förväntningar på eleverna och tror på deras förmåga att utvecklas
    är flexibel och lösningsfokuserad
    tycker om att samarbeta och bidra till det gemensamma arbetet på skolan.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av undervisning på högstadiet, men välkomnar även dig som är i början av din lärarkarriär.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Omfattning: 100 %
Anställningsform: Vikariat
Tillträde: 26 oktober 2026
Varaktighet: Till och med december 2027
