jobs.description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Dans le cadre de sa transformation numérique, l'administration judiciaire recrute un développeur full stack pour le service de gestion des projets informatiques. Le service gestion des projets informatique s'organise sur le modèle de la Digital Factory, et comporte plusieurs programmes de digitalisation articulés autour d'équipes Scrum, et un pôle transverse abritant les centres de compétences partagées (architecture d'entreprise, DevOps, change management.) et un laboratoire d'innovation. Au sein de l'Innovation Lab, vous contribuerez à l'identification, l'exploration, au prototypage et à la validation rapide de solutions innovant/antes à forte valeur pour les métiers de la Justice. Vous interviendrez sur des proofs of concept (POC), prototypes et démonstrateurs, avec un objectif clair: expérimenter rapidement, démontrer la valeur métier, préparer l'industrialisation des solutions lorsque les résultats sont concluants. L'Innovation Lab a pour ambition de: Expérimenter des technologies émergentes et leurs usages au service des métiers de la Justice, notamment dans les domaines de l'intelligence artificielle, de l'automatisation, du low-code/no-code et des nouveaux services numériques; Produire des POC et démonstrateurs rapidement industrialisables; Collaborer à l'industrialisation des solutions validées; Connecter l'administration judiciaire à l'écosystème luxembourgeois de l'innovation; Organiser et soutenir des ateliers, hackathons et moments d'échange avec les métiers; Diffuser durablement une culture de l'innovation et de l'expérimentation dans l'administration. Le développeur Innovation Lab pourra intervenir sur des sujets tels que: Intelligence artificielle appliquée (agents, assistants, NLP, classification, recherche augmentée, automatisation intelligente, intégration de services d'IA générative); Développement de prototypes et démonstrateurs s'appuyant sur des technologies émergentes; Outils low-code / no-code; Automatisation de processus; Blockchain / registres distribués; Nouveaux usages numériques, interfaces innovant/antes et expérimentation orientée utilisateur; Méthodes d'innovation collaborative, design participatif, hackathons et innovation ouverte. jobs.title: Maintenance Engineer - Laboratory & Utilities
jobs.description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

As Maintenance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and availability of Alfa Laval's laboratory assets, including test rigs, laboratory equipment, and supporting utility systems. This is a hands-on position where your practical technical expertise will help us strengthen our in-house maintenance capabilities, improve equipment reliability, and reduce downtime.



You will work closely with a highly technical team, supporting daily laboratory operations while also contributing to the development of maintenance routines, procedures, and best practices. With a broad range of equipment and technical challenges, the role offers plenty of variety and the opportunity to see the direct impact of your work on both daily operations and long-term improvements.



Your key responsibilities will include:

    

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on test rigs, laboratory equipment, and utility systems.

    

Troubleshoot equipment failures and perform root cause analysis to identify effective solutions.

    

Support the installation, modification, and commissioning of new and existing laboratory equipment.

    

Plan and document maintenance activities in the CMMS.

    

Improve preventive maintenance routines and contribute to maintenance procedures and best practices.

    

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to increase equipment reliability and availability.

    

Provide technical support to laboratory operations and collaborate with colleagues and external suppliers.

    

Share technical knowledge and contribute to building a proactive maintenance culture within the team.



Who are you

You are a practical and proactive problem solver who enjoys being close to the equipment and figuring out how things work. You use your technical judgement to assess situations, identify root causes, and take ownership of finding effective solutions. You work in a structured and reliable way, while staying open to improving routines and how things are done. At the same time, you are collaborative and communicate clearly, sharing your knowledge and working closely with colleagues to solve problems and keep operations running reliably.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you bring solid practical maintenance experience combined with the technical understanding needed to troubleshoot, maintain, and improve a broad range of equipment. We believe our ideal candidate has:

    

Several years of practical experience in maintenance, troubleshooting, and equipment support, ideally 5 years or more.

    

Hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting industrial equipment.

    

Experience with the installation and modification of technical equipment.

    

Experience from industrial, laboratory, or production environments.

    

Technical education within maintenance, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

    

Basic computer skills and experience using maintenance software and documenting maintenance activities.

    

Ability to communicate technical information clearly.

    

Fluent English, both spoken and written.

    

Swedish is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Network & Infrastructure Engineer (Data Center)
jobs.description:
**About us**

Established in 2006, Nordecon Oy is a multinational OEM company and solution provider specializing in complex end-to-end mobile, server, and custom-built desktop solutions. With nearly two decades of experience and a strong track record in delivering innovative and reliable technology solutions, the company is pivoting towards new opportunities. We are building a modern AI-focused Data Center in Finland designed for high-density GPU computing. Our infrastructure is being built from the ground up, giving you the opportunity to influence every aspect of the network architecture instead of maintaining legacy systems.

We are looking for an experienced Network & Infrastructure Engineer who enjoys designing, building and operating reliable infrastructure.

**What you will do**

You will be responsible for designing, implementing and operating the entire network infrastructure of the data center.

This role combines architecture, implementation and day-to-day technical ownership.

**Network Architecture**

- Design the complete data center network from the ground up.

- Develop scalable and resilient network architecture.

- Design physical fibre topology.

- Design IP addressing strategy.

- Design VLAN and VRF structure.

- Design rack connectivity standards.

- Produce and maintain network documentation.

- Plan future expansion of the infrastructure.


**External Connectivity**

- Design and maintain multi-ISP connectivity.

- Configure and operate BGP.

- Design Internet redundancy and failover.

- Coordinate network connectivity with providers.

- Plan future interconnection between multiple data center locations.


**Internal Network**

- Deploy and maintain switches, routers and firewalls.

- Configure Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking.

- Build management and out-of-band networks.

- Maintain network security.

- Troubleshoot complex networking issues.

- Support high-speed Ethernet environments (25G / 100G / 400G).


**Monitoring & Automation**

- Build network monitoring and alerting.

- Integrate infrastructure into monitoring platforms.

- Automate repetitive operational tasks.

- Maintain accurate documentation.

- Improve operational reliability.


**Infrastructure Integration**

Work closely with electrical and mechanical contractors to integrate infrastructure into a unified monitoring platform.

Examples include:

- UPS

- Generators

- Cooling systems

- Water pumps

- Fire detection systems

- Environmental monitoring

- Building Management System (BMS)


Experience with Modbus, BACnet or similar industrial protocols is an advantage but **not required**.

**Required Skills**

- Strong networking knowledge.

- Experience designing and deploying enterprise or data center networks.

- Cisco, Juniper, Arista or similar platforms.

- TCP/IP.

- BGP.

- OSPF.

- VLAN.

- LACP.

- Linux administration.

- Fibre networking.

- Excellent troubleshooting skills.

- Good documentation practices.

- Ability to independently deliver technical projects.


**Nice to Have**

- EVPN / VXLAN.

- Spine-Leaf architectures.

- Network automation.

- Python.

- Ansible.

- Grafana.

- Prometheus.

- Zabbix.

- GPU cluster networking.

- AI/HPC infrastructure.

- Kubernetes.

- Docker.

- Modbus.

- BACnet.


**What we are looking for**

We are looking for an engineer who enjoys building infrastructure rather than simply maintaining existing environments.

You should be comfortable taking ownership of technical decisions, designing solutions from scratch and implementing them yourself.

You don't need to know everything. We value strong networking fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn.

**What we offer**

- Opportunity to build a modern AI Data Center from the ground up.

- Freedom to influence technical decisions.

- Modern infrastructure.

- High level of technical ownership.

- Long-term career growth.

- Competitive salary based on experience.


**Work Setup**

Location: Riihimäki, Finland (hybrid work possible but on-site presence required at times)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Compensation: Competitive and based on experience. Start: As soon as a suitable candidate is found but the start date is flexible.

**Interested?**

Send your CV, short introduction, and salary request to **applications@nordecon.fi**.

If you have questions, feel free to reach out, were happy to discuss the role in more detail.

**Please note:** Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to respond individually to each applicant. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Klassisk Bistro 65, being the characteristic charming French bistro   https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organisation is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

Experienced chefs, that have years behind a stow and is used to busy and high pressure service. You are able to keep calm, move fast, make nice food & keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

Kitchen help, that have min. 6 months experience working in kitchens, helping out with prep for service as well as helping out as a waiter. You are willing to do a lot of helpful stuff when getting ready for service.

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. 

Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in following the company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company. We expect of you to be responsible and meet on time and not report sick every second day due to hangovers.

You will successfully secure that the team can plan, execute and complete the services to our customers globally.

We offer you the opportunity to develop your project management competence in various ways and the possibility to work with both domestic and global customers in the areas of utility, industry, transportation and infrastructure. In this position, you will have the opportunity to further your career to a senior position, or in sales or general management.

**How youll make an impact**

- Leading the project team with clear guidelines, tasks and milestones, while motivating and providing feedback.

- Managing all aspects of the project to agreed-upon customer requirements and ensuring all technical, safety, quality and financial targets are met.

- Participating in domestic and export service projects of various sizes as a technical engineer.

- Overseeing the development of project plan documents in relation to scope, budget, schedule, and risk management.

- Monitoring each stage of project implementation to ensure best practices in cost control, resource efficiency, risk management and health, safety and the environment.

- Supporting our end-customers with your technical expertise, leading to better user experience, higher customer satisfaction and long-term collaboration.

- Identifying, analyzing and addressing service project risks, with the regular sharing of lessons learned.

- Providing technical support for our sales teams in designing the scope to be offered.

- Coordinating contract negotiation and claims with customers, in collaboration with the Supply Chain and Legal functions.

- Achieving service project deliverables and compliance with contract requirements. Building strong relationships with customers and stakeholders.


**Your background**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

- Project Management certification is considered as a benefit.

- Experience in SAP, MS Office and MS Project.

- Good communication skills in Finnish and in English.

- Willingness to work in a flexible project team.

jobs.title: cater, køkkenassistent ell køkkenmedhjælper
jobs.description:
Klassisk 65, Bistro & Vinbar søger jævnligt kokke og køkkenassistenter til vores franske bistro i Jægergårdsgade, https://www.klassiskbistro.dk/

Vi er et hyggeligt og uformelt spisested med rustikke retter fra det franske landkøkken og en dejlig varm betjening. Vi har et køkken i to plan og plads til ca. 140 gæster. Vi er kendte for vores skønne, smagfulde og ærlige bistromad samt charmerende betjening. Der er drøn på under service og vi har en bistro som oser af stemning og god energi.  

Vi har løbende et kig på ansøgninger og tager nye kolleger ind efter behov, så ansøg bare hos os.

Som fuldtidsansat i køkkenet hos os, er dette opgaven og forventningerne;

  • Du har erfaring med at arbejde i et køkken, du kan svinge en kniv – men du skal ikke nødvendigvis være faglært, du kan være cater, køkkenassistent eller andet

  • Du har både lyst og evne til at lære vores retter at kende, og du sætter en ære i at levere vores gode bistro mad - hver dag

  • Du kan rubbe neglene, vi har travlt og der kører mange retter gennem klappen

  • Ved levering af varer, er du med til at tjekke alt er kommet og er i korrekt stand

  • Gennemgå og udføre to do/prep liste

  • Bestilling af diverse varer ved forskellige leverandører

  • Du forstår hvorfor - og kan gøre ordentligt rent, så det lever op til fødevarestyrelsens krav

  • Udfylde egenkontrol tilfredsstillende

  • Ikke er bleg for at tage telefonen under prep, når gæster ringer ind for at booke bord

  • Villig til at lære koldt og varmt parti under service

  • Kan arbejde og bevæge dig tæt med andre (det er et lille køkken vi har)

  • Kan arbejde og snakke i samme omgang, vi elsker gode historie og gode grin, men vi får også noget for hånden på samme tid

  • Du kan indgå i vores gode, respektfulde og ligetil kommunikation mellem alle kolleger, - såvel kokke, opvaskere, tjenere og ledelse

  • Du forstår vigtigheden af at arbejde i et team, og du gør dit til at gøre dine kolleger gode

Hvem er vi?

  • Du får gode skønne kollegaer

  • Flere nationaliteter under samme tag, og du skal kunne snakke lidt engelsk 

  • Social arbejdsplads med godt kammeratskab

  • Ungt dynamisk team 

  • God for en fyraftensøl, hvis man skulle få lyst - OG vi kan selvfølgelig altid møde til tiden dagen efter

Tatoveringer, spraglede bukser, strithår, intet hår, A,B,C,D skåle, FLIPSKÆG, overskæg, alt for skæg.... du må være lige som du er! - bare du er en arbejdsom, stabil og god kollega, venlig og imødekommende. Vi bruger kun åbent køkken, så også for kokken vil der være herlig meget gæstekontakt. 

Vores team er sunde mennesker, så har du et alkohol problem eller tager du stoffer, så behøver du ikke søge hos os. Du skal kunne passe dine vagter, møde til tiden og ikke melde dig syg i tide og utide pga tømmermænd og lign. 

Vi tilbyder;

En dejlig livfuld arbejdsplads!

Personale ture og andet gøjl, bla.

  • 1 årlig personale tur til fx. Paris / København / Samsø, - betalt af drikkepengene

  • 2 årlige arrangementer, forårs Tivoli tur med turbånd og grillmad hvor du kan invitere din kæreste / ægtefælle samt en vintertur på skøjtebane med mad efterfølgende, hvor du kan invitere venner og familie, betalt af arbejdspladsen

  • Mulighed for at komme med restaurant Smukfisk på Danmarks smukkeste festival

  • Mulighed for at deltage i DM i østersåbning

  • Personalemad til små penge

Arbejdstid, løn og personalerabat;

Alle hos os er timelønnet ansat. Det vil sige, at vagtplanen er lavet til at ramme cirka 160 timer pr. lønperiode for fuldtidsansatte og typisk vil du ramme mellem 150-170 timer

  • Løn efter kvalifikation

  • Fri lørdag og søndag hver 4. Uge

  • Mødetid mellem kl 12.00 og 14.00 - afhængig af dagen på ugen

  • 50% på din regning, op til 4 personer, søndag til torsdag

Vi snakker løbende med potentielle kandidater, så send din ansøgning til info@jobsaka.dk

Skriv tydeligt i mailens emne/overskrift ´kok/køkkenassistent Bistro´ - og vedhæft gerne et vellignende billede af dig selv.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Carpenter Co. is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams, serving a diverse global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide. Our Kouvola facility produces traditional comfort solutions, mattresses (both consumer & medical) and technical foams including rolls and bonded foam applications.

We are looking for an Account Manager to join our Finnish team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing sales and strengthening Carpenter's market position in Finland. You will work closely with existing customers while actively identifying new business opportunities within the manufacturing industry. This position offers the opportunity to take ownership of your customer portfolio, influence commercial strategy, and contribute directly to business growth in a global market-leading company.

What you'll do

- Drive the commercial growth of Carpenter Comfort Solutions in Finland.

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and key stakeholders.

- Identify, pursue, and convert new business opportunities and market segments.

- Develop and execute sales plans aligned with business objectives.

- Monitor market developments, customer needs, and industry trends.

- Lead commercial negotiations, including pricing, contracts, and business terms.

- Support profitability by managing pricing strategies and commercial risks.

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer experience and business performance.

What we're looking for

- At least 5 years of experience selling materials, components, or technical solutions to manufacturing industry customers.

- Experience managing and developing your own customer portfolio.

- A proven track record in acquiring new customers and growing sales.

- Strong commercial acumen and experience negotiating pricing and contracts.

- Experience developing and implementing sales strategies and business plans.

- The ability to identify market trends and translate them into commercial opportunities.

- Fluency in both Finnish and English, written and spoken.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in technical sales.

- Experience in polyurethane, furniture or bedding industry.

- Experience managing distributors, dealers, or key accounts in the Nordic market.

- A background in B2B sales and business development.

Location & Travel

This role requires regular travel within Finland to meet customers, develop business opportunities, and support market growth. Our Finnish team is based in Kouvola, and monthly visits to the office are expected.

Apply Now

To ensure a consistent recruitment process, all applications and CVs must be submitted in English through our recruitment system via [this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/account-manager/ZlEGpp) no later than 7 September 2026. We review and interview candidates throughout the application period, and the position may be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.


Carpenter Engineered Foams Oy

Founded in 1950, Carpenter Co. is the worlds largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. Carpenter also serves a diversified global marketplace with polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials through a network of more than 70 production locations. Our 6,500+ employees across the globe seek to provide the most innovative products and solutions with a focus on enhancing the quality of peoples lives while being a good steward of our resources.

At Carpenter, you'll find a rewarding career in a stable company, diverse experiences and an unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. As part of our team, you'll collaborate with talented and dedicated colleagues whose sense of purpose complements your own.

Phone: 05 78451 Location: Nevantie 2

jobs.title: YHTEISÖVALMENTAJAN SIJAINEN AMMATILLISEEN KOULUTUKSEEN
jobs.description:
Perho Liiketalousopisto on koulutusalojemme työnantajien perustama ammatillinen oppilaitos. Toimimme Helsingissä kolmella hyvin saavutettavalla kampuksella: Malmilla, Töölössä ja Urhea-kampuksella (Mäkelänrinteessä). Perhossa opiskellaan palvelualojen bisnestä, ja meiltä valmistuu taitavia ammattilaisia ravintola-, matkailu- ja luontoalan sekä liiketoiminnan tarpeisiin. Olemme myös urheiluoppilaitos ja tuemme tavoitteellisen urheilun ja opiskelun sujuvaa yhdistämistä. Monipuolisia oppimisympäristöjämme täydentävät mm. digikampuksemme sekä Perhon ravintolat, Green City Farm -kaupunkipelto, Perhon Panimo ja Juustola sekä Helmi Center -liikuntakeskus (www.perho.fi [http://www.perho.fi])

Perho kantaa pitkälle – se on lupauksemme perholaisille opiskelijoille ja työyhteisömme jäsenille! Perhon työyhteisössä on aikaansaava yhdessä tekemisen meininki. Työyhteisömme rakentuu eri alojen asiantuntijoista, jotka kannustavat toisiaan ja joiden kaikkien ääntä kuunnellaan. Perholaiset onnistuvat yhdessä!

Vakinaisen yhteisövalmentajamme toimivapaan myötä haemme nyt yhteisövalmentajan sijaista määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 21.9.-18.12.2026 väliselle ajalle.

Pääset työskentelemään Malmin ja Töölön kampuksillamme Perhon perustutkinto-opiskelijoiden parissa monipuolisissa toimintaympäristöissä. Päätehtävänäsi on aktivoida opiskelijoita liikkumaan, pelaamaan ja viettämään yhteistä aikaa oppituntien ulkopuolella sekä tutustuttamaan heitä yhteisöllisiin tiloihimme ja mahdollisuuksiin kampusympäristöissämme. Opiskelijoita aktivoivat ja ryhmähenkeä lisäävät tapahtumat ovat myös yhteisövalmentajan työpöydällä.

Opiskelijoiden lisäksi pääset työskentelemään tiiviisti opetushenkilöstön ja opiskeluhuoltoryhmän kanssa aktiivisen ja liikkuvan arjen edistämisessä sekä opiskelijoiden hyvinvoinnin tukemisessa.

Me odotamme sinulta

* tehtävään soveltuvaa tutkintoa - esimerkiksi yhteisöpedagogi, sosionomi tai kasvatus- ja ohjausalan perus- tai ammattitutkinto

* kokemusta nuorten kohtaamisesta ja työskentelystä heidän kanssaan

* hyvää yhteistyökykyä ja kokemusta ryhmätoiminnasta

* hyviä suullisia vuorovaikutusvalmiuksia

* aktiivista ja liikunnallista asennetta

* oma-aloitteista, itsenäistä ja innostavaa työotetta, valmiutta ja halua sitoutua perholaisiin arvoihin: rohkea, vastuullinen, palveleva ja innostava. Monikulttuurinen osaaminen katsotaan hakijalle eduksi.

Me tarjoamme sinulle

* monipuolisen ja haastavan tehtävänkuvan

* viihtyisän ja hyvinvointia edistävän työympäristön

* mahdollisuuden omaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen

* Perho Liiketalousopiston ammatillisen koulutuksen kokemuksen ja edelläkävijyyden.

jobs.title: Emission Measurement Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an Emission Measurement Engineer to strengthen the Emissions & Automation team in ourTesting & Validation Test Services. The location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, and the work is carried out at the Sustainable Technology Hub (STH) in Vaskiluoto.

Your role and responsibilities

We operate in the STH Plant, close to the test cells in the Hub and Research Lab. We strive to continuously improve our measurement methods and maintain our equipment in top condition. Youll be working as part of a dedicated team with diverse expertise.

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

* Carry out emission measurements in STH on production engines, test engines, and single-cylinder research engines
* Be part of a team developing new methods for emission measurements and continue the ongoing work of automating recurring emission measurements
* Develop your knowledge and expertise in the emission measurement area in the longer term, to also cover fuel gas analysis, measurement of particulates, and/or other more advanced methods
* Perform maintenance and calibration of the emission measurement equipment



To be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have:

* Relevant technical education (BSc or MSc, or equivalent, in Chemical, Environmental, Automation, or Electrical Engineering)
* Good understanding of technology and product development – knowledge of the Wärtsilä engine product family, systems, and solutions is seen as a benefit
* Strong internal motivation, passion for execution, and drive to get things completed
* Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Good teamwork skills
* Proactive and self-driven approach with a doers attitude
* Good English skills; Finnish and/or Swedish skills are an advantage

Why you and us?

We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.

We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?

We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking to find a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.


Contact & next steps

We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Grabs gesucht
jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Grabs sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Grabs

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Grabs

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). jobs.title: Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)
jobs.description:
Scholz & Friends is the internationally most successful German agency group and is represented in Switzerland through its Zurich office. As a full-service agency, we create orchestrated communication solutions for national and international clients.

For our client UBS Switzerland AG, supporting their LATAM segment across the booking centers in Switzerland and Hamburg, we are currently looking for a

Marketing & Business Support LATAM (100%)

Your role
•    Support the planning, coordination and execution of marketing activities and client events for LATAM markets across booking centers Switzerland and Hamburg.
•    Manage end-to-end event ticketing processes, including requests, allocations, nominations, tool updates, reporting and follow-up activities.
•    Coordinate closely with Market Business Coordinators and stakeholders to ensure accurate guest management, invitation handling and timely execution.
•    Organise and deliver local client events in Zurich and Geneva, including venue sourcing, restaurant bookings, transportation arrangements, event materials, giveaways and on-site support.
•    Support international and flagship events by consolidating nominations, monitoring confirmations, managing deadlines and coordinating with central event teams.
•    Handle operational event administration, including supplier coordination, invoices, contracts, documentation and post-event follow-up.
•    Ensure accurate event tracking and timely reporting for LATAM markets, contributing to KPI dashboards and management reporting.
•    Provide back-up support for digital lead management activities, maintaining data quality, monitoring follow-ups and coordinating with Client Advisors.
•    Contribute to process improvements and help ensure a consistently high-quality client experience across all marketing and event activities.
•    Place of work will be Zurich.

Your profile
•    Commercial apprenticeship, degree in Marketing, Events Management or a comparable qualification.
•    Professional experience in marketing, event management, hospitality, client service or a similar coordination role.
•    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.
•    High level of client and service orientation with a proactive, hands-on approach.
•    Excellent attention to detail and strong operational execution skills.
•    Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and handling ad hoc requests and last-minute changes.
•    Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with internal and external stakeholders.
•    Advanced user of Microsoft Office applications; experience with reporting tools and dashboards is an advantage.
•    Fluency in English is essential; Spanish and/or Portuguese are highly desirable. German would be an advantage.

Are you an upbeat person used to working independently within a team?
Are you a highly organised and service-oriented professional who enjoys creating outstanding client experiences? Do you thrive in a dynamic international environment and enjoy coordinating events, managing operational processes and working with a variety of stakeholders? Then we look forward to meeting you.

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

jobs.title: Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About Syngenta

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s Hiring Team is seeking a Onsite, Team Leader Process Technology New AI (m/f/d) in Münchwilen, Schweiz.

Role purpose:

The role involves leading a team of 1-3 lab technicians in a chemistry lab while being responsible for developing and scaling-up chemical reactions towards manufacturing, including preparation and support of pilot campaigns. The position requires maintaining comprehensive process know-how for all assigned chemical steps. It also demands digital curiosity and confidence, working at the interface of chemistry, data and technology.

Accountabilities:

Ensuring the required HSE standards and good laboratory practices are applied/respected.
Overseeing and defining the experimental program to deliver safe and sustainable chemical processes that are fit for the current development lifecycle stage under guidance of the project lead.
Designing lab experiments and pilot campaigns to generate process understanding and know-how
Maintaining documentation to capture lab results and project requirements as defined by guidance.
Supporting process know-how transfers in agreement with the project lead.
Ensuring close collaboration with project stakeholders.
Supporting the department in specialist roles.
Preparing inputs for cost estimates.
Proposing, supporting, and implementing improvement projects.
Ensuring efficient use of provided resources.
Qualifications
PhD in organic chemistry or chemical engineering, typically with a Post Doc. (or equivalent experience)
Practical experience in organic chemistry.
Fluent English. German and French advantageous.
Good communication skills coupled with the ability to see trends and simplify complex information.
Track record in working within project timelines in a dynamic environment.
Experience in the fields of data science, statistics, modelling, automation or process analytical techniques or in collaborating with experts in these fields.
Basic knowledge of Python, MATLAB, or R or a willingness to learn, is advantageous.
Additional Information
What We Offer

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

We offer a position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
The opportunity to make a difference to process safety, both within Syngenta’s global operations, and in shaping safety legislation and culture worldwide
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)
Please send your complete application with CV, diploma and work certificates (if applicable).

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition.You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. As a member of the Technology Management Team, you will act as a trusted advisor to leaders and employees, helping drive business and people success. You will contribute to the implementation of HR priorities in line with the people strategy, support leaders across the employee lifecycle and take over project work and diverse HR assignments in a dynamic international environment.

Your responsibilities:

Act as strategic HR partner and trusted advisor to leaders across Technology (R&D), Service and selected Corporate Functions.

Advise and support managers on HR practices, processes and policies, including employee relations, performance management, change management and leadership effectiveness.

Partner with leaders on workforce planning, organizational design, talent management, succession planning and capability development.

Support the implementation of annual HR processes, including performance management, salary review, talent review and employee engagement activities.

Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers on recruitment activities for selected roles and support effective job marketing and communication.

Use workforce and people data to identify trends, derive insights and recommend pragmatic actions that support business objectives.

Lead or contribute to HR projects, process improvements and diverse local or global assignments.

Foster an inclusive, engaging and high-performance culture aligned with Accelleron’s values.

Ensure compliant and consistent HR solutions in line with Swiss employment legislation, internal policies and governance requirements.

Your background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Law or a related field.

5+ years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Manager or equivalent HR generalist role in a complex business environment, preferably experience with HR work in management teams.

Experience partnering technical, engineering, R&D, industrial, service or manufacturing populations is highly desirable.

Strong understanding of talent management, organizational development, employee relations and Swiss employment legislation.

Experience with Workday or a similar HR system is preferred.

Proven ability to advise, challenge and influence leaders at different organizational levels.

Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and operational excellence.

Structured, proactive and solution-oriented working style with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in an international matrix environment.

Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.

Flexible working models.

Canteen.

Global parental leave program.

jobs.title: Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Sport Facilities Manager & Activity Coordinator
to join the school from: 01.11.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 28.09.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE
Lead, safeguard and develop Aiglon’s sports and activities provision so that every pupil, staff member and guest enjoys an inclusive, high-quality and safe programme.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Safety & Compliance
Conduct daily facility walk-throughs, logging hazards and initiating corrective action, which includes taking action to fix equipment where possible
Enforce best practice in child safeguarding and health & safety, fully aligned with Swiss regulations and Aiglon policies
Maintain inspection and servicing schedules for all sports equipment; liaise with the Director of Operations for repairs or replacement
Help to manage the bookings of the minibus fleet for the expeditions and sports departments
Ensure that the minibuses are in good order after use
Secure the Sports Centre at the end of the day or open hours (equipment check, lights, alarms, locks)
Programming & User Experience
Produce and publish the weekly Sports Centre and facilities timetable, balancing curriculum lessons, house practices, team training and community bookings. This includes the Padel Court, Alpina Pitch, Ski Lockers along with other sports spaces and facilities
Encourage a broad, lifelong engagement in physical activity by promoting a wide range of sports and wellbeing initiatives
Liaise proactively with the Health Centre, Deputy School Director (Pastoral) and Houseparents regarding students with medical or additional-needs profiles
Communicate clearly and courteously with all users, modelling professional conduct that earns trust from pupils and colleagues
Fitness Suite & Strength-and-Conditioning
Oversee presentation, cleanliness and day-to-day supervision of the Fitness Suite
Assist in the planning and coaching of age-appropriate S&C sessions
Monitor student progress (eg movement screens, jump tests, wellness surveys) and maintain records to inform individualised programmes
Educate students on safe lifting technique, recovery, nutrition and injury prevention; coordinate return-to-play plans with medical/physio staff
Foster a culture of respect for equipment and peers, ensuring correct footwear, clothing and hygiene standards at all times
Activities Co-ordination
Design, oversee and support a high quality and successful activities programme across the school through planning and programming the activity schedule, timings, staffing and resources
Quality assure the activities programme through observations, student, staff and parent surveys and liaison with outside external staff providers
Ensure effective and timely communication of information to students, staff and the wider community
Provide leadership, guidance and support to staff for effective programme planning, scheduling and execution
In collaboration with the Director of Character and the Head of Junior Activities, have a clear overall strategy in line with the schools mission for both the development and participation of our students in activities for enjoyment and lifelong engagement
Create energy and dynamism within activities and manage the day-to-day operation of the programme
Ensure that an effective activities programme exists to develop the leadership of our students
Work with the Director of Character and Educational Systems to ensure that there is an effective schedule of events and activities that fit within the school master calendar
Ensure that all students and parents are aware that activities are a school requirement and to provide the necessary support and guidance on how to use SOCs to make it possible for all students to engage and sign up to activities they are interested in
Work with the Director of Character and Educational Systems to continue to develop the processes and systems of SOCs to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the services delivered
Monitor student involvement and attendance at all activities and contact students and staff regarding student absence
Ensuring ongoing innovation, engagement and development so the students have access to a broad, balanced and constantly evolving programme of activities
Continuously evaluate and improve the programme to ensure it meets and aligns with the interests of the students
Provide opportunities, such as prize giving to showcase excellence or celebrate development and achievements in the wide range of activities and events across the school community
Oversee the purchasing and maintenance of resources, equipment and materials for the programme
Prepare detailed reports on the programme for the School Director in the reports to the Board of Directors
Working with the Director of Character, develop and implement risk management strategies for the programme and ensure all risk assessments are in place and regularly reviewed
Working with the HR department and Director of Character, to ensure that the central register of staff safeguarding checks is up to date and that there is due diligence with checks on external staff providers
Contribute to internal and external written and other communication of news and information about Activities across the school
Working with the Communications and Marketing team, evolve the activities section for the school website and school handbook
Administration
Produce termly participation reports of student engagement and ensure equipment compliance
Contribute to staff CPD by running short workshops on fitness, wellbeing or safe practice
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
To be available for School sporting events such as inter-house and inter-school competitions, Sports day and other major events
Understand and implement all School policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Director of Character Education to assist in the smooth running of the team
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times

The qualifications, experiences and attributes of the post-holder must match the detailed specification below:
A. Education, Qualifications and Languages
Essential
Bachelor’s degree in Sports Science, Exercise Physiology, Sport Facilities Management or related discipline, or equivalent qualifications
Desirable
Accredited Strength & Conditioning certification (eg NSCA‑CSCS, UKSCA, ASCA Level 2 or Swiss equivalent)
Valid First Aid & CPR qualification
Working proficiency in French

B. Experience and Knowledge
Desirable
Minimum 5 years’ professional experience managing multi‑sport facilities, including student and staff supervision
Proven record of coaching S&C programmes for student athletes and teams
Experience working in an international school, university or elite sports academy

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Zumikon – die Eckdaten Ihrer Stelle

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Spitex

**Pensum:** 60–80 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Zumikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Zumikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch seine ruhige, grüne Lage mit guter Verkehrsanbindung zur Stadt Zürich. Die S-Bahn ermöglicht eine zuverlässige und schnelle Anbindung ins Zentrum. Die Region bietet Ihnen eine attraktive Mischung aus ländlichem Charakter und urbaner Nähe, was sie zu einem beliebten Arbeitsort für Pendler macht. Zudem profitieren Sie von stabilen Infrastrukturen und einem hohen Lebensstandard.

### Das packen Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Spitex in Zumikon an

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Rüstzeug für den erfolgreichen Einstieg

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Spitex

Sie arbeiten in der Spitex – Pflege dort, wo Menschen zu Hause sind. Selbstständiges Arbeiten, kurze Wege zum Menschen und viel Eigenverantwortung prägen diesen Alltag. Denn wer zu Hause gepflegt wird, schenkt besonders viel Vertrauen.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Spitex in Zumikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern in der Spitex der Region Zumikon ist anhaltend hoch, da der demografische Wandel einen steigenden Bedarf an ambulanter Pflege mit sich bringt. - Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Spitex in Zumikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**

jobs.title: Trade Compliance Manager Process Industries Switzerland (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Bei ABB unterstützen wir Industrien dabei, effizienter und sauberer zu arbeiten – und jede einzelne Person trägt hier dazu bei. Wir bieten allen Mitarbeitenden die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und die eigene Entwicklung aktiv voranzutreiben. Gemeinsam entstehen Lösungen, auf die alle stolz sein können. Wir suchen engagierte Talente, um gemeinsam die Welt voranzutreiben.
__

In this role, you own the Trade Compliance framework for the Local Business Line (LBL) and are accountable for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving the policies, processes, controls, and governance required to ensure compliant execution of our global business activities. You ensure that all international business transactions, project deliveries, imports, exports, cross-border shipments, and related trade activities are conducted in accordance with ABB's Global Trade Program and applicable customs, export control, sanctions, and origin regulations. As the LBL's Trade Compliance authority, you define and maintain the operational trade compliance framework. You establish clear processes, responsibilities, controls, and escalation mechanisms and ensure effective implementation across all relevant functions. You drive the integration of trade compliance requirements into daily operations and act as the main point for complex compliance matters, regulatory changes, and risk mitigation. You are further responsible for developing, documenting, and maintaining procedures and training programs related to export controls, sanctions, customs, and origin management.


Working model is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop, improve and implement processes of LBL’s customs procedures, origin management, sanction lists screening, dual-use classification and export controls.

Functionally lead trade compliance resources in the LBL.

Lead and oversee Trade Compliance within the Local Business Line (LBL), including the implementation and continuous improvement of ABB’s Trade Compliance Program, internal directives, internal control system, local trade reviews, self-audits, and corrective actions.

Provide expert guidance and training on customs, origin, export control, and sanctions compliance, supporting the LBL, coordinating trade compliance resources and support functions, and maintaining strong alignment with key stakeholders such as CTCO, TCS, PCE, declarants, and logistics teams.

Drive Trade Compliance in day-to-day operations and complex projects, including risk assessments, internal checks, master data and supplier-related compliance requirements, and regular updates to stakeholders on implementation progress and relevant regulatory changes.

Advise and drive all trade compliance matters in LBL’s complex projects to different countries


What we are looking for:

Degree as a Foreign Trade Specialist / Manager or Export Control / Customs Compliance Officer with at least 8 years of experience in a relevant field (Senior Trade Compliance or Legal/Compliance background)

Excellent experience in free trade and preferential origins as well as in trade compliance matters

Solid knowledge in Swiss (GKV), EU and US (EAR) dual-use and sanctions regulations

Experience in an industry with large project businesses in various countries and ability as a people leader and solution-oriented team player

SAP and SAP GTS E4H experiences

Fluent in English, German is a plus

More about us:

Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry- specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment.  Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead, ABB Switzerland.

Die Zukunft wird sauberer und intelligenter durch vielfältige Talente – neugierige, mutige und kreative. Wir schätzen Menschen mit unterschiedlichem persönlichem Hintergrund und Erfahrungen.

Bereit, gemeinsam etwas zu bewegen?

Jetzt direkt bewerben oder weitere Informationen zu ABB und unseren Lösungen weltweit entdecken unter: https://www.abb.com

Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

jobs.title: Ønsker du en meningsfull jobb der du utgjør en reell forskjell i hverdagen til et annet menneske?
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter flere trygge BPA-assistent som skal inngå i en nyetablert ordning i Oslo for en voksen, traumatisert mann med ryggmargsskade, avhengig av rullestol. Han har behov for oppfølging til daglige gjøremål, hjelp til praktiske oppgaver og motivasjon til aktivitet.  Hans livs- og helsesituasjon er kompleks og krevende, med mange plager og utfordringer. Disse kommer til utrykk både psykisk og fysisk.

Som BPA-assistent jobber du tett med én person og blir en viktig støtte i å få hverdagen til å fungere på en god og forutsigbar måte. Rollen innebærer å bidra til forutsigbarhet, frihet, selvstendighet og muligheten til å leve et liv på egne premisser innenfor trygge og profesjonelle rammer for et menneske med en krevende og uforutsigbar livs- og helsesituasjon.

Om stillingen

Vi søker etter flere assistenter som ønsker å være med på å bygge opp en ny BPA-ordning.

  1. Vi søker en miljøterapeut med helsefaglig bakgrunn til en fast deltid, som utgangspunkt 55% stilling, med mulighet for å diskutere en mindre stillingsstørrelse. Som miljøterapeut i ordningen, vil du få det faglige ansvar for å følge opp utfordringer med legepåført medikamentavhengighet og rusproblematikk, som personen ønsker å komme ut av, og forholde deg til omfattende og kompleks somatikk og psykisk uhelse som angst og depresjon.
  2. I tillegg søker vi dyktige, varme og omtenksomme tilkallingsvikarer, uten krav om faglig bakgrunn, men ønske om erfaring med, eller kjennskap til, rusproblematikk.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Til stillingen som miljøterapeut ser vi etter deg som er utdannet sykepleier, vernepleier eller har annen relevant helsefaglig bakgrunn. Miljøfaglig kompetanse i forhold til psykisk uhelse og rusavhengighet er et krav.

Til stillingen som tilkallingsvikar, har vi ingen formelle krav, men søker voksne som kan kjenne seg igjen i øvrig beskrivelse.

Personlig egnethet og kjemi vil bli tillagt stor vekt. Vi ser etter deg som har et omsorgsgen litt utenom det vanlige, som ønsker å bidra til å gjøre et hverdagsliv påvirket av psykisk uhelse og store somatiske utfordringer levelig. Du må kunne sjonglere mellom å motivere til selvhjulpenhet og gi nødvendig avlastning og hjelp ved behov, da form og energinivå svinger. Det er ønskelig at du:

  • er ansvarsfull, pålitelig og moden.
  • er empatisk og varm.
  • er løsningsorientert med et åpent sinn.
  • har evne til å samarbeide tett med andre.
  • er trygg i deg selv og møter mennesker med respekt.
  • trives i en rolle der tillit og stabilitet er viktig.
  • kan jobbe selvstendig innenfor avtalte rammer.
  • har særlig gode norskkunnskaper, da gjensidig forståelse og tydelig kommunikasjon er viktig.

Hva tilbyr vi?

  • En meningsfull rolle, der du får muligheten til å utgjøre en reel forskjell i et annet menneskes liv
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser, hvor du får lønn etter tariff med tilleggsordninger, bedriftshelsetjeneste og rabatter knyttet til ansettelsesforholdet
  • Støtte og trygghet gjennom oppfølging, samtidig som du får muligheten til å være med å forme din egen hverdag
  • Fleksibilitet i arbeidslivet, hvor turnus kan avtales etter behov hvis det er mulig

Grundig oppgavebeskrivelse og opplæring vil bli gitt.

Søknader vurderes og ansettelse skjer fortløpende, så ikke nøl med å sende oss en søknad umiddelbart. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

Om stillingen

Som Global Technology Specialist, BESS bliver du teknisk nøgleperson inden for Battery Energy Storage Systems.

Du får en senior specialistrolle, hvor du skal sikre sikker, stabil og effektiv drift af BESS anlæg. Rollen kræver både dyb teknisk forståelse, praktisk driftserfaring og evnen til at samarbejde på tværs af tekniske og ikke tekniske interessenter.

  • Teknisk drift af BESS anlæg
    Du overvåger og understøtter den daglige drift af BESS systemer og bidrager til stabil og sikker performance.

  • Fejlfinding og performance optimering

  • Sikkerhed, risiko og beredskab
    Du bidrager til risikovurderinger, sikkerhedsprocedurer og beredskabsplaner i samarbejde med relevante funktioner.

  • Leverandørstyring og tekniske krav
    Du samarbejder med leverandører, servicepartnere og interne projektteams samt bidrager til tekniske krav, lessons learned og forbedringer til kommende projekter.

Du får en rolle med stor teknisk indflydelse, hvor du skal kunne tage ejerskab, træffe beslutninger og skabe struktur i et komplekst teknisk miljø.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Relevant teknisk uddannelse
    Du har minimum bachelor niveau inden for engineering, el, energi, automation, power systems eller tilsvarende teknisk område.

  • Dokumenteret BESS erfaring
    Du har praktisk erfaring med Battery Energy Storage Systems og forstår teknologien i en driftsmæssig kontekst.

  • Hands on erfaring med teknisk drift
    Du har arbejdet med drift, fejlfinding, vedligehold og performance optimering af tekniske systemer.

  • Stærk forståelse for sikkerhed og risiko

  • Erfaring med leverandørstyring
    Du kan samarbejde med eksterne servicepartnere, leverandører og tekniske specialister.

  • Erfaring med teknisk projektledelse
    Du kan planlægge, prioritere og følge op på tekniske opgaver på tværs af interessenter.

  • Flydende engelsk
    Du kommunikerer professionelt på engelsk i både skrift og tale. Dansk er en fordel.

Som person er du teknisk stærk, selvstændig og beslutningsdygtig. Du arbejder struktureret, er vedholdende i fejlfinding og kan kommunikere klart med både teknikere, ledelse og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Arbejdssted og praktiske forhold

Det primære arbejdssted er i Region Nordjylland.

Rollen har et globalt teknisk ansvar og kan omfatte remote support samt onsite aktiviteter efter behov.

Deltagelse i vagtordning kan forekomme.

Ansættelsen kan være betinget af sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En senior specialistrolle med globalt ansvar
    Du får mulighed for at tage teknisk ejerskab for BESS drift på tværs af sites.

  • Arbejde med fremtidens energiteknologi
    Du bliver en del af et teknisk miljø, hvor batterilagring, driftssikkerhed og energioptimering er i centrum.

  • Stor faglig indflydelse
    Du får mulighed for at påvirke tekniske standarder, driftsprocesser og krav til kommende projekter.

  • Samarbejde på tværs af organisationen
    Du arbejder tæt sammen med tekniske teams, leverandører, servicepartnere, QHSE og projektorganisationen.

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer

Hurtigst muligt

Rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement au Directeur de site, vous mettez en oeuvre les actions de maintenance nécessaires à la réalisation des objectifs de performance du site en déployant la stratégie de l'entreprise dans le respect des valeurs du Groupe et de ses spécificités régionales.
Dans cette structure industrielle moderne, exigeante, visant l'excellence industrielle avec un environnement de santé et sécurité optimal, voici un aperçu « non exhaustif » de vos activités :
En support de l'atelier de production - impression, façonnage et montage, vous :

- Assurez la maintenance et le dépannage courant des organes mécaniques, pneumatiques, hydrauliques, électriques et automatismes ; Recherches de pannes, remplacements d'éléments, remises en état, mécanique industrielle.
- Réalisez les maintenances planifiées et effectuez des contrôles réglementaires ;
- Améliorez la performance des équipements de production et notamment la performance énergétique ;
- Proposez des améliorations du matériel - fiabilité, productivité ;

- Gérez la documentation technique et les pièces détachées, approvisionnez les stocks de consommables ;
- Ponctuellement auprès de nos clients locaux, vous intervenez sur des machines similaires aux nôtres mises à leur disposition.

Pour l'ensemble du site, vous :

- Pilotez des prestataires de tous corps de métiers : fournisseurs de machines, intervenant en maintenance ou travaux neuf, entretien du parc chariot élévateurs, sécurité incendie et bâtiment ;

- Êtes le garant de la sécurité de vos chantiers et des interventions externes dans le respect des protocoles de consignation et de sécurisation du Groupe - plans de prévention, permis feu, travail en hauteur?



Profil recherché :

De formation technique de niveau Bac à Bac+2 en Maintenance industrielle, Électrotechnique ou équivalent, vous justifiez idéalement d'une expérience professionnelle significative en maintenance industrielle.
Une expérience des services généraux constituerait un véritable atout.
Vous avez évolué à des fonctions de Coordinateur de maintenance, Gestionnaire de maintenance, Technicien de maintenance ou Électromécanicien expérimenté, vous ayant permis de développer une solide vision opérationnelle des activités de maintenance et de fiabilisation des équipements industriels.
Vous disposez de solides compétences techniques en mécanique, électromécanique, hydraulique et pneumatique, ainsi que d'une bonne maîtrise des méthodes et processus de maintenance. À l'aise avec les outils informatiques, vous utilisez quotidiennement une GMAO et savez assurer le suivi des interventions, piloter des entreprises sous-traitantes et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la performance des installations.

Votre autonomie et votre sens du service vous permettent d'intervenir efficacement auprès des équipes de production tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence en matière de sécurité, de qualité...

Zanaka Solutions RH recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) de crèche diplômé(e) Éducateur(trice) de Enfants (EJE) pour assurer la direction d'une crèche municipale de 26 berceaux située à Vétraz-Monthoux (74), dans le cadre d'un CDD de remplacement de congé maternité à pourvoir du 24/08/2026 au 30/11/2026.

Vous rejoindrez une commune dynamique de Haute-Savoie, engagée dans une politique petite enfance de proximité, au sein d'un service municipal accueillant les enfants et les familles dans un cadre bienveillant et adapté aux besoins du  enfant.
Le poste
Sous l'autorité de la Responsable du service Petite Enfance et dans le respect des orientations de la collectivité, vous assurez la direction opérationnelle, pédagogique et administrative de la structure.
Manager et accompagner l'équipe :

- Encadrer, animer et fédérer l'équipe pluridisciplinaire de la crèche ;
- Organiser le fonctionnement quotidien de la structure et garantir la continuité d'accueil des enfants ;
- Accompagner les professionnels dans leurs pratiques et soutenir la dynamique d'équipe ;
- Gérer les plannings, congés, absences et besoins en remplacement en lien avec les règles de la collectivité ;
- Participer à l'accueil et à l'intégration des nouveaux professionnels ;
- Réaliser les entretiens professionnels et contribuer au développement des compétences de l'équipe.

Piloter le projet pédagogique :

- Faire vivre le projet pédagogique de la structure en cohérence avec les orientations municipales ;
- Garantir la qualité de l'accueil proposé aux enfants et aux familles ;
- Accompagner l'équipe dans une démarche de réflexion autour des pratiques professionnelles ;
- Veiller au respect du rythme, des besoins et du développement de chaque enfant ;
- Mettre en oeuvre des actions favorisant l'éveil, l'autonomie et le bien-être des enfants.

Garantir la qualité d'accueil et la sécurité des enfants :

- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de réglementation applicables aux établissements d'accueil du  enfant ;
- Garantir la mise en oeuvre des protocoles sanitaires et médicaux ;
- Participer à l'accompagnement des enfants présentant des besoins spécifiques ou en situation de handicap ;
- Assurer le lien avec le Référent Santé Accueil Inclusif (RSAI) et les professionnels partenaires.

Accueillir et accompagner les familles :

- Organiser l'accueil et l'adaptation des nouveaux enfants ;
- Développer une relation de confiance avec les familles ;
- Assurer un accompagnement individualisé en tenant compte des besoins de chaque enfant ;
- Gérer les situations particulières en lien avec les familles et les partenaires.

Assurer la gestion administrative de la structure :

- Participer au suivi administratif quotidien de la crèche ;
- Garantir la bonne tenue des dossiers des enfants ;
- Assurer le suivi des présences et des éléments nécessaires au fonctionnement de la structure ;
- Participer au suivi d'activité et aux échanges avec la collectivité.

Conditions d'emploi

- CDD de remplacement congé maternité du 24 août 2026 au 30 novembre 2026 possiblement reconductible ;
- Poste à temps plein 36h hebdomadaires ;
- Amplitude horaire de la crèche : du lundi au vendredi de 07h30 à 18h30
- Structure municipale de 26 berceaux ;
- Statut relevant de la Fonction Publique Territoriale ;
- Rémunération selon diplôme et ancienneté (grille FPT) entre 2100euros et 2300euros net / mois + 10% indemnités de fin de mission + 10% indemnités de congés payés ;
- Poste basé à Vétraz-Monthoux (74).

Processus de recrutement

- Votre candidature sera analysée sous 2 jours ouvrés par nos chargés de recrutement ;
- Si votre profil correspond aux attentes du poste, un entretien avec Sylvie, notre consultante petite enfance (ancienne directrice de crèche et Éducatrice de Enfants) vous sera proposé ;
- Si votre candidature est validée, vous rencontrerez ensuite la Direction de la Petite Enfance de la commune.

=> Durée globale estimée du processus de recrutement : 2 semaines à partir de l'envoi de votre CV.


Profil recherché :

Diplômes requis

- Diplôme d'État d'Éducateur(trice) de Enfants (EJE) obligatoire ;
- Une expérience significative en direction ou coordination d'équipe en structure Petite Enfance est indispensable.

Compétences et expérience

- Expérience en direction de crèche ou en fonction de coordination au sein d'un établissement d'accueil du  enfant ;
- Bonne connai...
