jobs.title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

jobs.title: Husmor till Lemland-Lumparlands församling
jobs.description:
**Vill du skapa trivsel, gemenskap och goda möten?** Lemland-Lumparlands församling söker en engagerad och serviceinriktad **husmor** som vill vara med och skapa välkomnande och trivsamma miljöer för församlingens medlemmar, personal och besökare.

Som husmor har du en viktig roll i församlingens vardag. Du ser vad som behöver göras, tar ansvar för helheten och bidrar till att våra lokaler fungerar väl och känns välkomnande.

**Arbetsuppgifter**

Arbetet är varierande och omfattar bland annat:

- ansvar för ordning, trivsel och praktisk skötsel av församlingens lokaler

- förberedelser inför, minnesstunder, möten och andra församlingsarrangemang i församlingshemmet

- dukning och servering samt enklare matlagning och bakning inför församlingens aktiviteter

- ansvar för inköp och hantering av livsmedel och andra förnödenheter som tillhör ansvarsområdet

- städning och löpande tillsyn av församlingshemmets kök och gemensamma utrymmen

- ansvar för att kök och serveringsutrymmen fungerar på ett hygieniskt och ändamålsenligt sätt

- samarbete med präster, församlingsanställda, frivilliga och andra som använder församlingens lokaler

- vid behov andra praktiska uppgifter som hör till församlingsverksamheten.


Arbetet innebär också att vara en del av församlingens värdskap. Du möter människor i många olika situationer och behöver därför kunna bemöta både församlingsmedlemmar och besökare på ett vänligt, respektfullt och professionellt sätt.

**Vi söker dig som**

- är serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande och noggrann

- tycker om att arbeta med människor

- har god organisationsförmåga och kan arbeta självständigt

- har blick för vad som behöver göras och tar egna initiativ

- trivs med ett varierande arbete där arbetsuppgifterna kan växla från dag till dag

- har god samarbetsförmåga och ett positivt förhållningssätt

- har erfarenhet av köksarbete, servering, städning eller motsvarande praktiska arbetsuppgifter.


Svenska är ett krav för befattningen, i enlighet med församlingens språkstadga. Du behöver ha mycket god muntlig svenska och kunna kommunicera tydligt och begripligt med människor i olika situationer. Eftersom arbetet innebär omfattande kontakt med församlingsmedlemmar och besökare är tydligt tal och god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska en förutsättning för att kunna utföra arbetet.

Utbildning inom restaurang, livsmedelshantering, lokalvård eller annan för befattningen relevant utbildning är meriterande, liksom erfarenhet av arbete inom församling eller annan föreningsverksamhet.

Vi fäster stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

**Vi erbjuder**

Hos oss får du ett omväxlande och meningsfullt arbete där du får vara med och skapa goda möten och en välkomnande miljö i församlingen.

Du blir en del av ett engagerat arbetslag och får arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra.

**Tjänsten:** deltid, 50 %

**Tillträde:** 1 november eller enligt överenskommelse

**Arbetsplats:** Birgittagården

**Lön:** enligt kollektivavtal

**Ansökan**

Skicka din ansökan, CV och eventuella arbetsintyg till lemland-lumparland@evl.fi senast **8.9.2026**.

Frågor om befattningen besvaras av ekonomichef Maria Ek, maria.ek@evl.fi.

**Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!**

jobs.description:

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Pieksämäelle. Käynnit arkisin 3 kertaa viikossa.

Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Stark Sønderborg søger Lagermedarbejder
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at sikre at vores kunder altid får den bedste service, når de henvender sig på lageret? Vil du være en del af et stærkt fællesskab med gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar? Hos STARK Sønderborg søger vi en engageret Lagermedarbejder, der vil være med til at forme både sin egen og STARKs fremtid som Danmarks førende distributør af byggematerialer.


Din rolle som Lagermedarbejder i STARK
Du bliver en del af lageret i STARK Sønderborg, hvor vi målrettet arbejder med lagerstyring og for at give vores kunder den bedste service. Som STARKs nye Lagermedarbejder vil du få en vigtig rolle i at servicere kunderne og håndtere både ind- og udgående varer i samarbejde med resten af teamet. Det betyder at du:

  • Er ansvarlig for varemodtagelse og -registrering.

  • Sikrer et altid salgsklart lager, hvilket inkluderer vareopfyldning, trimning, prisskiltning på hyldeforkanter samt oprydning og orden.  

  • Arbejder med ordrehåndtering, herunder pluk og pak, emballering og læsning på lastvogn.

  • Tager del i at sikre at lageret altid er et sikkert sted at færdes – både for medarbejdere og kunder.

  • Indgår i et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på lageret, for at sikre optimal koordinering og effektiv planlægning af varehåndtering og ordrebehandling.  

  • Med fordel har truckcertifikat og kørekort B.


Vores nye Lagermedarbejder
Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som lagermedarbejder er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er effektiv i planlægning og evner at navigere efter fakta og se de små detaljer.

  • Er stabil og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være faglært og ufaglært inden for lagerlogistik eller med anden relevant uddannelse. Selvom produktkendskab og brancheerfaring kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med lagerhåndtering, kundeservice og at blive en del af STARK holdet.
 

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer.

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Sønderborg via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Sønderborg som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef Mike lentfer på telefon +45 60 43 71 69

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

jobs.description:
Vuonna -76 syntyneelle liikuntarajoitteiselle pariskunnalle haetaan avustajaa, sijaisuus kestää ainakin syyskuun loppuun saakka. Työaika on noin klo 8.30-16, enintään kolmena arkipäivänä. Haetaan ennen kaikkea luotettavaa ja työhönsä sitoutuvaa, rehellistä naishenkilöä.

Toinen heistä käyttää liikkumisen apuvälineenä pyörätuolia sekä sähköpyörätuolia, turneri on tarvittaessa käytössä siirroissa. Toinen on pienikokoinen ja hän siirtyy itse, mutta nostaa pitää tarvittaessa. Työhön kuuluu myös avustaminen kodin ulkopuolella asioinneissa ja harrastuksissa. Joskus voi tulla pienimuotoisia matkoja Helsinkiin tai Tampereelle. Työ ei sovellu eläinallergikoille koska pariskunnalla on kotona myös kolme lemmikkikania, joiden hoidossa avustajan tulee tarvittaessa myös auttaa.

Työsuhteessa noudatetaan työsopimuslain mukaista koeaikaa. Tuntipalkka on B1 -palkkaryhmän mukainen 13,73€ - 15,14€, mahdollisista kokemuslisistä riippuen, työaikakorvaukset HetaTESin mukaisesti. Työnantaja on Heta -liiton jäsen.

Stilling: Bartender
Ansettelse: Heltid / deltid

Oppstart: Etter avtale
Arbeidssted: Bergen

Søknad

Send oss din CV sammen med en kort presentasjon av deg selv, din erfaring og hvorfor du ønsker å bli en del av teamet vårt.

Vi søker en bartender som kombinerer faglig dyktighet, personlighet og ekte gjestfrihet – og som trives med å lage gode drinker samtidig som hver eneste gjest føler seg velkommen.

BARTENDER

English

Are you passionate about hospitality, great drinks and creating memorable guest experiences?

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Bartender to join our team in Bergen. You will be an important part of the restaurant and contribute to creating a professional, energetic and welcoming atmosphere for our guests.

We are looking for someone who takes pride in their profession, enjoys working in a busy environment and understands that great hospitality is about much more than simply serving drinks.

Key responsibilities

  • Prepare and serve cocktails, wine, beer, spirits and non-alcoholic beverages

  • Provide professional, friendly and attentive service to all guests

  • Maintain high standards of quality, presentation and consistency

  • Follow established cocktail recipes, serving standards and bar routines

  • Have good knowledge of the beverage menu and actively recommend products to guests

  • Contribute actively to sales and the overall guest experience

  • Prepare the bar before service and ensure efficient closing routines

  • Maintain cleanliness, organization and hygiene in the bar throughout the shift

  • Refill and organize products, glassware and equipment

  • Assist with stock control and inventory when required

  • Minimize waste and handle products responsibly

  • Follow routines for cash handling and payments

  • Follow Norwegian alcohol regulations and responsible serving requirements

  • Follow HSE requirements and the restaurant's internal procedures

  • Work closely with the Bar Manager, Restaurant Manager and the rest of the FOH team

  • Contribute to a positive, professional and respectful working environment

We are looking for someone who

  • Has previous experience as a bartender, preferably from a busy restaurant, bar or hotel

  • Has good knowledge of cocktails, spirits, wine and beer

  • Is passionate about hospitality and excellent service

  • Is confident communicating with guests

  • Is positive, energetic and solution-oriented

  • Works efficiently and remains professional during busy service

  • Is reliable, punctual and takes responsibility for their work

  • Has high standards for cleanliness, organization and presentation

  • Enjoys working as part of a team

  • Is commercially aware and comfortable recommending and selling beverages

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and understands that the position includes daytime, evening, weekend and late-night shifts

  • Communicates well in English; Scandinavian language skills are an advantage

What we offer

  • A professional and international working environment

  • Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications

  • Training and opportunities to develop your beverage and service knowledge

  • Strong opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A social and dynamic workplace

  • The opportunity to work with quality products and develop your skills within cocktails, wine and hospitality

  • For the right candidate, there are excellent career opportunities and the possibility to progress into positions with greater responsibility and management roles within the company

  • We believe in developing our people internally and giving talented and motivated employees the opportunity to grow within the organisation

Position: Bartender
Employment: Full-time / Part-time
Working hours: Daytime, evenings, weekends and late nights according to schedule
Start date: By agreement
Location: Bergen

Application

Please send us your CV together with a short introduction about yourself, your experience and why you would like to join our team.

We are looking for a bartender who combines professional skills, personality and genuine hospitality – someone who enjoys creating great drinks while making every guest feel welcome.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Dilla Holding AS er et holdingselskap som eies og drives av brødrene Daljinder, Kawal og Jas Kahlon. Selskapet ble stiftet i 1995, og driver hovedsakelig med restaurantvirksomhet.

Med mange års erfaring i bransjen driver vi nå restauranter og barer i Oslo, Fredrikstad og Bergen.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Molecular Immunology
jobs.description:
About the position

Applications are invited for a 3 year position in a Research Fellowship as PhD candidate in molecular immunology to be based at the Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo, Norway. The research fellow must take part in the Faculty of Medicine's approved PhD program and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree.


More about the position

The fellowship period is 3 years and devoted to carrying out a project on the topic: “Modulation of adaptive immunity: Molecular drivers of T cell exhaustion”.

The work will consist of experiments to explore how cytosolic adapter molecules, particularly the adapter molecule SH2D2A, regulate resting as well as activated and experienced T cells, and how this relates to T cell exhaustion. The candidate will explore how cytosolic adapters modulate the phosphoproteome of T cells, using high end mass spectrometry approaches, as well as immunological and genetic techniques. 

The research fellow must take part in the faculty’s approved PhD program and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period. The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Why choose this PhD programme? - Faculty of Medicine

The applicant must, in collaboration with their supervisor, within 3 months after employment, have worked out a complete project description to be attached to the application for admission to the doctoral program. 

For more information, please see our website https://www.med.uio.no/english/research/phd/index.html

Starting date: as soon as possible.


Qualifications

The Faculty of Medicine has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this and will be expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in experimental life sciences (e.g. biology, chemistry, medicine) or similar subjects
  • Relevant, hands-on experience with mass spectrometry techniques, as well as immunological research.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Competence in immunologically relevant techniques such as flow cytometry, isolation of T-cells, assays for analysing T cell activation, immunoprecipitation and immunoblotting. 
  • Experience with gene technology methods such as PCR, DNA isolation, gene cloning, sequence analysis, mutagenesis.
  • Experience with proteomics techniques such as mass spectrometry, production of recombinant proteins.
  • Experience with work with experimental animals (mice), including FELASA C approval.
     

Language requirments

Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: 
How to apply for admission to the PhD programme - Faculty of Medicine
 

Grade requirements
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

All candidates will have to undergo a check versus national export, sanctions and security regulations. Candidates may be excluded based on these checks. Primary checkpoints are the Export Control regulation, the Sanctions regulation, and the national security regulation.


Personal skills
  • Strong motivation
  • Good problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and as an integrated member of a team
  • Good communication skills

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 to 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications). It is a requirement that the first paragraph of the CV contains confirmation that the candidate has the required qualifications specified for the position. 
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.
  • When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.


General information

When evaluating the application, emphasis will be given to the applicant’s academic and personal prerequisites to carry out the project. The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to postdoctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Basic Medical Sciences overall objective is to promote basic medical knowledge in order to understand normal processes, provide insight into mechanisms that cause illness, and promote good health. The Institute is responsible for teaching in basic medical sciences for the programmes of professional study in medicine and the Master's programme in clinical nutrition. The Institute has more than 300 employees and is located in Domus Medica.

jobs.title: Mechanical Lead - Data centres
jobs.description:
Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are intensifying our focus on data centres and strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure.

We are therefore looking for a Mechanical Lead to join us on this journey, becoming an integral part of our growing organisation and helping evolve our data centre environment through your expertise in complex projects.

Be part of building COWI’s data centre environment.

Data centres are a strategic growth area at COWI. As we scale our presence in this market, we are enhancing our multidisciplinary capabilities and working closely with clients to develop reliable, efficient and sustainable data centre solutions. In this role, you will engage closely with clients, colleagues and partners to develop and deliver data centre projects from early concept through design and implementation.

As Mechanical Lead, you will bring your expertise in mechanical systems into multidisciplinary teams, helping translate customer needs into robust and future-ready solutions. You will be part of a professional environment experiencing rapid growth and strong strategic focus within COWI, with opportunities to deepen your expertise, grow alongside the organisation, and play an active role in shaping our approach to data centre projects and customer collaboration.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

    Contribute to the design and delivery of data centre projects, ensuring high technical quality within your discipline.
    Engage in dialogue with customers to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
    Lead and contribute to data centre projects, ensuring coordination across multidisciplinary teams.
    Support project development from early concept stages through design, tender and construction.
    Collaborate with colleagues across engineering, architecture, sustainability and environmental advisory.

Examples of discipline-specific responsibilities may include:

    Lead mechanical design and advisory for data centre facilities.
    Act as mechanical lead within projects, ensuring technical quality and coordination.
    Contribute to detailed technical dialogue with clients and project stakeholders.
    Support project development from concept to detailed design.
    Contribute to innovative and sustainable data centre solutions.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

    A relevant educational background in engineering.
    Experience working with design of data centres, engineering consultancy, technical advisory or complex infrastructure projects.
    Experience from data centre projects or other large-scale mission critical projects.
    Professional proficiency in English.

Additional role-specific qualifications may include:

    Experience with mechanical systems for data centres.
    Experience working with large-scale infrastructure or industrial facilities.
    Experience leading technical teams or complex engineering projects.

Work location

The role can be based in any of our offices across Scandinavia. This includes offices in:

Norway – Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger, Oslo and Fredrikstad

Sweden – Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö

Denmark – Copenhagen, Kongens Lyngby, Vejle, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg

We work in international and multidisciplinary teams, and many of our projects are delivered across offices and borders.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com and www.arkitema.com where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

Tule Kontukodin asukkaille ohjaajaksi ja meille työkaveriksi!

Etsimme lähihoitajia ja lähihoitajaopiskelijoita eri pituisiin sijaisuuksiin Kontukodeille, ympärivuorokautisen ikäihmisten palveluasumisen Kontu Satamaan, Kontu Toukolaan ja Kontu Pyynikille, sekä yhteisöllisen palveluasumisen Kontu Hopeakallioon.

Mikäli sinulla on lähihoitajan tutkinto, tartuntatautilain mukainen rokotussuoja, sekä hygieniapassi ja olet kiinnostunut tehtävästä lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus ja CV rekry@kontukoti.fi 26.8.26 mennessä. Yhteisössämme uusia asukkaiden tarinoita kirjoitetaan yhdessä tervetuloa osaksi Konnun väkeä!

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Hyvin toimivan, inhimillisen toimintamallin, joka tuottaa hyviä kokemuksia.

- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan (lähihoitaja G20).

Mer enn bilutleie

Som kombinert utleierepresentant er du den første personen våre kunder møter. Du er med på å forme inntrykket av Sixt og skape kundeopplevelser som kjennetegnes av kvalitet, tilgjengelighet og premium service.

Rollen kombinerer kundebehandling, salg, logistikk og klargjøring. Du vil jobbe tett på både kunder og bilflåte, og være en viktig del av teamet som sørger for at stasjonen leverer på de høye forventningene kundene har til Sixt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer dem, alltid med et mål om å overgå kundens forventninger. Arbeidsoppgaver • Klargjøring og vask av utleiebiler i henhold til våre kvalitetsstandarder • Oversikt og kontroll på skader og service • Skifte dekk ved dekk omlegg • Yte premium kundeservice i alle situasjoner • Presentasjon og salg av våre produkter og tjenester • Håndtere telefon og e-posthenvendelser • Organisere daglige reservasjoner i forhold til tilgjengelig bilflåte • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid • Håndtering av tilleggsutstyr som barneseter, skistativ og annet ekstrautstyr Hvem er du? Du trives med mennesker, liker høyt tempo og motiveres av å levere kvalitet i alt du gjør. Du tar initiativ, ser løsninger og forstår betydningen av både de små detaljene og den helhetlige kundeopplevelsen. Vi ser gjerne at du har: • Førerkort klasse B • Plettfri vandel • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter • Gode salgsferdigheter • Evne til å arbeide raskt og nøyaktig, også i en hektisk hverdag • Stor arbeidskapasitet og vilje til å ta i et tak når det trengs • Strukturert arbeidsstil og evne til å håndtere logistikk i et miljø med høyt tempo • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig • Grunnleggende datakunnskaper, gjerne erfaring med Microsoft Office Hvorfor velge Sixt? Hos Sixt blir du en del av et internasjonalt premiummerke med høye ambisjoner. Du får en variert arbeidshverdag, dyktige kolleger som jobber sammen for å levere premium kundeopplevelser hver dag. Vi tilbyr: • En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag • Et sosialt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø • Opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter • Verdifull erfaring fra en internasjonal premium-merkevare • Muligheter for videre karriereutvikling internt • Gode karrieremuligheter for den rette kandidaten

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

jobs.title: Automekaanikko / ajoneuvoasentaja
jobs.description:
ALL Motors Oy hakee automekaanikkoja / ajoneuvoasentajia **Helsingin ja Nummelan toimipisteisiin**.

Etsimme motivoituneita, oma-aloitteisia ja vastuullisia asentajia henkilö- ja pakettiautojen monipuolisiin huolto- ja korjaustöihin.

**Tarjolla on myös vaativia moottori- ja korjaustöitä – työ ei rajoitu pelkkiin määräaikaishuoltoihin.**

Erityisesti arvostamme kokemusta moottorien korjauksista, jakopäätöistä ja muista vaativammista mekaanisista töistä. Moottoriosaaminen ei kuitenkaan ole välttämätön edellytys – haemme myös hyvää yleismekaanikkoa, jolla on käytännön osaamista ja halua kehittyä työssään.

Tehtävässä pärjäät parhaiten, jos sinulla on:

- käytännön kokemusta autojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä

- kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti

- huolellinen ja luotettava työote

- B-ajokortti


Autoalan koulutus, työkokemus, sähkö- ja hybridiautojen tuntemus sekä **venäjän kielen taito** katsotaan eduksi.

Tarjoamme kokoaikaisen työn, monipuoliset työtehtävät, hyvin varustellun korjaamoympäristön sekä palkkauksen osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan.

Työpaikka sijaitsee **Helsingissä tai Nummelassa**. Kerro hakemuksessasi, kumpi toimipiste kiinnostaa sinua ensisijaisesti.

Lähetä lyhyt hakemus tai CV ja kerro aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi, osaamisestasi, palkkatoiveestasi sekä siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa.

jobs.title: Digital Content & Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Paiblock is a Fintech company that provides secure access to emerging asset classes to qualified investors, and global crypto payment processing solutions to e-commerce

We are looking for a Content & Creative Lead to join our Copenhagen team. In this role, you will take ownership of our visual content production and bring it to life across our site and channels. You will be responsible for our visual look and feel - setting direction for Paiblock and defining how content shows up everywhere our customers meet us.

This is a role for someone who combines a strong marketing understanding with hands-on content execution. You'll own visual content across our website and channels - the standard, the quality, and making sure we set and keep direction. Using the newest AI tools, you'll produce great content at scale while building automated creative workflows.

The position is full-time and based at Paiblock’s Copenhagen Office in Denmark, where you'll be part of a fast-paced, ambitious environment with a strong commercial focus. You'll also have people responsibility, managing subcontractors who support content production.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Content & Creative Production Manager, you will own content production end-to-end - from setting creative direction to getting content live. You’ll take part in defining the visual bar for Paiblock and make sure everything we launch reflects it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Taking ownership of overall content production and getting content live across our site and channels - email, socials, creative ads, etc.

  • Using the newest AI tools to execute and produce content at scale

  • Owning the delivery of content packages for new products

  • Setting visual and direction for Paiblock

  • Defining how we use our content on our site

  • Building and setting up automated creative workflows

  • Managing and coordinating subcontractors who support content production

  • Pushing our site and channels to the next level in look and feel

  • And so much more

The Ideal Profile

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-driven and knows all about the newest AI content production tools, with a background in content, creative, or marketing roles, preferably within blockchain or digital lifestyle company.

We imagine that you:

  • Have a strong sense of visual direction, and what good looks like

  • Have a marketing understanding

  • Have strongly adopted AI and use the newest tools to execute and produce content

  • Know how to set up automated creative workflows to scale content production

  • Have experience setting visual direction and look and feel across channels

  • Are fluent in English, written and spoken

You are someone who:

  • Is motivated by ownership and accountability

  • Is ambitious, takes initiative and turns opportunities into clear, structured actions. And executes them.

  • Is creative and obsessive about quality and detail

  • Thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

  • Enjoys working cross-functionally and building strong internal relationships

What We Offer

Our people are at the core of our success, and we work in an environment that values ownership, development, and collaboration - where your contributions make a real impact.

  • A full-time, on-site position at our Copenhagen office in Denmark

  • A role with ownership of our content production and visual direction, with direct impact on how Paiblock shows up everywhere

  • Strong opportunities for professional and personal development

  • A social, dynamic, and ambitious workplace culture

  • Hands-on responsibility for setting the creative bar and producing content with the newest AI tools

  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues

  • A modern, data- and tech-driven workplace where AI and new tools are actively applied

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Student Assistant
jobs.description:
Excellent opportunity for students who want hands-on experience with modern data platforms, analytics, and business intelligence.

Do you have a strong analytical mindset? Do you enjoy coding, processing data and conceptualize them into analytical reports? Then you might be our new Business Intelligence Student Assistant.

You will play an important role in:

Paiblock is looking for two motivated and eager-to-grow student assistants to support our continuous journey in improving financial and business insights through data.

You will be a key member of our BI team, working close to both business stakeholders and the underlying data infrastructure.

More specifically, you will:

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain analytical reports

  • Provide technical support for existing BI applications and data solutions

  • Clean, structure, and model raw data to improve analytical insights

  • Create and maintain tables, views, and queries in SQL Server

  • Create and maintain Python scripts for data ingestion

  • Deliver ad‑hoc reports and analyses as required

  • Provide in‑depth analysis to support business decision‑making

We imagine that you:

  • Are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s (towards the end) or Master’s program of relevance (e.g.

  • Engineering, AI, Data Science, Finance or Business Analytics).

  • Have a strong interest in data, systems and analytics – basic financial knowledge is an advantage

  • Possesses strong analytical skills and enjoy working with data to solve real-world problems

  • Are comfortable communicating and presenting in English

  • Thrive by working independently as well as in teams

  • Have hands-on experience or strong interest in programming, e.g. Python or similar

  • Have basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases (or strong motivation to learn)

  • Have experience with or curiosity for data visualization tools

  • Are comfortable with Excel (e.g. filters, pivot tables, lookup formulas)

  • Can work approx. 15 hours a week (flexible hours to accommodate your academic schedule)
     

Welcome to Paiblock

You will be a part of Finance department and you will participate in the collaboration with the business stakeholders and within the analytical community across the organization. You will be joining a diverse team of skilled and dedicated people operating in an international environment. 

Are you a student ready to apply your theoretical knowledge in practice?

We offer you the opportunity to connect your education with valuable practical experience in a late stage startup, where diversity and inclusion drive innovation, enabling us to create cutting-edge blockchain solutions.
 

Build your future with us

Please apply before 30th of August 2026. Interviews will be held during the application period.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – ESG Data Repository
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a passion for sustainability?

We are now recruiting a software engineer to join our journey and take long-term ownership of the ESG Data Repository — and we want you to help lead the way. The role involves working with a business-critical platform with high expectations on stability, scalability, and data quality. This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of sustainable finance in Swedbank

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

    

Be part of a team with the purpose of ensuring stability, scalability, and data quality of ESG data in a business-critical platform.

    

Take end-to-end ownership of design, development, maintenance, and evolution of the ESG Data Repository.

    

Work hands-on with complex data models and enterprise-scale data flows.

    

Collaborate with senior stakeholders across technology and sustainability domains.

    

Contribute to long-term architectural decisions.

What is needed in this role:

•    A bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in Engineering and/or Computer Science.

•    Minimum 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C# and SQL Server.

•    Strong, recent hands-on experience with SSIS and advanced T-SQL development.

•    Proven, hands-on experience designing and implementing Data Vault models.

•    Proven experience in building and maintaining REST APIs in enterprise environments.

•    Solid experience with Git-based version control in team-based development.

•    Proven responsibility for ownership, maintenance, and support of business-critical data platforms.

•    Hands-on experience working in SAFe-based agile organizations.

•    Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks) is meritorious.

•    Experience from IT development within financial services, or other highly regulated environments will be considered a strong advantage in the selection process.

•    Ability to independently solve complex technical challenges is essential.

•    Ability to contribute to technical decisions and improvements in data architecture will be important for success in this role.

•    Demonstrates a proactive approach to continuously learning new technologies and identifying opportunities to apply them to improve existing systems and processes.

•    Full professional proficiency in English is required. Ability to work in Swedish in a professional environment is required for effective collaboration.



With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

jobs.title: Customer Service Agent, Turku tai Kuhmo
jobs.description:
**Oletko asiakaspalvelun moniosaaja – tai haluatko kasvaa sellaiseksi?**

Tykkäätkö ratkaista ongelmia, kohdata erilaisia ihmisiä ja siitä fiiliksestä, kun asiakkaan asia tulee kerralla kuntoon?

**Saatat olla juuri se tyyppi, jota etsimme DialOk:lle Turkuun tai Kuhmoon!**

Haemme nyt uusia tekijöitä monipuolisiin asiakaspalvelutehtäviin. Tarjolla on **osa-aikaista työtä** (60-120h/kk).

**Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu?**

DialOk:lla yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen. Tuotamme monikanavaista asiakaspalvelua useille suomalaisille yrityksille ja julkisen sektorin toimijoille, joten pääset työskentelemään erilaisten asiakkaiden ja tilanteiden parissa.

Palvelet asiakkaita **puhelimitse, sähköpostitse ja chatissa**. Tehtäviisi voi asiakkuudesta riippuen kuulua esimerkiksi:

- tilausten ja muiden yhteydenottojen hoitamista

- ajanvarausta

- asiakkaiden neuvontaa ja ongelmien ratkaisemista

- vaihteenhoitoa

- erilaisia back office -tehtäviä.


Työ ei sisällä puhelinmyyntiä.

Meillä onnistumista ei mitata sillä, kuinka nopeasti saat asiakkaan pois linjoilta, vaan sillä, että hänen asiansa tulee hoidettua **ammattimaisesti, ystävällisesti ja mahdollisimman sujuvasti**. Tavoitteemme on yksinkertainen: ensiluokkainen palvelukokemus – kanavasta riippumatta.

**Missä ja milloin töitä tehdään?**

Voit työskennellä viihtyisällä toimistollamme **Turussa tai Kuhmossa**. Kun talo, työtehtävät ja toimintatapamme ovat tulleet tutuiksi, tarjoamme mahdollisuuden myös osittaiseen **etätyöhön** perehdytyksen jälkeen.

Työajat sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin **klo 7–18**, mutta vuoroja on tarjolla myös iltaisin, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Osa-aikaisilta työntekijöiltä toivomme mahdollisuutta sitoutua vähintään **kahteen työvuoroon viikossa**.

**Millainen tyyppi pärjää meillä?**

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis asiakaspalvelun supersankari ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Tärkeämpää meille on oikea asenne, halu oppia ja aito kiinnostus ihmisten auttamiseen.

Toivomme sinulta:

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, ruotsin kielen taito on etu

- positiivista ja palveluhenkistä asennetta

- kykyä pitää pää kylmänä myös kiireessä

- selkeää, rauhallista ja ystävällistä puhetyyliä

- hyviä kirjallisia taitoja

- sujuvia tietoteknisiä perustaitoja

- huolellista ja aikaansaavaa työotetta.


**Jos nautit ongelmien ratkaisemisesta, opit nopeasti uusia asioita ja saat energiaa onnistuneista asiakaskohtaamisista, olet jo pitkällä.**

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

- Tuntipohjaisen palkan (11,73 €) ja kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän

- joustavia työaikajärjestelyjä

- ajanmukaiset työvälineet

- osaavan ja energisen tiimin tuen

- Epassin liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut

- arvokasta kokemusta monikanavaisesta asiakaspalvelusta

- mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi useiden erilaisten asiakkuuksien parissa

- mahdollisuuden osittaiseen etätyöhön perehdytyksen jälkeen. Täysin etänä työtä ei voi tehdä.


Ja ennen kaikkea ympärillesi porukan, jonka kanssa töitä tehdään **ammattimaisesti mutta hyvällä fiiliksellä**.

**Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa – laita hakemus tulemaan!**

Kerro meille, kuka olet, miksi asiakaspalvelu kiinnostaa sinua ja miksi juuri sinä sopisit DialOk:lle.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Tesla autoriseret værksted
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af fremtidens bilbranche hos Autoskadestuen

Vil du arbejde med nogle af verdens mest innovative biler? Hos Autoskadestuen får du muligheden for at blive en del af en branche i rivende udvikling, hvor kvalitet, teknologi og godt håndværk går hånd i hånd.

Vi søger en passioneret autolakerer, der brænder for sit fag og har øje for detaljen. Hos os er medarbejdertrivsel i højsædet, fordi vi tror på, at glade medarbejdere skaber de bedste resultater – og dermed de mest tilfredse kunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Klargøring af karosseri (slibning, spartling og afdækning)

  • Lakering, farvetilpasning og finish på højt niveau

  • Tæt samarbejde med teknikere og pladeværksted

  • Sikring af høj kvalitet i alle processer – du afleverer kun arbejde, du er stolt af

Hvem er du?

  • Uddannet autolakerer eller har solid erfaring

  • Kvalitetsbevidst og med sans for detaljer

  • Ansvarsfuld og i stand til at arbejde selvstændigt

  • Nysgerrig på ny teknologi – herunder elbiler

  • En teamplayer med godt humør

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer

  • Et moderne værksted med topmoderne udstyr

  • Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og specialisering

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på både trivsel og faglighed

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning og CV til luisana@autoskadestuen.dk allerede i dag. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Vuokra-/kiinteistönvälittäjä Lappeenranta
jobs.description:
Meiltä löytyy toimeksiantoja täyttämään uudenkin välittäjän työpäiviä! Tarjoamme sinulle paikan kasvavasta organisaatiosta, jossa pääset itse vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi. Saat meiltä hyvät työkalut ja tuen työssäsi menestymiseen.

Etsimämme henkilö on motivoitunut ja positiivinen tiimipelaaja, jolta löytyy kyky laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamiseen. jobs.title: Expert Observabilité - Dynatrace GEN3 (H/F)
jobs.description:
Nous recrutons pour le compte de notre client, un(e) Expert(e) Observabilité pour renforcer une équipe dédiée à l'ingénierie et au maintien en conditions opérationnelles d'une plateforme d'observabilité SaaS, dans le cadre d'une mission de 6 mois renouvelable.

VOS MISSIONS

Spécialisation logs
     - Intégration structurée des logs dans la plateforme : collecte, indexation, exploitation et optimisation des flux
     - Mise en place de mécanismes de corrélation avancée entre logs, traces et métriques pour une vision bout-en-bout
     - Définition et application de règles de gouvernance : standardisation des formats, politiques de rétention, classification des données, gestion des droits d'accès (RBAC)

Observabilité
     - Contribution active aux projets techniques liés à la plateforme, de la conception au déploiement et à l'exploitation
     - Intégration dans des environnements cloud hybrides (on-premise + cloud public : AWS, Azure, GCP)
     - Amélioration continue du cycle de vie de la plateforme selon une approche Observability as Code (intégration des SLO dans les pipelines CI/CD, automatisation des configurations)

Collaboration & Support
     - Accompagnement des équipes DevSecOps dans l'onboarding des applications et des usages
     - Conseil technique et support aux équipes internes pour optimiser l'utilisation de la plateforme
     - Participation à la communauté interne : partage de bonnes pratiques, formation, contribution aux initiatives transverses

PROFIL RECHERCHE
     - Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en observabilité, avec une spécialisation avérée sur les logs
     - Maîtrise complète de l'intégration et de l'exploitation des logs dans un environnement SaaS
     - Expertise Dynatrace GEN3 (architecture, déploiement, configuration, exploitation), avec expérience concrète de migration GEN2 vers GEN3 (critère indispensable)
     - Corrélation avancée entre logs, traces et métriques (Davis AI, PurePath, Log Monitoring ou équivalents)
     - Expérience approfondie en collecte de logs (Fluentd, OpenTelemetry Collector), indexation (ELK, Loki) et gouvernance des données
     - Connaissance des environnements cloud hybrides (AWS, Azure, GCP)
     - Compréhension des sources de logs dans Kubernetes/OpenShift (pods, conteneurs, nodes)
     - Infrastructure as Code : Ansible, Terraform
     - Développement/scripting : Python, Bash ou Go (automatisation, scripts d'intégration)
     - Pratique de l'Observability as Code (outils CLI dédiés, Terraform Provider Dynatrace ou équivalent)

Atouts appréciés
     - OpenTelemetry (collecte unifiée des données)
     - Splunk ou ELK
     - CI/CD : Jenkins, GitLab CI
     - Sensibilité sécurité et collaboration avec des équipes SOC (détection d'anomalies, bonnes pratiques de logging sécurisé)

Environnement technique : Dynatrace, Splunk, ELK, Loki, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, Fluentd, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, Linux, Windows, Apache, Wildfly, J2EE

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Kurikka
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

To join this exciting new journey, we are now seeking a HSE Officer - a key role at the heart of our growth.



Your key responsabilities will include :



- Support a safe, secure start-up and ongoing operations, ensuring Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) requirements are addressed from day one

jobs.title: Scientist / Senior Scientist in Mass Spectrometry-based Proteome Research
jobs.description:
About Us

The Helsinki Proteomics Center (HPC) is a state-of-the-art technology platform operating across two life-science campuses at the University of Helsinki. Dedicated to advancing proteomics research, we provide cutting-edge services and collaborate with researchers to explore protein functions, interactions, and dynamics. This position is based at the Viikki Proteomics Unit, which is part of the Helsinki Proteomics Center.

Your Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist / Senior Scientist to join the Viikki Proteomics Unit. This is primarily a hands-on core-facility position: the appointee will help deliver reliable proteomics services, support facility users, maintain robust daily operations, and develop methods that can be implemented across the HPC service portfolio. The role is therefore best suited to a collaborative scientist who is motivated by enabling the research of others as well as advancing proteomics technology.

Key Responsibilities

Research and Development
* Investigate and evaluate new sample preparation protocols for bottom-up proteomics, including protein digestion, peptide clean-up, enrichment of post-translationally modified peptides, and handling sub-nanogram protein quantities.
* Optimize protocols for sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility, and evaluate new MS data-acquisition and analysis workflows for implementation as new or improved HPC services.


Operational Support
* Perform day-to-day technical operation of the high-resolution LC-MS/MS systems.
* Prepare customer and internal samples using validated facility protocols.
* Participate in routine maintenance of existing equipment, quality-control checks, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain accurate records of instrument usage, downtime, maintenance, and experimental procedures.


Collaboration and Communication
* Work closely with HPC colleagues to maintain an efficient, safe, and well-organized core-facility laboratory, and coordinate priorities to deliver high-quality results within agreed timelines.
* Advise facility users on experimental design, sample requirements, available technologies, instrument capabilities and limitations, and realistic expected outcomes.
* Prepare clear reports, discuss results and appropriate next steps with users, and provide evidence-based recommendations to HPC leadership on new platforms, methods, and technologies.


Administrative Duties
* Oversee inventory and coordinate procurement to ensure uninterrupted operation of the Viikki Proteomics Unit.
* Work with service contract providers to restore operations of the LC-MS/MS system promptly after system downtime.


Qualifications

Educational Background
* Master's degree required; Ph.D. preferred in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, or a related life science discipline.

Experience
* 2+ years of research experience with proteomic or related technologies.
* Strong background in protein chemistry is required.
* Experience in mass spectrometry-based proteomics is highly preferred.

Technical Skills
* Proficiency in using both vendor-specific and publicly available software tools for MS data analysis.
* Detail-oriented both at the lab bench and with record-keeping.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.


Soft Skills
* Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a collaborative, service-oriented team environment.
* Willingness to learn, standardize, document, and routinely apply a range of sample preparation protocols.
* Ability to provide demonstrations and training to facility users with varying levels of proteomics experience.
* Motivation to expand data-analysis expertise and contribute to user support and reporting.


What We Offer
* The salary is based on the Finnish university salary system, depending on qualifications and experience.
* The University of Helsinki provides occupational health services, staff well-being resources, access to sports facilities, and extensive opportunities for professional development.
* You will join a world-class research community, work with cutting-edge technologies, and collaborate with leading experts in the field.


Join Us
Employment is expected to start on November-December, 2026, or as agreed. The position is initially offered for two years with the possibility of extension. A 6-month trial period will be applied. The formal title of the position will be determined according to the appointee's qualifications and experience: Research Coordinator/Postdoctoral Researcher / Specialist (for an appointee with a MSc).

How to Apply
Applications should be submitted through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System at [application link] by clicking the "Apply now" button.
For the relevant application enclosers and further information, please see our website.
Application deadline: September 30, 2026

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
At NORMAL we are looking for an experienced People Business Partner in Finland who will be an important part of our People Business Partner team. You will be based at our head office in Helsinki but will primarily have activities in stores - in your regions in the country.

**Your role**

As a People Business Partner, you will be the link between our People Development initiatives and the everyday life in our Finnish stores. You will be given a wide range of tasks – from recruitment and onboarding to leadership development and business partnering – all with a focus on developing both people and the organization. You will participate in leadership group meetings and contribute actively to the People agenda.

**Your responsibilities**

· Drive and support recruitment processes primarily at management level

· Be a close sparring partner for the leaders in your regions - also in relation to strengthening our leadership pipeline

· Drive and support onboarding of new employees and managers

· Teach at our internal management training courses and run workshops

· Facilitate leadership development initiatives and ensure that concepts become practice

· Contribute to the development and implementation of People Development activities in everyday life

**Who are you?**

You are an empathetic relationship builder who meets people at eye level, and you are able to create trust and support among both managers and employees. You have a high drive, like to take initiative and do not wait for others to get you started. You think business and people together - and can translate strategic initiatives into concrete actions. You are also ambitious as a sparring partner and not afraid to get involved.

You thrive in an informal culture where there is room for the crazy and quirky while at the same time, we chase results and have big ambitions.

You communicate fluently in Finnish and English.

**We also imagine that you:**

· have years of experience with recruitment and leadership development – preferably from a larger retail organization

· have worked in a leadership role yourself

· can teach and facilitate with impact and energy

· thrive in an environment with pace, growth and many stakeholders

**Who are we?**

The culture at NORMAL is unpretentious, and we meet each other at eye level with the common goal of achieving success and results – while having a lot of fun and running fast. We believe in US more than ME, so we also help each other when things are busy. The employees have a high degree of influence, as we want to create a workplace based on trust and responsibility for the individual.

**Normal offers you:**

An exciting and challenging responsibility in a rapidly growing company. With us, you will become part of a big family, where we are motivated by self-development and our common goal to make Normal the best place possible for both our customers and employees.

Our working environment at NORMAL's Finnish headquarters and stores is youthful, international and fun, and we have a good can-do attitude. The company's values are an important part of our daily lives and thus we offer the opportunity to develop in a supportive work environment.

**Do you want to be part of the team?**

If you are interested in the position, please send us a motivated CV and an application with a few words about yourself and why you would be a good fit for this position. You are also welcome to reach out for questions to our Head of People Development, Morten Max on +4530248611.

We will be conducting interviews as we go, and we will hire the right candidate as soon as we have found that individual.

We look forward to receiving your application

Website & Technology Support

- Report bugs, usability issues, and suggestions for improvement.

- Assist with product listings and website content updates.

Personal Assistance

- Organize my personal appointments, calendar, and daily schedule.

Childcare Support

Cleaning & Hospitality Support

These duties are only required during exceptional situations, such as unexpected staff shortages, employee absences, or sudden operational needs.

When needed, you may be asked to assist with:

- Hotel room cleaning.

- Café cleaning.

- Cleaning assignments for SiivousVelhot.

- General housekeeping and maintaining high cleanliness standards.


Philippine Administrative Matters

- Assist with matters involving Philippine government agencies.

- Help organize taxes, permits, registrations, and official documents.
