After

Based on my research into your Q3 earnings call, where you discussed streamlining supply chain logistics, what specific data sources or key stakeholders would be critical for me to engage with in my first 30 days to begin mapping out an optimization strategy for that area?

Interview Questions: Impact vs. Inquiry What most people do What actually works Ask about team culture or company benefits. Ask how your specific skills solve their problems. Ask for a job description summary. Refer to a specific point from the job posting or their website. Ask generic questions from a list. Craft questions that lead to an offer, not just information. Ask questions that show you're curious. Ask questions that show you're already contributing. Wait to be told what to do. Propose how you'll make an immediate impact.

The takeaways

  • 01Ask questions that solve problems, not just gather info.
  • 02Reference the job posting and your resume directly.
  • 03Frame questions to reveal your strategic value.
  • 04Use your 30/60/90 plan to guide your questions.

Questions people ask

What if I don't have any questions left after our conversation?

It's rare that you won't have any questions if you're truly engaged, but if it happens, you can say, "You've been incredibly thorough, and I feel I have a strong understanding of the role and team. I'm confident I can contribute significantly." Then, pivot to reiterating your interest and fit. You can also offer to follow up if new questions arise.

Is this just a fancy cover letter? What does Baldwin Blueprint actually do?

No, it's much more. A cover letter is static. Baldwin Blueprint turns the actual job posting and your resume into a living 12 page strategic Blueprint you walk in with. It includes an Impact Memo, an Account Map, Strategic Signals, an Experience Accelerator, and a 30/60/90 day plan tailored specifically to that role. It's built from the actual posting, and the first draft is free, no card required. It gives you concrete, specific content for every stage of the interview, including the questions you ask.

How many questions should I ask?

Aim for 2 to 3 strong, impactful questions. Quality over quantity. You want to leave them thinking about your insights, not just how many questions you had. If your questions are strategic and well-researched, you won't need many to make a lasting impression. Focus on the ones that highlight your unique value and understanding of the role.

What if the interviewer seems rushed?

If they seem rushed, acknowledge it respectfully. "I know we're short on time, so I'll just ask one key question: based on our conversation, what's the single most critical challenge this role needs to solve in the first 6 months?" This shows you're observant and considerate, while still landing a powerful, focused question. It's about adapting to the situation while still making your point.

What does 'fast-paced environment' actually mean for my day to day?

SHORT ANSWERTranslate 'fast-paced environment' as a warning that the company lacks clear processes, has shifting priorities, and expects you to manage your own chaos. It means you must make decisions with incomplete data and execute tasks quickly without waiting for permission or perfect instructions.

Seeing 'fast-paced environment' in a job posting usually makes your stomach drop because it sounds like a recipe for instant burnout. I will show you how to decode this phrase so you can spot the warning signs and prove you can handle the actual work. You will walk away with a concrete strategy to turn this vague requirement into your biggest unfair advantage.

They need I can prove Scale a team Cut churn Ship fast Hired 9 Cut it 22% Weekly ships line them up first

FIG. 02Before I write a single line, I draw two columns: what they need on the left, what I can prove on the right. Then I draw lines connecting them. The gaps that have no line tell me exactly what to address in the cover note.

  • 01 Is 'fast-paced' just code for understaffed and chaotic?

A fast-paced environment means the company has more work than people and lacks the structured systems to manage the daily overflow. It is often a direct signal that priorities change weekly, resources are scarce, and you will be expected to self-manage through constant operational friction.

I see this constantly. Startups use this phrase because they are building the plane while flying it, while larger companies use it to excuse their broken internal processes. It is a structural reality.

You need to ask the hiring manager how they prioritize projects when everything is labeled urgent. Ask them to describe a week when a major goal shifted mid-flight.

  • 02

How do I prove I can thrive in this kind of chaos?

Prove your capability by sharing specific examples of times you managed competing deadlines, made decisions with limited data, and built your own templates to survive. You must demonstrate that you do not need a perfect manual to execute your daily tasks and deliver real results.

Most prep advice is useless because it tells you to say you love speed. Do not do that. Instead, give them a concrete example, like how you managed a sudden product launch delay by shifting your team's focus to customer documentation.

For example, a customer support lead could explain how they handled a forty percent spike in tickets without extra budget by building a temporary automated triage system.

fifty generic five sharp ones weight wins, not stack height

FIG. 03I weighed fifty generic applications against five sharp ones, and the five tailored to the role still tipped the scale. Fit carries more than sheer count. Build this for your role.Paste a real posting, get the 12 page plan. First draft free.Start free

  • 03 What are the red flags to watch out for in the interview?

Red flags appear when interviewers cannot define what success looks like in the first ninety days or when they brag about working late nights. If they describe the culture as a family that works hard and plays hard, expect uncompensated overtime and poor boundaries.

I want you to listen to their vocabulary. If they use words like firefighting or wearing many hats too often, run.

Here is your honest caveat. A strategic blueprint can prepare you for the interview, but it cannot fix a toxic boss once you take the job. You must use the interview to screen them just as much as they screen you.

  • 04

How does a 30/60/90 day plan help me address this?

A structured plan addresses this by showing the hiring manager you know how to onboard yourself without draining their limited time or resources. It proves you can identify quick wins, map out key stakeholders, and establish your own workflow within your first month on the job.

This is where the Baldwin Blueprint comes in. When you walk in with a 30/60/90 day plan built from their actual job posting, you show them you do not need hand-holding.

You are telling them, I see the chaos, and here is exactly how I plan to organize my first ninety days to relieve your pressure.

Worked example

  • STAR answer

Before

I work really well under pressure and I am used to fast-paced environments where things change quickly.

After

When our main supplier shut down with zero notice, I did not wait for leadership to act. I built a temporary tracking sheet, sourced three local backup vendors within forty-eight hours, and kept our production line running without a single hour of downtime.

How to handle 'fast-paced' in your application What most people do What actually works Write generic resume bullets about multitasking Quantify how you managed shifting priorities and tight deadlines Nod and say you love a challenge during the interview Ask how the team handles resource constraints and shifting goals Wait for the company to train you on their systems Present a 30/60/90 day plan showing how you will onboard yourself

The takeaways

  • 01Fast-paced usually means shifting priorities and limited resources.
  • 02Prove you can self-manage with concrete, quantified examples.
  • 03Use the interview to screen for toxic, disorganized environments.
  • 04A 30/60/90 day plan shows you do not need hand-holding.

Questions people ask

Does fast-paced always mean I will have to work overtime?

Not always, but it usually means your working hours will be intense and highly focused. It often points to poor project management, which can bleed into your personal time if you do not set firm boundaries early in your tenure.

Is Baldwin Blueprint just a fancy cover letter generator?

No, it is a comprehensive twelve page strategic document that includes an Impact Memo, Account Map, and 30/60/90 day plan. It does not write generic cover letters. It analyzes the actual job posting to build a concrete execution plan you can use in your interview.

How do I ask about work-life balance without sounding lazy?

Ask how the team prioritizes work when everything is urgent. A good manager will explain their triage process, while a bad one will tell you that everything simply has to get done, which is your cue to walk away.

We are currently seeking a Planner to join the construction of a large-scale luxury hotel and residential development in the Cayman Islands, currently in the preparatory works phase.

Reporting to the Project Management Team, you will be responsible for the development, monitoring, and optimization of the overall project schedule.   • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is essential. Knowledge of French would be considered an asset.

Our Work Environment

Joining us means becoming part of an international group that offers numerous opportunities for development and mobility. It also means benefiting from a rich and diverse training offering, attractive employment conditions, and the possibility to organize your work flexibly.

We welcome your application regardless of any discriminatory grounds. What matters to us is your originality, your motivation, and your skills. Join our team and letâs build the future together based on shared values.

jobs.title: Barcelona Säljare

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av fast telefoni till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 150 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

Playground Pictures are modernising the 'Backyard Sports' universe and the beloved characters in a new and exciting animated series. The series is an homage to the game and explores how - no matter your background or chaos that may happen in life - everyone has a place in the Backyard Sports community. For this role, candidates may work either from our Kilkenny studio or remotely within the Republic of Ireland, there is no option to work freelance from outside of Ireland About the role As a location designer, you are responsible for exploring and creating environments that set the stage for a production, while ensuring the designs are functional for production. What you'll be doing Finalise and clean up designs using Photoshop Execute changes on designs based on feedback from the art lead and/or assistant director/director Maintain the overall location style Demonstrate strong visual interpretation skills Keep team informed of potential creative problems Ensure that production deadlines are met while maintaining the highest standard of quality Draft, design and layout locations from script/animatic/briefs The above is not exhaustive and from time to time you may be asked to carry out other tasks. What we're looking for 3+ years of Professional Studio experience as a Location Designer Strong understanding of traditional 2D principles Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize work Attention to detail and ability to find solutions Experience with Shotgrid/Flow is considered a plus

jobs.title: Directeur d'Hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Vous souhaitez diriger un établissement à taille humaine tout en étant au cœur de l'action ? Rejoignez l'univers chaleureux et convivial des Hôtels Inn Design, où satisfaction client et gestion opérationnelle sont les piliers du quotidien!

Nous recrutons le Directeur de l'Hôtel Inn Design de Sainte-Luce sur Loire, hôtel restaurant de 100 chambres.

Description du poste

En tant que Responsable d'établissement, vous êtes le garant de la performance globale de l'hôtel et de la satisfaction client. Vous jouez un rôle central dans le pilotage quotidien en lien étroit avec les équipes et les clients.

Vos missions principales :

Accueil & expérience client :
- Accueil physique et téléphonique d'une clientèle nationale et internationale
- Mise en place du petit-déjeuner et service en restauration
- Suivi des retours clients et gestion des demandes spécifiques

Commercialisation:
- Valoriser votre sens du commerce pour identifier et saisir les opportunités de croissance sur votre marché

Encadrement des équipes :
- Animer, motiver et organiser le travail des collaborateurs, gérer les plannings et accompagner le développement des compétences.

Gestion opérationnelle :
- Gestion des réservations, des arrivées/départs (check-in/check-out), facturation, encaissements, contrôle des caisses.
- Suivi du standard téléphonique, des e-mails et de la communication avec les clients.
- Organisation des espaces séminaires : installation, matériel, rangement.
- Suivi et gestion des stocks : petit-déjeuner, bar, fournitures.

Hygiène et conformité :
- S'assurer du respect rigoureux des normes d'hygiène et de sécurité, du contrôle qualité des chambres à la propreté des espaces communs et des cuisines.

Conditions spécifiques :
- Poste logé
- Astreintes hebdomadaires, avec autonomie dans la gestion opérationnelle.

Votre profil :
- Vous avez une première expérience réussie dans la gestion d'un établissement hôtelier, avec management d'équipe.
- Vous aimez la polyvalence et la gestion opérationnelle
- Orienté(e) résultats, vous savez mobiliser votre équipe autour d'objectifs communs tout en valorisant la cohésion et la performance.

Haemme APULAISRAVINTOLAPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ Original Sokos Hotel Vaakuna Vaasassa toimiviin ravintola- ja kokoustoimintoihin.

Haemme nyt rohkeaa ja tuloshakuista päällikköä vetämään ja johtamaan huipputiimiä. Jos tunnet suurta paloa ravintola-alaa ja ihmisiä kohtaan, tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn, jossa pääset näyttämään taitosi ja edelleen kehittymään.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Suomusjärvi ja Sale Kiikala
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SALO

Etsimme nyt MYYJÄÄ vakituiseen tehtävään Suomusjärven & Kiikalan Saleen! Tehtävä on osa-aikainen, 20 h/vko.Myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tekemisen meiningistä. Siitä on tietysti hyötyä, jos olet työskennellyt vastaavissa tehtävissä jo aiemmin, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – me perehdytämme kyllä!

Salen myyjänä teet ihan tavallisia töitä:työpäiväsi täyttyvät asiakaskohtaamisista, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallinnasta. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita tylsää tai merkityksetöntä – päinvastoin! Meille tavallista on asiakkaiden hurmaaminen leveällä hymyllä ja reippaalla työotteella.

Toivomme, että pidät asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta, tiimityöskentelystä, fyysisestä työstä ja reippaasta työtahdista. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa n. klo 7–21 välillä. Tehtävä edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä sekä Kiikalan että Suomusjärven Salessa. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus on tarpeen toimipisteiden sijainnin vuoksi.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
Ihan tavallisia töitä, ja erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.

Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 10,89–14,57 € /h. Ja lisät päälle!

Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.

Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.

Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko kotimyymälässäsi tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.

Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana.


💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: syyskuussa 2026 sopimuksen mukaan
Huomaathan, että haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla, ja valintapäätökset tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa arkisin klo 8–16 myymäläpäällikköElina Valdemarsson joko puhelimitse p. 044320 5780 tai sähköpostitse elina.valdemarsson@sok.fi

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessasso.fi/toihinmeille.

jobs.title: Facilities Manager
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Operational Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You Essential Experience & Skills Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

jobs.title: Housekeeping Associate - Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
jobs.description:
Step into a role that redefines excellence at the Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, a hallmark of hospitality since 1971 in the heart of Sweden's bustling capital. Aligned with our innovative owners Archer Hotel Management and Marriott International, we merge rich cultural history with modern luxury and a deep dedication to sustainability.

We are now looking for detail-oriented and motivated Housekeeping Associates to join our team! If you take pride in creating a clean, welcoming environment and enjoy working in a fast-paced setting, we’d love to hear from you.

If you have a passion for hospitality and a focus on delivering outstanding guest experiences, we want to hear from you!
We believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for professional development and offer a workplace where you can learn, grow, and thrive.


Key responsibilities:
·      Clean and maintain guest rooms, public areas, and workspaces
·      Replenish linens, toiletries, and other supplies
·      Follow safety and sanitation policies.
·      Report maintenance issues promptly
·      Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction, assuring personalized service and addressing guest concerns or needs promptly
·      Ensure that our guests have a great start and end to their stay at the hotel
·      Work collaboratively with other team members


Qualifications:
·      Previous housekeeping experience
·      Ability to handle high-pressure situations with efficiency and professionalism
·      Strong attention to detail
·      Flexible and available to work both daytime, evenings, and weekends
·      Ability to work independently and as part of a team


What We Offer:
·      Full-time and part-time positions following a 6-month probation period, as well as extra positions, all in accordance with the collective agreement.
·      We also offer employment on an occasional basis. If you are looking to work only from time to time or just on weekends, this could be a great opportunity for you.
·      Employment in a company with great opportunities for growth, where our core value is "Putting People First"
·      A dynamic and inclusive work environment
·      Employee discounted rates at over 10 000 hotels worldwide

Join our team and play a key role in creating memorable experiences for our guests!


About Sheraton Stockholm Hotel
The Sheraton brand, established in 1937, has been synonymous with excellence in hospitality. The Sheraton Stockholm Hotel, opened in 1971 as the first international 5 star hotel in Stockholm, and it’s an icon in Sweden’s capital city. As part of Marriott International, Sheraton Stockholm Hotel is providing guests with thoughtful amenities, contemporary accommodation, and the best city center location. Our commitment to sustainability aligns with our owner Archer Hotel Managements ethos, making us a unique choice for conscientious travelers.

Redefining the Essence of Hospitality
We are at the end of our renovation journey at Sheraton Stockholm. This marks the beginning of our mission to redefine the essence of hospitality. We have transformed all our spaces, hotel rooms, implemented new food and beverage concepts and expanded our gym and wellness. As we embark on this transformation, we are seeking the best industry people to join our team.

jobs.title: Manager, Engine Component & Performance
jobs.description:
We are looking for a forward-looking and people-oriented Manager to lead the Engine Component and Performance Experts team within Product Lifecycle Management / Global Technical Services. This is a key leadership role for someone who wants to combine deep technical understanding, modern people leadership, data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement to create measurable value for customers and for Wärtsilä.

Ideally the candidate would be based in either Vaasa Finland, but we are open to qualified applicants also in Trieste, Italy or Turku, Finland on a permanent basis.


We operate hybrid working in Finland and Smart-working hybrid in Italy. We will not consider a fully remote working option on any of our three preferred locations.


There will be requirement to travel within the role up to 20% of the time.



The team consists of approximately 20 highly skilled experts working with 4-stroke engine products for industrial and marine applications, with a strong focus on engine performance, fuel injection, turbocharging, cylinder heads, valve train and power system components.



Main responsibilities:



* Proper resources are allocated to fulfil business needs


* Resources are trained and develop their competences for all technologies and components in the area of expertise


* Connections to Technical Service product teams provide consolidated product feedback


* Networking with R&D is bringing lifecycle knowledge for product development and new product introduction


* New Technologies are introduced within Technical Service well in advance to secure proper preparation of resources


* R&D is considering lifecycle technical needs


* Innovation culture is spread into Technical Service


* New portfolio solutions are proposed for existing products




We are especially looking for a manager who can bring a modern approach to technical leadership, including:



* Strong people leadership based on trust, clarity, empowerment and coaching


* A data-driven mindset, using facts, analytics and performance indicators to improve decisions and prioritisation


* Ability to transform field experience and expert knowledge into structured learning, technical standards and product improvement input


* Curiosity towards digital tools, AI-supported knowledge management and modern ways of sharing technical competence


* A collaborative and improvement-oriented attitude, able to connect experts, R&D, supply management, field service, workshops and business stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior Dynamics 365 CRM Developer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will help shape and modernize Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions in a complex public sector environment where stability, long-term quality, and real business value matter. The work spans the full development lifecycle and combines hands-on development with solution design, architecture input, and close collaboration with stakeholders. You will work in an environment that still relies on strong on-premises capabilities while also preparing for future cloud migration initiatives using Power Platform and Dynamics 365 Online. It is an exciting role for you who want to solve technically demanding challenges, work close to the business, and contribute to solutions that support important services for citizens.

Job Description

    You will develop and enhance Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service solutions in on-premises environments.
    You will work across the full lifecycle, from solution design and development to testing, deployment, and ongoing support.
    You will solve complex technical challenges with clear business impact.
    You will collaborate with business stakeholders to understand needs, prioritize requirements, and turn them into sustainable technical solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Business Controller – Software & Tech
jobs.description:
Would you like to combine business controlling, financial analysis, and business-oriented advisory in an environment where software and advanced technology are at the core? 📊💻

We are looking for a Senior Business Controller for a long-term consulting assignment in Gothenburg. In this role, you will work closely with senior decision-makers, transforming financial data into insights, challenging assumptions, and contributing to well-informed business decisions.

You will work in a technology-intensive organization developing software for modern vehicles, including digital services, infotainment, and advanced driver assistance systems. 🚗

About the Role

As a Senior Business Controller, you will have broad responsibilities combining operational controlling, project and program follow-up, and business partnering. You will work closely with senior management and act as a proactive financial partner in both strategic and operational matters.

An important part of the role is creating transparency around costs, budgets, and forecasts. You will analyze financial performance, identify risks and opportunities, and ensure that relevant decision-making data and insights are available.

Your main responsibilities will include:

    

Acting as a financial partner to senior management, providing clear analyses and recommendations.

    

Driving monthly financial follow-up, including variance analyses and performance reviews.

    

Working with OPEX, cost control, and monitoring financial KPIs.

    

Managing budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning for various programs and projects.

    

Monitoring project costs, burn rates, and forecast accuracy, and highlighting deviations.

    

Collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, procurement, program management, and other functions.

    

Reviewing purchase requests and supplier invoices to ensure compliance with budgets, contracts, and internal guidelines.

    

Driving recurring budgeting and forecasting processes.

    

Preparing financial analyses and presentations for senior management.

    

Proactively identifying financial risks, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 📈

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone with a solid foundation in controlling who thrives in a business-oriented role. You are analytical and structured, but above all, you have the ability to understand the business behind the numbers and translate your analysis into concrete recommendations.

You are comfortable working independently, challenging existing assumptions, and communicating financial matters to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.

Ideally, you have:

    

A university degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or equivalent.

    

At least 3–5 years of experience in business controlling, financial controlling, business partnering, program controlling, or a similar role.

    

Solid experience in budgeting, forecasting, and financial modelling.

    

Strong analytical skills and experience working with large volumes of financial data.

    

Experience working cross-functionally and closely with senior stakeholders.

    

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

    

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience from automotive, technology, engineering, or another development-intensive environment is considered an advantage. Previous experience in project controlling, program controlling, or automotive development programs is also a plus.

Additional Merits

Experience with the following is considered an advantage:

    

Power Query / Excel Query and macros

    

Power BI

    

SAP S/4HANA

About the Assignment

📍 Location: Gothenburg, on-site 📅 Start date: September 1, 2026 ⏳ Assignment period: Until August 31, 2027 🕒 Scope: Full-time, 40 hours per week

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to take on a central financial role close to the business while working in an environment where finance meets software development and advanced technology.

jobs.description:
Au quotidien, les femmes et les hommes de l'EdA s'engagent aux côtés de nos forces armées sur le territoire national et à l'étranger.

L'EdA c'est 1 000 collaborateurs dans le monde, 20 familles de métiers, pour assurer l'approvisionnement en denrées alimentaires, la restauration collective - externalisée ou en régie - et les activités de loisirs, la gestion des camps en opérations extérieures et le soutien aux évènements.


Notre offre

Au sein de la direction International et Opérations (DIO), rattaché au second de cuisine, le cuisinier a pour mission de réaliser la production alimentaire d'un restaurant collectif et de ces prestations particulières.


Vos missions au quotidien

- Réaliser les préparations culinaires selon les fiches techniques

- Assurer les cuissons le dressage et la mise en valeur des plats

- Appliquer strictement les règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire (HACCP)

- Assurer le nettoyage et l'entretien du poste de travail et du matériel

- Travailler en coordination avec le reste de l'équipe du RF

- Contrôler et garantir l'entretien et la bonne utilisation des matériels mis à sa disposition

- Préparer les produits et mettre en place les matériels de cuisine

- S'assurer de la qualité des denrées fournies

- Produire, valoriser et vérifier (goût, qualité, présentation) les préparations

- Repérer et signaler les dysfonctionnements

- Veiller au bon déroulement du service dans les différents espaces de restauration

- Assurer l'accueil des convives et la gestion des enregistrements des passages viales caisses JES pour les 3 services


Votre profil
Le candidat est de nationalité française et/ou ressortissant européen.
Etablissement soumis à enquête administrative.

Votre parcours

Formation CAP/BEP restauration et/ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience d'au moins 2 ans dans le domaine.


Les savoir-être partagés par tous les collaborateurs de l'EdA

Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, discrétion, implication, agilité, éthique, communication, initiative


Nos propositions

Poste à pourvoir sur des enceintes militaires françaises.

Rattaché au second de cuisine.

Respect des règles de sécurité édictées par l'autorité militaire, notamment les conditions de sortie.

Logement fourni (nuitée et petit déjeuner), type appart hôtel.

Poste de contact, varié, nécessitant d'être apte à travailler en autonomie aussi bien qu'en équipe.

Contrat : CDD de droit privé, contrat français détaché, à temps plein (42h30).

Durée : 3 mois avec première mission d'un 1 mois.

Statut : Agent de maîtrise

Rémunération : 4 000 € net mensuel de package.

Pourquoi postuler

L'engagement au côté des forces armées françaises nous permet de donner du sens à nos actions et de nous accomplir au quotidien. C'est l'opportunité de mettre nos expertises et notre créativité au service de projets dimensionnants.
Pour garantir leur réussite, nous veillons à développer et conjuguer les talents de chacun.

Nous rejoindre c'est intégrer un collectif où l'humain reste au centre des attentions, qu'il soit client ou collaborateur. Nous avons la conviction que le service indéfectible que nous devons à nos prescripteurs ne peut être garanti que par la qualité de l'environnement que nous proposons à nos équipes.

A la jonction des univers militaire et civil, l'EdA est riche d'une culture de mixité.
En postulant chez nous, ne vous posez pas d'autre question que celle de savoir si vous partagez nos valeurs et ambitions.
Au-delà de votre expertise, nous recherchons les qualités qui font la force de nos équipes : éthique, implication, audace, rigueur, empathie et créativité.

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
**The Role**

**We're looking for a Data Scientist to do the quantitative analysis behind a large-scale data quality program. When our data engineering team's monitors flag a statistical anomaly in large, human-generated rating and annotation data, you'll be the one who determines whether it's genuine signal or ordinary noise, and if it's real, what's actually driving it. You'll triage confirmed findings into the right remediation lane, turn your analysis into fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups, and help build the dashboards and reporting views that make your findings visible to the team and stakeholders. You'll operate on a two-week sprint cadence as part of a small, distributed team, reporting into the program's Data Scientist Lead.**

**What You'll Do**

- **Take anomalies flagged by the data engineering team's monitoring systems and apply statistical methods (hypothesis testing, distributional comparisons, cohort/segment analysis) to classify each as genuine signal or ordinary noise/drift.**

- **Run root-cause analysis on confirmed anomalies in rating/annotation data — for example, comparing cohorts to identify what distinguishes an outlier group from the rest of the population — to identify the likely driver.**

- **Triage confirmed findings into the correct remediation lane: contributor-side issues (route to our internal Quality team for remediation) versus process-side issues (route back to the client's program team as a guideline or workflow fix).**

- **Turn analysis into clear, concise, fast-turnaround diagnostic write-ups that feed the team's stakeholder cadence, owned by the Data Scientist Lead.**

- **Build and maintain the dashboards and reporting views (in partnership with data engineering) that surface anomaly trends, cohort findings, and turnaround metrics to the team and stakeholders.**

- **Work within tight, SLA-driven turnaround windows, delivering diagnosis-ready findings within hours — not days — once an issue is flagged.**

- **Participate fully in a two-week sprint cadence: sprint planning, review, and continuous improvement of analysis methodology.**

- **Collaborate cross-functionally with data engineers, the Data Scientist Lead, and program/quality stakeholders across a distributed, international team.**


**What You'll Need**

- **3+ years of professional experience as a Data Scientist, Statistician, or Quantitative Analyst.**

- **Strong background in statistical analysis and hypothesis testing — comfortable choosing and applying the right test (e.g., distributional comparison tests) to determine whether two groups genuinely differ.**

- **Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including standard statistical/analysis libraries.**

- **Demonstrated experience distinguishing genuine patterns from noise or drift in large, messy, human-generated datasets.**

- **Experience with BI/dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Data Studio).**

- **Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with short sprint cycles.**

- **Strong written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable producing clear write-ups for both technical and non-technical audiences.**


**Nice to Have**

- **Experience with anomaly and drift detection on human-rated, crowdsourced, or annotation-based datasets.**

- **Prior experience in a data quality, trust & safety, content moderation, or crowdsourced-data environment.**

- **Familiarity with cohort or segmentation profiling techniques for large populations.**


**Project Overview**

**Location: Remote from Finland**

**Type: Full-time, fixed-term engagement of approximately 6 months, with potential to extend based on program needs.**

jobs.title: Finance Manager to Öhlins Group
jobs.description:
Do you want to take on a key role in a world-leading technology company with one of Sweden’s strongest brands in motorsport and premium vehicles? Do you thrive at the intersection of operational accounting, group reporting, and leadership? Then the role as Finance Manager at Öhlins could be the next step in your career.

Öhlins is in an exciting phase where the focus on business performance, cash flow, and financial governance is greater than ever. We are now looking for a Finance Manager who wants to help develop the finance function in an international environment.

Your Challenge

As Finance Manager, you will have overall responsibility for accounting and financial reporting across the Group. This is a central role within the organization, involving close collaboration with the CFO, management team, and colleagues in our international subsidiaries. You will be responsible for ensuring high quality in accounting, financial closings, and reporting while leading a high-performing finance team. The role combines hands-on operational work with leadership responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence processes, ways of working, and the continued development of the finance function.

The position is based at the headquarters in Upplands Väsby and reports directly to the CFO.

Your Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for:

    Responsible for all accounting and reporting, including monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and external reports

    Ensure timely and accurate preparation of financial statements, reports and forecasts in accordance with GAAP and regulatory requirements

    Serve as the primary internal expert on Swedish GAAP (K3), statutory reporting and local regulatory requirements.

    Develop, structure and maintain accounting department procedures and internal controls

    Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support budgeting, forecasting and financial planning

    Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making and strategic planning

    Manage relationships with external auditors, tax advisors and regulators

    Stay up to date on accounting standards, regulations and industry trends to ensure compliance and best practices

    Lead and develop the accounting team and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth

    Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to streamline workflows and increase efficiency.

Qualifications

We believe you have:

    A university degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field

    Approximately 7-10 years of experience in accounting and finance

    Experience managing or leading an accounting function

    Extensive knowledge of K3 accounting standards, annual reporting, and Swedish regulatory frameworks

    Demonstrated experience preparing annual reports for Swedish legal entities

    Experience with group accounting and consolidation

    Strong systems proficiency and an interest in efficient processes

    Experience from an international organization is considered an advantage

    Fluency in both Swedish and English, written and spoken as communication and documentation take place in both languages

If you have a background in auditing, preferably with a Big Four firm, we consider that particularly interesting.

Personal Attributes

To succeed in this role, you are a confident and down-to-earth professional who enjoys collaboration and building long-term relationships. You are a natural team player who builds trust across the organization and works effectively both with your team and with other functions within the business. You are structured, detail-oriented, and quality-focused, with strong analytical skills and sound business acumen. You are confident in your accounting expertise, able to balance attention to detail with a holistic perspective, and motivated by developing both people and processes to create sustainable improvements and results.

About Öhlins Group

Passion, Performance, Perfection — this is the Öhlins way. Our passion for innovation and state-of-the-art technology is the driving force in our search for the next generation of advanced suspension technology. Öhlins has been a cornerstone of the motorsport, motorcycle, and automotive industries for over 45 years. Since day one, our focus has been on delivering high-quality products, service, and support—from the MotoGP circuit to national and local racing events—in over 50 distributing countries. We supply the aftermarket, OEM partners, and teams with high-end suspension technology, and strive to exceed the expectations of our customers around the world.

Application

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you match the profile described above, we encourage you to apply today using the application button.In this recruitment process, Öhlins Group is partnering with Gazella. If you have any questions, please contact Bilge Kaya (bilge.kaya@gazella.se) at Gazella, who is the recruiter responsible for this position.

Rekrytering sker i samarbete med Gazella.

jobs.title: myynti@tapahtumakoordinaattori
jobs.description:
Backbyn kartano & Pirttimäki Camping&ulkoilukeskus hakee **myynti- ja tapahtumakoordinaattoria.**

Backbyn Kartano & Kylpylähotelli sekä Pirttimäki Camping &ulkoilukeskus ovat kaksi erilaista kohdetta saman katon alla — toinen tarjoaa kartanotunnelmaa ja kylpylän rauhaa, toinen aktiivista ulkoilmaelämää ja yhteisöllisyyttä. Etsimme tekijää, joka vastaa molempien kohteiden somesta ja tapahtumatuotannosta.

Rooli on harvinaisen laaja: pääset rakentamaan kahden erilaisen brändin näkyvyyttä alusta asti, näkemään työsi tulokset suoraan varauksissa ja tapahtumien kävijämäärissä, ja vaikuttamaan siihen, miten kummankin kohteen tarina kerrotaan.

Kaksi brändiä, yksi tekijä.

\- Backbyn Kartano & Kylpylähotelli: Historiallista kartanotunnelmaa, laadukasta ravintolaruokaa, rentouttavia kylpylähetkiä sekä laadukkaita kokouksia ja juhlatilaisuuksia.

\- Pirttimäki Camping & ulkoilukeskus: Aktiivista ulkoilmaelämää,glampingtelttailua, caravan keskus, luontoelämyksiä, kahvila-ravintolatunnelmaa, urheilutapahtumia, yritystapahtumia & kokouksia sekä rentoa yhdessäoloa ystävien tai työkavereiden kanssa. Pirttimäki on myös loistava kokouspaikka, hienoine kokouspaketteineen joissa huomioitu monipuolisesti Nuuksion kansallispuisto ja sen tarjoamat aktiviteetimahdollisuudet.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu;

\- Somen kokonaisvaltainen haltuunotto — vastaat molempien kohteiden kanavista (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Linkedin jne..) ideasta toteutukseen: kuvaat, editoit, kirjoitat ja julkaiset.

\- Tapahtumien suunnittelu ja toteutus— Vaunuvajan hääsuunnittelusta toteutukseen ja kylpyläviikonlopuista Pirttimäen ulkoilupäiviin ja urheilu&yritystapahtumiin. Otat vastuun tapahtuman ideasta lippujen myyntiin ja paikan päällä koordinointiin asti.

\- Myynnin sisällöt — kirjoitat kutsuvia uutiskirjeitä ja myyntiviestejä, jotka muuttavat klikkaukset pöytävarauksiksi, hotelliyöpymisiksi ja kokousvarauksiksi.

\- Brändien äänenä toimiminen — varmistat, että molempien kohteiden oma tunnelma välittyy aitona kaikissa kanavissa.

\- Myynnin tukitoiminnot kuten tarjousten tekemistä, asiakastapaamiset jne.. yhteistyössä myyntitiimimme kanssa.

Millainen olet?

\- Sinulla on somesilmää: tiedät mikä toimii Instagramissa ja TikTokissa juuri nyt, ja osaat tuottaa laadukasta kuva- ja videomateriaalia näppärästi puhelimella.

\- Kirjoitat sujuvaa, virheetöntä suomea ja osaat vaihtaa tyyliä kartanon eleganssista ulkoilualueen rentouteen.

\- Olet järjestelmällinen ja pystyt pitämään useita projekteja käynnissä yhtä aikaa, myös tilanteiden muuttuessa nopeasti.

\- Olet oma-aloitteinen ja valmis oppimaan uutta.

\- Aiempi kokemus tapahtumatuotannosta tai some-markkinoinnista on eduksi.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- Vastuullisen ja itsenäisen roolin , jossa omat ideat pääsevät käytäntöön.

\- Monipuolisen työnkuvan — yhtenä päivänä kuvaat kylpylässä sisältöä, toisena hiot myyntikirjettä ja kolmantena järjestät Pirttimäellä ulkoilutapahtumaa.

\- Viihtyisän työympäristön ja ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen.

\- Kilpailukykyiset henkilöstöedut.

\- Kokoaikaisen työsuhteen.

\- Työpisteenä Backbyn kartano, työaika arkityö ma-pe klo 8.00 – 15.30 + tapahtumien mukaan työaika soviteltavissa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Rooli sopii sinulle, jos haluat yhdistää some-osaamisen ja tapahtumatuotannon yhdessä paikassa sen sijaan, että jompikumpi jäisi sivuosaan. Lähetä meille:

1\. CV + palkkatoivomus

2\. Lyhyt videohakemus (max. 1 min), jossa kerrot lyhyesti itsestäsi.

3\. Portfolio tai linkkejä tekemiisi some-sisältöihin, jos sinulla on sellaisia.

Lähetä hakemuksesi palkkatoivomuksineen osoitteeseen kimmo.lagstrom@backby.fi viimeistään 30.8.2026 mennessä.

Tokio, kuris vertina kruopštumą – mėgsta, kai viskas padaryta tvarkingai, bet moka ir greitai reaguoti, nebijo naujų iššūkių;
Gebančio derinti fizinį darbą sandėlyje su kompiuterinėmis užduotimis;

Company Description Sanya Pharma Pvt Ltd is a key part of a family-owned group that began in 1960 with Medicine House, one of the first pharmaceutical wholesalers in Patna, Bihar, focused on providing life-saving medicines to the state. Over the decades, the group has evolved into a leading supply chain and distribution partner for major Pharma and FMCG companies across Bihar and Jharkhand. As a trusted channel partner, Sanya Pharma Pvt Ltd delivers resilient supply chain infrastructure and a professional work culture to its associates. The company operates as a C&FA and state distributor (super stockist), offering services, IT systems, facilities, and management support. Its long-term partnerships are built on trust, transparent communication, responsiveness, and a shared strategic vision.
Role Description The Billing Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Patna. The Billing Executive will be responsible for preparing and processing invoices, verifying billing data, and ensuring accuracy in customer and vendor accounts. Daily tasks include coordinating with internal teams and external partners to resolve billing discrepancies, updating financial records, and maintaining organized documentation. The role also involves monitoring payment status, following up on outstanding bills, and supporting finance and accounting teams with reports and reconciliations. The Billing Executive is expected to adhere to company policies and regulatory requirements while contributing to efficient, reliable billing operations.
Qualifications
  • Candidates should possess strong Billing Process and Invoicing skills, with attention to accuracy and compliance.
  • Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to review data, identify discrepancies, and support reconciliations.
  • Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, and customers.
  • Candidates should possess basic to intermediate Finance knowledge, particularly in billing, accounts receivable, and documentation.
  • Candidates should possess proficiency in MS Office or similar tools, and familiarity with billing or ERP software.
  • Candidates should possess strong organizational and time-management abilities to handle high volumes of transactions.
  • Candidates should possess a minimum of a diploma or bachelorâs degree in commerce, finance, accounting, or a related field; prior experience in pharmaceutical or FMCG distribution billing is an advantage.

jobs.title: Mekaniker - service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger
jobs.description:
SAWO HERLEV

Mekaniker med blik for teknik, kvalitet og løsninger, der holder

Vil du arbejde med mere end standardreparationer – og blive specialist i hydraulik, el og avancerede opbygninger på lastbiler?

Hos SAWO får du faglige udfordringer, gode kolleger og mulighed for at udvikle dig i en branche, hvor dit håndværk gør en synlig forskel for kunden hver eneste dag.

Bliv en del af holdet i Herlev

Vi har travlt – og det er der en god grund til. SAWO er Danmarks førende specialist i opbygninger og udstyr til lastbiler og entreprenørkøretøjer. Siden 1962 har vi leveret driftssikre, skræddersyede løsninger, og i Herlev har vi brug for endnu en dygtig mekaniker, som vil være med til at holde både udstyr og kundernes hverdag kørende.

Du bliver en del af et erfarent og hjælpsomt værkstedsteam, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og går op i at aflevere et stykke arbejde, vi kan være stolte af.

Din hverdag hos os

Du får en varieret arbejdsdag med både planlagte opgaver og faglige udfordringer, der kræver nysgerrighed og en god teknisk forståelse. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

·     Service, reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiler og opbygninger

·     Fejlfinding på mekaniske, hydrauliske og elektriske systemer

·     Montering, tilpasning og klargøring af udstyr

·     Kvalitetssikring og dialog med kolleger om den bedste løsning

·     Bidrag til, at kunderne får driftssikkert udstyr og kortest mulig nedetid

Derfor skal du vælge SAWO

·     Et stærkt fagligt miljø – du arbejder sammen med erfarne specialister og får kolleger, der gerne deler deres viden.

·     Opgaver med variation – du møder forskellige køretøjer, opbygninger og tekniske problemstillinger.

·     Mulighed for at blive endnu dygtigere – vi tilbyder relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

·     Ordentlige rammer – gode arbejdsforhold, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone.

·     En arbejdsplads med retning – du bliver en del af en landsdækkende specialistvirksomhed med stolte håndværkstraditioner og stor efterspørgsel.


 

Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en faglig baggrund som mekaniker eller reparatør – eller solid erfaring, der giver dig et stærkt teknisk fundament. Du arbejder selvstændigt, men trives også i et team, hvor man lykkes sammen.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:

·     har erfaring med mekanisk montage, fejlfinding og service

·     har flair for hydraulik og el – eller lyst til at lære mere

·     er kvalitetsbevidst og følger opgaven helt til dørs

·     er fleksibel, serviceminded og har forståelse for kundens behov

·     har kørekort til kategori B

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt mekanisk fundament, tager ansvar for kvaliteten og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med os.

Om SAWO

SAWO leverer, opbygger og servicerer kraner, hejs, ladopbygninger, lifte og specialudstyr til transport- og entreprenørbranchen. Med værksteder og servicepunkter over hele Danmark hjælper vi kunderne hurtigt og kompetent – fra rådgivning og specialopbygning til service, reparation og reservedele.

Bag hver løsning står mennesker med høj faglighed og respekt for godt håndværk. Det gælder også dig, hvis du bliver vores nye kollega.

Klar til næste skridt?0

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Oliver Cox på oco@sawo.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet eller hverdagen på værkstedet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Oliver Cox på telefon 27 74 76 81.

jobs.title: Skal du have en plads bag rattet i en af Aarhus’ ambulancer?
jobs.description:
Præhospitalet søger lige nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være en del den regionale ambulancetjeneste i Aarhusområdet. 

Du får hjemmebase på Præhospitalets største base på Bautavej i Aarhus V, hvor du bliver en del af et stærkt, kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi har en ledig stilling i DAN-vagtrul til besættelse 1. november 2026, eller efter aftale. Her får du 12-timers vagter i rækkefølgen 6-18, 11-23, 18-06 og 5 fridøgn

Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet paramediciner eller ambulancebehandler med autorisation. Du skal være fagligt velfunderet og opdateret inden for dit felt, og du skal have vist, at du tager ansvar for egen faglig udvikling og uddannelse.

Du kommer til at indgå i en organisation, der har fokus på både at løse de daglige opgaver, og hvor opgaverne er under fortsat udvikling. Vi håber, at du vil bidrage til en konstruktiv og løsningsorienteret samarbejdskultur – på tværs af faggrupper og organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Der vil således blive lagt vægt på dine evner til at samarbejde og til at bidrage til et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab i ambulancerne og i Præhospitalet som helhed. 

Du skal have kørekort kategori B og C. 

Der indhentes straffeattest og børneattest.

Din nye arbejdsplads
Præhospitalet har ansvaret for det præhospitale område i Region Midtjylland, og vores hovedopgave og vision er ”at sikre rette hjælp i rette tid til alle patienter”. Præhospitalet har som de øvrige hospitaler i regionen både drifts-, behandlings-, uddannelses-, kvalitetssikrings- og forskningsmæssige opgaver. I Præhospitalet møder du kolleger med mange forskellige fagligheder, og fælles for alle er, at vi stræber efter at gøre det bedste for patienterne.

I Præhospitalet lægger vi vægt på høj faglighed, uddannelse og udvikling. Det håber vi også, at du gør, for kompetencevedligehold og efteruddannelse bliver en lige så fast del af dit arbejde som udrykning og behandling af patienter. Derfor skal du også selv have et ønske om at styrke din egen faglighed og udvikling. Det gør du selvfølgelig ikke alene – for vi hjælper og støtter hinanden, og der er kort vej fra medarbejdere til ledelsen. Vi vil gerne være en attraktiv og rummelig arbejdsplads, og du skal kunne se dig selv som en del af et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og meget gerne bidrage til det fælles arbejdsmiljø. 

Du bliver ansat i Præhospitalets afdeling for ambulancer og akutlægebiler. Afdelingen ledes af en afdelingsledelse, som består af en ambulancechef og en cheflæge, samt en funktionsledelse bestående af 11 funktionsledere. Funktionslederne varetager personaleledelsen af ambulancepersonalet samt den daglige drift.

Du kommer til at referere til funktionsleder Morten Herlev.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold i henhold til overenskomst med FOA.

Mail: M.Herlev@rm.dk 
Tlf.: 51152151

Du søger nemt stillingen via linket "send ansøgning" nederst på siden. Her bliver du bedt om at udfylde nogle oplysninger om dig selv (navn, adresse mv.) samt vedhæfte en motiveret ansøgning og et opdateret CV.

Ansættelsesproces
Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 24. august 2026. Samtaler afholdes d. 26. august på Olof Palmes Allé i Aarhus N.

 

 


Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

jobs.title: Early morning deliverer, Turku region
jobs.description:
Keep your days free - become an early morning deliverer!

Are you looking for a job that leaves your days free for studies, hobbies, family life, or other commitments? Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu regularly offers delivery work in Turku and the surrounding municipalities. The job is an excellent fit for students, early risers, and anyone looking for additional income.

Please note that we do not always have an open delivery route available immediately in every area. We continuously interview candidates and maintain a recruitment pool for different locations. This allows us to quickly contact suitable applicants when a route becomes available near their home.

We invite applicants to interviews based on their place of residence and anticipated recruitment needs in different areas. Bicycle delivery routes are typically offered within approximately 5 kilometres of the applicant's home address.

What is the job like?

As a deliverer, you will work approximately 3-5 hours per night, typically between 1:00 a.m. and 6:00 a.m.

The work consists of delivering newspapers, magazines, and addressed mail along a pre-defined route. The standard shift pattern is six consecutive working nights followed by two nights off, providing a predictable work rhythm and helping you plan your free time.

Delivery routes and equipment

- In Turku, deliveries are primarily carried out using a bicycle provided by the employer.
- Outside Turku, routes are completed using either your own car or a company vehicle.
- When a route requires the use of your own car, mileage compensation is paid according to the applicable rate.

Pay and training

- Pay is based on the collective agreement between the Finnish Media Federation and the Industrial Union.
- The average earnings for a new deliverer, including applicable supplements, are approximately €12-13 per hour.
- You will receive paid onboarding, including daytime training and practical guidance on your own route during night shifts.
- In addition, we pay a €900 orientation bonus during the first nine months of employment.

What we offer

- Permanent or fixed-term employment depending on your preferences and available routes
- Comprehensive training and support from the start
- A predictable and stable work schedule
- Independent work with a high degree of responsibility
- An active job that keeps you moving
- Occupational healthcare
- Five weeks of paid annual holiday
- TS Group employee benefits, including a Turun Sanomat subscription and wellbeing benefits
- The opportunity to start work quickly when a suitable route becomes available in your area

What we expect from you

- At least 18 years of age
- Good English or Finnish language skills
- Reasonable physical fitness
- A careful, responsible, and independent working attitude
- Ability and willingness to work at night
- A valid residence permit and the right to work in Finland

Interested?

Apply easily by clicking the "Apply" button below.

Please note that applications submitted by email cannot be processed.

This job posting is available in both English and Finnish. You only need to apply through one of them.

After reviewing applications, we invite selected candidates to interviews and maintain a recruitment pool for future delivery opportunities in different areas.

About Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu

Lounais-Suomen Tietojakelu is responsible for the early morning delivery of newspapers, magazines, and addressed mail across 25 municipalities in Southwestern Finland. We employ approximately 500 deliverers and are part of the TS Group.

Our main delivery product is Turun Sanomat, the leading newspaper in the Turku region. As Finland's second-largest newspaper distribution company, we play an important role in ensuring reliable deliveries every day of the year.

Apply today and be ready to start when the right delivery route becomes available near you.

jobs.title: Go-to-Market Responsible
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning product direction into commercially successful go-to-market plans? Are you motivated by bringing collections to life across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels? And do you thrive in the role that connects Product, Brand Identity and commercial execution?

Then you may be the Go-to-Market Responsible we are looking for.

YOUR TEAM
You'll join our E-Commerce & DTC Marketing team, where we bring our collections to market across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels. As our GTM Responsible, you'll work closely with specialists across CRM, Media, Retail & E-Commerce while partnering with Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications to ensure every launch is successfully planned and delivered.

YOUR ROLE
As our Go-to-Market Responsible, you'll own the annual DTC go-to-market plan, translating product direction into commercially successful market launches. Working closely with Product, Brand Identity and key business stakeholders, you'll shape go-to-market plans that connect product direction with commercial execution across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels.
You'll ensure product direction is translated into clear plans, strong cross-functional collaboration and successful execution, bringing launches to market on time and supporting both revenue growth and brand awareness.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Developing and driving the annual DTC go-to-market plan

  • Translating product direction into campaign and rollout plans

  • Planning and coordinating market launches across retail, e-commerce and other consumer-facing channels

  • Driving timelines and cross-functional execution from planning to launch

  • Coordinating stakeholders across Product, Brand Identity and B2B Communications

  • Using commercial performance and brand insights to optimize future go-to-market planning.

YOUR BENEFITS
This is a role for someone who enjoys making things happen. You'll work in a fast-moving environment where every collection presents new opportunities to improve, simplify and strengthen the way we go to market. If you're motivated by creating clarity, driving progress and seeing your work make a commercial difference, you'll find plenty of room to do so here.

YOUR PROFILE
You're at your best when bringing people, plans and commercial priorities together. You enjoy working across functions, balancing different perspectives and turning product direction into successful go-to-market activities.
Whether your background is in fashion or another consumer-focused industry, what matters to us is that you understand what it takes to create relevant consumer communication that resonates with end consumers.

In addition, we’re looking for someone who brings the following:

  • A relevant degree in Marketing, Communication or a related field

  • 4+ years of experience within DTC marketing, campaign planning or go-to-market planning

  • Experience planning and executing campaigns across multiple consumer-facing channels, including media planning and rollout.

  • Strong project management skills with experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives

  • A commercial, analytical and KPI-driven mindset, using data and insights to support decision-making.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Eileen Elbers at +45 52 15 40 73. Otherwise, please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than 11 September 2026. We review candidates on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Vastuumyyjä, S-market Lieto, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIETO

Etsimme VASTUUMYYJÄÄ S-market Lietoon!
Tehtävä on vakituinen 37,5 tuntia viikossa. Työt olisi tarkoitus aloittaa sopimuksen mukaan syyskuun lopulla.

Vastuumyyjänä varmistat kaupan arjen sujuvuuden ja asiakastyytyväisyyden yhdessä marketpäällikön ja apulaispäällikön kanssa. S-marketissa työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia. Vastuualueenasi on varmistaa kassatoimintojen ja verkkokauppatilausten sujuva toiminta sekä huolehtia panimo- ja juomaosaston saatavuudesta ja esillepanoista. Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluvat asiakaspalvelu, hyllytys, sekä yleinen järjestely ja siivous. Vastuumyyjänä priorisoit työtehtäviä ja organisoit vuoroa, sekä varmistat että tieto kulkee vuorojen välillä. Kaupassa työskentely on fyysistä, sillä liikumme päivän aikana paljon, nostamme ja siirrämme tavaraa ja olemme koko päivän jaloillamme. Työtä tehdään vaihtelevissa vuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin, työajan kuitenkin painottuessa aamuihin klo 6.00-16.00 välille.

Olet etsimämme vastuumyyjä, jos olet asiakaslähtöinen sekä toimit luontevasti sekä tiimissä että yksin. Pystyt johtamaan vuoroa ja huolehdit myymälän kunnosta. Olet tehokas ja motivoitunut työntekijä, joka tarttuu oma-aloitteisesti eri työtehtäviin ja haluat oppia uutta. Edellytämme sinulta aiempaa työkokemusta myyjän työstä. Eduksi katsomme myös kokemuksen vastuutehtävistä.

Vastuumyyjän palkka perustuu Kaupan alan työehtosopimukseen sekä tehtäväkohtaiseen vastuulisään, ja on koulutuksesta sekä kokemusvuosista riippuen2153-2448€/kk. Vuorotyössä ilta- ja viikonloppulisät tuovat mukavaa lisää peruspalkan päälle. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kannustepalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1,20 € per tehty työtunti.

Liity meidän porukkaan, niin tarjoamme sinulle:
Ihan tavallisia töitä, epätavallisen hyvillä henkilöstöeduilla! Työskennellessäsi meillä, saat rahanarvoisia ostoetuja S-etukortillasi, kuten S-ryhmän ravintoloista –25 %,Sokos ja Emotion myymälöistä -15 % tai autopesusta –50 %

Kuulut kannustepalkkion piiriin, jonka maksimimäärä on jopa 1,20 € / tehty työtunti. Työskennellessäsi 30 h/vko sopimustunneilla kannustepalkkion määrä voi siis olla jopa noin 140 euroa kuukaudessa

Työpäiviä poikkeuksellisen rennossa porukassa yhdessä Suomen innostavimmassa työpaikassa

Mahdollisuuden kerryttää osaamista sekä lisätienestiä tekemällä lisävuoroja muissakin S-market myymälöissä sekä kaikissa TOK:n toimipaikoissa koko Varsinais-Suomen alueella

Kattavan perehdytyksen työtehtävääsi ja mahdollisuuden ammatilliseen kasvuun, jota tukevat S-ryhmän monipuoliset oppimis- ja valmennusmahdollisuudet



Jos ihan tavalliset työt houkuttaa, laita hakemusta tulemaan 25.8. mennessä! Me ollaan sinuun yhteydessä sähköpostitse tai puhelimitse 010 764 –alkuisesta numerosta. Kannattaa seurata myös roskapostia, sillä meidän viestit voivat eksyä myös sinne.

Haluaisitko kuulla lisää tehtävästä ja Turun Osuuskaupasta? 📞 Lisätietoja antaa marketpäällikkö Päivi Mesimäki. Päivin tavoitat parhaiten arkisin klo 9–15 numerosta 010 764 3016.


Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.
