jobs.title: Manager Accounting (m/f)
jobs.employer: IQ EQ Corporate Services (Luxembourg) S.à r.l.
jobs.description:
Manager Accounting - ITAA Certified

Department: Core Team Accounting

Reporting Line: Reports to the Head of Pool in Luxembourg

Role Purpose

The manager acts as a hands-on a technical expert within the Core Team Accounting contributing to high-quality client delivery achieves impact through technical oversight, review, guidance and knowledge transfer.

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis) & Responsibilities

1. Technical Oversight and Quality Assurance

- Act as a technical reviewer for accounting deliverables prepared by team members and GCD, including:

• Bookkeeping
• Annual financial statements
• Management and regulatory reporting
• BCL reports
• CIT and VAT returns and related tax calculations

- Ensure that work delivered complies with:

• Applicable accounting standards (BeGAAP, Lux GAAP; IFRS / US GAAP where relevant)
• Internal procedures and quality standards
• Regulatory and client‑specific requirements

- Identify technical risks, inconsistencies, or errors and ensure appropriate remediation.

2. Portfolio and Client Support

- Manage a portfolio of clients (primarily SPVs and alternative investment funds located both in Belgium and in Luxembourg), acting as the technical reference for accounting matters.
- Review accounting output prepared for the portfolio and assist with complex client requests.
- Support clients and internal teams during closing processes, reporting cycles, tax reportings, audits, and exceptional transactions.
- Assist with liquidation processes and structurally complex cases as required.

3. Technical Guidance and Knowledge Transfer

- Provide technical guidance and feedback to Accounting and GCD teams, without exercising line‑management authority.
- Transfer technical knowledge through:

• On‑the‑job guidance
• Targeted trainings on accounting standards, processes, or regulatory topics
• Written guidance, checklists, or technical notes

- Act as a point of escalation for complex technical accounting questions.

4. Cross‑Functional and External Collaboration

- Collaborate closely with Corporate Secretarial, Tax, and other internal departments to ensure consistent and accurate client delivery.
- Maintain professional relationships with external service providers, including auditors, tax advisers, law firms, and banks.
- Support onboarding of new or complex structures by assessing accounting, reporting, and tax implications.

5. Process, Tools, and Continuous Improvement

- Ensure correct and timely use of internal systems and tools (e.g. Navigator WF, Navigator Doc, QICS).
- Verify adherence to internal procedures and participate in process reviews.

The skills required for this role are outlined in the job profile in the MyCareer platform.

Key behaviours we expect to see in this role

• Strong technical accounting expertise and sound professional judgement
• Ability to review, challenge, and validate accounting work
• Clear and pragmatic communication skills, enabling effective knowledge transfer
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively across teams
• Structured, solution‑oriented approach to complex issues
• Collaborative and approachable, acting as a technical partner
• Proactive in identifying risks, technical gaps, or improvement opportunities
• Takes ownership for technical output and quality of work
• Resilient and organised, able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
• Reliable technical expert to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders

Requirements

• Education: Bachelor/BAC+5: Accountancy/Business Administration
• At least 6-8 years of experience in Accounting
• Computer/program knowledge: Microsoft office, Demasy
• Strong technical accounting (Lux GAAP) skills are essential, IFRS and US GAAP will be an asset
• Registered with and fully licenced by the Belgian Institute for Tax Advisors and Accountants (ITAA)
Languages: Native French or Dutch, Fluent in English and French/Dutch, any other language would be an advantage

• Monitor and remediate long-term profitability of client relationships
• Develop and implement initiatives to remediate less profitable client relationships to acceptable standards
• Understanding new services/developments within IQ-EQ and responsible for identifying and maximising business development opportunities within client portfolio
• Actively monitor and identify key areas and ensure operations team have appropriate remediation plans in place to address these

• Cash collection: ensure lockup days of client portfolio does not exceed 60 days (definition of lock up period as provided by IQ-EQ finance)
• Play an active role in developing and executing initiatives to grow the portfolio of clients and grow revenue per client

• Build a strong external network with Business Partners and industry associations
• Actively participate in business development and Thought Leadership events and represent IQ-EQ externally
• Participate actively in client pitching processes together with global and local commercial teams and ensure a seamless and effective onboarding process alongside Business Implementation team
• Act as an escalation point for complex matters and complaints and pro-actively work together with Client Services Directors, Head of Delivery and Subject Matter Expert to resolve them. Promote a feedback culture aiming at continuous service improvement
• Manage the financial and contractual relationship with the client. Reviews/renegotiates agreements if and when needed. Analysis of client / account performance to improve the relationship and profitability (lockup days, account profitability, scope, revenue trends, competitive analysis, perceived quality and account mapping.)
• Ultimate escalation point for cash collection

Deliverables (KPI's)

• Revenue growth generated in line with targets
• New busines growth in line with conversion target
• Outbound commercial collaboration in line with target leads and opportunities generated
• Client churn other than natural EOL (End Of Life).

About the SnT
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.
The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Signal Processing and Communications Research Group (SIGCOM) under the supervision of Prof. Symeon Chatzinotas at the University of Luxembourg.
Ever-evolving intelligent connectivity systems require increasingly efficient systems to transmit, analyze, and reconstruct high-quality data. The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. Fields of applications range from 6G telecommunications to satellite-based internet connectivity and quantum internet. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. Prospective researchers will find a large and vibrant team of over 100 members fostering a collaborative atmosphere. The group consistently publishes in top 10% venues, approaching 200 papers per year, supported by 60 running research projects.

Your role
• Conduct research and technology transfer in the area of advanced and intelligent wireless communications networks, with emphasis in the next-generation 6G cellular networks and non-terrestrial components
• Have the potential to build/lead a research team within the SIGCOM Research Group at SnT
• SIGCOM conducts research in close collaboration with the industry/government partners and is engaged in a number of European/International projects. The candidate will contribute to the definition, acquisition, and management of research projects together with other faculty or as a principal investigator
• Supervise PhD students in relevant topics with other faculty or as principal supervisor
• Ensure continuity in the laboratory/experimental research activities, international visibility and recruitment efforts
• Design and deliver Bachelor and Master level classes in computer science, wireless communications and/or optical-quantum communications, in the Bachelor in Engineering, or at the Masters belonging to FSTM Faculté des Sciences, des Technologies et de Médecine

The candidate detailed mission is to:
• Acquire, manage and contribute to research, innovations, and technology transfer activities with private and public partners
• Disseminate scientific results in top 10% conferences/journals
• Independently supervise PhD candidates and junior research associates
• Prepare and contribute to European and National research proposals to sustain the group's strategic research

Your profile
• PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or other relevant field
• At least 4 years of PostDoc research experience in relevant research area(s). Documented research expertise in:
o next-generation wireless communications and networking paradigms, non-terrestrial communications, quantum and optical communications, edge computing, telecom artificial intelligence, multi-functional systems (communications, sensing, positioning, computing), antenna and beamforming design and practical validation of technologies in Lab environment
• Proven track record in carrying a leading role in research project acquisition and project management
• Experience in research collaboration with industrial and international partners
• Experience in supporting PhD candidates in their research

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must demonstrate an excellent command of English (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn French or German and provides access to language courses to this end.

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee.

More than a traditional business support role, this position acts as a strategic advisor and internal consultant to the CFO. You will tackle complex business challenges, drive transformation initiatives, support executive decision-making, and work across the organization to deliver strategic outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for a former consultant or strategy professional seeking direct exposure to executive leadership and the ability to influence the direction of a leading financial institution.


Your next challenge:


1. Strategy Advisory & Information Management

Act as a trusted sparring partner to the CFO on strategic, organizational and business topics.
Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.


2. Operational Support & Execution

Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.


3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.


4. Project Leadership

Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.
Act as an internal consultant on key business priorities, including organisational transformation, operating model improvements and strategic initiatives.


Your skills:

Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
Minimum 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, with a strong preference for candidates having gained experience in a top-tier consulting firm or a comparable strategic advisory, transformation or Chief of Staff environment.
Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
Solid understanding of finance.
Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats. This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

About the SnT
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB) is an interdisciplinary research centre of the University of Luxembourg.
We conduct fundamental and translational research in the field of Systems Biology and Biomedicine – in the lab, in the clinic and in silico. We focus on neurodegenerative processes and are especially interested in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and their contributing factors. The LCSB recruits talented scientists from various disciplines: computer scientists, mathematicians, biologists, chemists, engineers, physicists and clinicians from more than 50 countries currently work at the LCSB. The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and environment we live in.

Your role:

1. Events Organisation - Primary Focus

• Take ownership of the end to end organisation of Faculty events (e.g. conferences, seminars, workshops, public outreach events, summer parties, team retreats, graduation), from preparation to execution and follow up.
• Support management, departments and research groups in the conceptualisation and planning of events (format, audience, objectives, programme, speakers).

• Coordinate with administrative assistants for POs, invoices and other administrative steps, ensuring they receive clear information.
• Promote events via appropriate channels in collaboration with the communication team and maintain the Faculty event calendar, in line with GDPR requirements.

1. Communication - Supporting Role

• Contribute to the execution of the FSTM communication plan, under the guidance of senior communication colleagues.
• Support internal and external communication related to events (e.g. short announcements, event information, inputs for newsletters, web and social media content),
• Assist in keeping the Faculty website and social media inputs up to date for events, and in producing basic event related promotional materials (e.g. invitations, flyers, badges) in line with the Faculty's visual identity.
• Help maintain communication files and archives related to events (photos, materials, media clippings).

1. Administration & Stakeholder Relations

• Act as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders on event related organisational and communication matters.
• Coordinate with Faculty administration and central services on administrative aspects linked to events (e.g. POs, invoices, supplier contracts), providing accurate information and follow up.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Communication, Marketing, Journalism, Event Management or a related field, or equivalent by experience.
• 0 to 4 years of relevant working experience in communication and/or event organisation, ideally in an academic, research or international environment.
• Experience in event planning and logistics management.

• Strong organisational and coordination skills, with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
• Comfortable taking responsibility for the operational organisation of events, while collaborating closely with colleagues on content and communication aspects.
• Good interpersonal skills; ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with academics, administrative staff, students and external providers.
• Proficiency with digital communication tools (e.g. MS Office, basic content management for web, social media platforms).
• Familiarity with graphic design tools (e.g. Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) is an asset.
• Ability to work collaboratively in a multicultural, multilingual environment.
• Comfortable working under guidance and general instructions, with support from more senior colleagues in the communication team.
• Knowledge of GDPR principles as applied to communication databases and event registrations is an asset.

Language Requirements

• Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.
• Very good knowledge of French (B1-B2 level) mainly for external interactions.
• Knowledge of German and/or Luxembourgish is a strong asset, given the multilingual character of the University.

About us
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Learning Centre (LLC) is the University's hub for knowledge sharing, research support and academic collaboration. With over 14,000 m² of dedicated library space and an extensive collection (282 databases, 60k (e-)journals, 827k e-books and 200k books), the LLC serves as a foundation for student learning, research and faculty engagement. The LLC works closely with faculties and interdisciplinary centres to ensure library resources match evolving learning, teaching and research needs.
As the University expands both its health education programs at the Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) (medicine, nursing sciences, midwifery sciences, medical technical radiology assistant and prospective Master in Medicine) and research centres (Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine), we are looking for a Librarian Specialist with a primary focus in Medicine & Health Sciences to join the University library. The position currently serves also other STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics) subjects, but will play a pivotal role as medical and health sciences grow, including supporting the future Faculty of Medicine.

The University | About us...
The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.

People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed. The cohesion of liberal societies increasingly depends on high-quality, participatory human services spanning social, educational, and cultural domains. Strategies for reducing barriers to service uptake and enhancement, including through the co-production of specialist knowledge, are essential for the legitimacy of services and underlying policies. The University of Luxembourg aims to play a key role in this public-facing co-productive knowledge landscape. Data Management Senior Officer
Locations Luxembourg
Time type Full time
Job requisition id JR000687

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:
‎
Senior Data Management Officer (DMO)

Your Role:

You will join the Data Management Office (DMO) and play a key role in driving its implementation, governance and continuous development. The DMO has a broader remit covering the quality, integrity and lifecycle management of Client, Payor, Matter and related master data across the firm. Your responsibilities include:

• Driving the design, rollout and continuous improvement of the DMO operating model, including scope, roles, controls, governance routines and interfaces with other departments;
• Defining, maintaining and enforcing firm-wide standards for Client, Payor, Matter and related master data, including validation rules, ownership principles and escalation paths;
• Overseeing the DMO contribution to the redesigned Central Business Intake process and ensuring that key information is validated before being introduced or amended in the firm's systems;
• Designing and supervising centralised processes for entity lifecycle management in our ERP, including legal name changes, address changes, corporate actions, record inactivation, mergers and other third-party data events;
• Leading duplicate prevention, analysis and clean-up initiatives, prioritising remediation backlogs and coordinating stakeholders to address root causes;
• Structuring and leading third-party data enrichment activities, including VAT ID, EUID, business register ID and other identifiers required for reliable operations, compliance, billing and reporting;
• Coordinating with owners of satellite applications to ensure that major master data changes are shared and reflected consistently across systems;
• Leading or contributing to transformation projects impacting master datas, including requirements definition, testing, deployment, adoption and post-implementation follow-up;
• Creating and maintaining DMO procedures, working instructions, control checklists, data dictionaries, accountability matrices, training materials, KPIs and management reporting;
• Coaching DMO Officer(s), reviewing complex cases and promoting a culture of data accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.

Your Profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience, in finance operations, data governance, process management, business transformation or a comparable field;
• You have significant experience in master data management, data quality, data governance, process excellence or cross-functional operations;
• You have proven experience leading implementation, data clean-up, operating model or transformation projects;
• You are able to define standards, controls, KPIs, procedures and practical governance routines;
• You combine strong analytical and documentation skills with a pragmatic approach to implementation;

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance (FDEF) at the University of Luxembourg offers a unique academic and research environment.
Rooted in Luxembourg but with a European and international outlook, teaching and research benefit from the proximity of the European institutions, Luxembourg's leading international financial centre and its vibrant business community. Institutional and private sector partnerships, sponsored Chairs and a growing network of international partner universities make the FDEF a dynamic academic hub at the heart of Europe.

Your role

You will:

• Conduct independent research in the above-mentioned fields and contribute to the Department's and Faculty's research strategy, in particular on sustainability: environmental, social and institutional

• Excellent communication and writing skills, and motivation to contribute to the strategic development of the Department of Law and the Faculty

jobs.title: Senior AI/ML & Data Engineer + technical Lead (m/f)
jobs.description:
The position to be filled

adwäisEO is looking for an experienced AI & Data Technical lead to define and drive the technical strategy of its data team in support of innovative Earth Observation (EO) data valorization, and to carry out projects as project manager, expert, developer or operator in a small team of 3 people to be embedded in a larger team made of the grouping of sister companies' teams.

The role is centered around the survey, design, development, optimization and deployment of state-of-the-art machine learning/deep learning algorithms as well as the training & deployment of generative AI models (geo-VLM) to enhance current workflow on EO imagery processing & analysis.

The candidate will work on the development of deep learning and AI processes to support the generation of innovative new data derived information. The activities will include the development of advanced models and pipelines such as foundation model for EO data, Vision transformers and attention-based architecture for multimodal dataset and scalable workflows leveraging High-Performance Computing (HPC).

She/he will be contributing to:

    • Survey of and feedback on technological progress in the deep learning and machine learning technology evolution in the domain,
    • Design and development of deep learning algorithms for EO imagery and related datasets
    • Development of related documentation (Algorithm baseline, functional analysis)
    • Definition of data requirement for processing chain.
    • Writing engineering documentation and technical reports in English.
    • Participation to the Bids and proposals.

Must Have Requirements

Profile

• 5-8 years of experience in AI and data science algorithm development (preferable for satellite Remote Sensing or imagery/video data).

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

• Experience with Deep Learning and/or simple Machine Learning techniques, attention- based architecture, foundation model (adapting, fine-tuning, evaluating and, where relevant, pre-training foundation models for Earth Observation data -Vision and Large Language models in particular);
• Proficiency in python with solid object-oriented programming practices and experience building modular, scalable pipelines;
• Strong hands-on proficiency in PyTorch; (familiarity with TensorFlow or other ML frameworks is an advantage);
• Hands-on experience with popular specialized libraries (rasterio, xarray, geopandas, terratorch);
• Familiarity with Linux environments;
• Knowledge of Rest API for querying EO data repositories (e.g. STAC), with expertise in creating, validating, and maintaining robust training datasets;
• Demonstrated experience deploying machine learning or deep learning models in production environments;
• Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized AI applications;
• Experience designing, developing and maintaining model inference APIs or services;
• Good understanding of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, versioning and retraining;
• Hands-on experience with GPU-based training and/or inference, HPC/Slurm;
• Practical experience with at least one production computing environment, such as cloud platforms, Kubernetes-based infrastructures or HPC systems.

Behavior skills (Soft Skills)

• Analytical, critical and proactive mind;
• Very good task prioritization and organization: ability to allocate tasks and track progress;
• Very good technical mentoring (supporting and upskilling junior profiles);
• Very good communication skills: acting as the link between the technical team and management/other departments;
• Fluency in English (spoken and written) is essential;
• High degree of autonomy and decision-making;
• Versatility: comfortable operating at a hands-on capacity while coordinating the team's work.

Being considered as a plus:

• Knowledge of other programming or coding languages such as IDL, C, C++;
• Experience with physical modelling (e.g. hydraulic, hydrology, crop, …);
• MLOps Skills (Docker, microservices);
• Experience with HPC, distributed training, or GPU-accelerated computation;
• Knowledge of Satellite data processing;
• PostDoc in Remote Sensing or ML.

What we offer

❖ A professional, stimulating and human working environment in IT & Earth Observation Data sector based on proximity management,
❖ A real possibility of evolution depending on your involvement in your work,
❖ Lunch vouchers,
❖ Supplementary Health insurance,
❖ Bonuses,

❖ Free car park

Why Join Us?

❖ Be part of innovative projects with strong impact in high-tech and strategic sectors.
❖ Work in an agile, ambitious environment at the heart of a fast-growing industry.
❖ Contribute to the development of cutting-edge solutions and help shape the future of our business.

The company builds and scales brands that serve Cambodiaâs fast-growing consumer and digital economy, combining operational excellence with strategic partnerships and market insight.   • Bachelorâs degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field; professional HR or compensation certification is an advantage.

jobs.title: Kokenut huskyopas Pure Lapland / Wild Husky Rovaniemi Oylle
jobs.description:
**Kokenut huskyopas – tule mukaan Lapin talvikauteen!**

Onko sinulla kokemusta huskyvaljakon ajamisesta ja asiakkaiden opastamisesta? Nautitko vauhdikkaista työpäivistä, koirien kanssa työskentelystä ja Lapin talvesta? **Etsimme kokenutta huskyopasta vahvistamaan tiimiämme tulevalle talvikaudelle.**

Työtehtäväsi

Huskyoppaana vastaat asiakkaidemme turvallisesta ja elämyksellisestä retkestä alusta loppuun. Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- huskyretkien opastaminen ja valjakon ajaminen

- moottorikelkalla huskyretkien valvonta

- asiakkaiden perehdyttäminen valjakkoajoon ja turvallisuusohjeisiin

- huskyjen hoitoon, ruokintaan ja hyvinvointiin liittyvät päivittäiset tehtävät

- varusteiden ja työympäristön kunnossapito

- asiakaspalvelu kansainvälisessä ympäristössä


Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea **henkilöä, jolla on jo käytännön kokemusta huskyoppaan työstä**. Osaat toimia itsenäisesti, vastuullisesti ja rauhallisesti myös kiireisinä päivinä ja vaihtelevissa talviolosuhteissa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, reipasta työotetta sekä kykyä tulla toimeen niin koirien kuin ihmistenkin kanssa. **Hyvä englannin kielen taito on tärkeä**, sillä suuri osa asiakkaistamme saapuu ulkomailta. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.

Arvostamme erityisesti positiivista asennetta, luotettavuutta, joustavuutta sekä aitoa kiinnostusta koirien hyvinvointiin ja laadukkaiden asiakaskokemusten luomiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden työskennellä siperianhuskyjen, kansainvälisten asiakkaiden ja Lapin luonnon keskellä. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen työyhteisön sekä työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole aivan samanlainen.

**Jos huskyt, vauhdikas ulkotyö ja Lapin talvi ovat sinun juttusi, saatat olla juuri etsimämme henkilö.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi huskyjen ja opastustyön parissa. **Kokenut huskyopas saa meiltä paikan – hae mukaan!**

jobs.title: Job i Malaga? Book et kald med os i dag og hør alt om vores danske kontor og fællesskab i Malaga centrum.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at arbejde i solen? ☀️ Vi søger nye kollegaer til vores danske kontor i Malaga. Book et kald med os i dag, så tager vi en uforpligtende snak om hvad vi kan tilbyde.

Vil du være en del af et dynamisk og socialt team, hvor du kan opbygge stærke relationer og gøre en positiv forskel? Så har vi plads til dig på vores danske kontor i Malaga!

Vi søger engagerede fundraisere til at kontakte potentielle donorer og præsentere vores NGO-projekter. Dit arbejde vil bidrage til at skabe øget bevidsthed om, hvor lidt der skal til for at gøre en stor forskel. Du vil samarbejde tæt med teamet for at sikre støtte til vores projekter.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fast løn efter kvalifikationer og en kontrakt med ordnede forhold.

  • Faste arbejdstider med fri om aftenen og i weekenderne.

  • Betalt frokost på arbejdet.

  • Løbende træning i salgskommunikation og personlig udvikling.

  • Et socialt og støttende arbejdsmiljø med et stærkt fællesskab.

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for salg og ledelse.

Hvem er du?

  • Du har en passion for velgørenhed og ønsker at gøre en forskel.

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og opbygge relationer.

  • Du arbejder selvstændigt, men er også en teamplayer.

  • Du er åben for at lære og udvikle nye færdigheder.

  • Du kan arbejde fuldtid i en periode på minimum 4-6 måneder.

Hvem er vi?

Vores danske kontor i Málaga har eksisteret siden 2012, og vi støtter forskellige NGO-projekter. Kontoret er kendt for sin inkluderende kultur og stærke sammenhold. Her bliver du en del af et team med 50 kollegaer på tværs af aldersgrupper, og du møder alle ansatte i løbet af dagen.

Arbejdsplads og miljø

  • Vi har et inspirerende og socialt arbejdsmiljø med en flad ledelsesstruktur.

  • Fokus på fællesskab, engagement og respekt.

  • Teammøder fyldt med energi og humor.

  • En kultur, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed og inklusion.

  • Vi tror på, at alle kan gøre en forskel!

Vil du være en del af vores team?

Uanset om du allerede bor i Málaga eller overvejer at flytte hertil, så er du velkommen hos os! Kom forbi vores kontor, drik en kop kaffe hvis du er i nærhenden og oplev vores unikke fællesskab. Du er også velkommen til abre at sende en ansøgning og så tager vi en snak med dig om muligheden.

Du kan se kontoret og kulturen på dette link

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?
At tage til udlandet og arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kan være en berigende oplevelse, både personligt og professionelt.

Her er nogle fordele, det kan have for din karriere fremadrettet:

  • Når du arbejder i udlandet, udvider du dine horisonter og får indsigt i forskellige kulturer og arbejdsmetoder.

  • Det gør dig mere åben og fleksibel, hvilket er værdifulde kvaliteter i et globalt arbejdsmarked.

  • Arbejde med fundraising over telefonen kræver stærke kommunikationsevner og evnen til at overbevise og engagere potentielle donorer. Disse kompetencer er eftertragtede i mange erhverv, da de viser, at du kan formidle budskaber effektivt og skabe positive relationer.

  • Derudover skaber du et internationalt netværk af kontakter og forbindelser, som kan være nyttige for din fremtidige karriere.

  • At have erfaring fra udlandet viser også, at du er initiativrig og villig til at tage chancer, hvilket kan imponere fremtidige arbejdsgivere.

  • Fundraising-arbejde kan føre til muligheder inden for marketing, salg, og nonprofit-organisationer, hvor dine kommunikative færdigheder og evnen til at opbygge relationer er afgørende.

  • Endelig viser det, at du kan tilpasse dig forskellige arbejdsmiljøer og håndtere udfordringer med positivt engagement. Dette gør dig til en attraktiv kandidat på arbejdsmarkedet, da virksomheder ofte søger medarbejdere, der kan navigere i en global kontekst og bidrage til deres vækst og udvikling.

Vil du med på holdet? Så grib chancen og ansøg nu! Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan også allerede nu booke en snak med os via dette link: Book et kald

jobs.title: Huoltoneuvoja
jobs.description:
Haemme kasvavaan joukkoomme **Huoltoneuvojaa**, jolla on jo kokemusta korjaamotoiminnasta ja joka viihtyy monipuolisessa asiakaspalvelu- ja työnjohtoroolissa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat autohuollon asiakaspalvelu, korjaamon työnjohto, ajanvaraukset, varaosatilaukset sekä päivittäinen yhteistyö asiakkaiden, asentajien ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Olet tärkeässä roolissa varmistamassa, että asiakkaan huoltokokemus on sujuva alusta loppuun.

**Meistä**

Autosta Oy on Espoon Muuralassa toimiva autohuolto- ja rengasalan yritys, jonka lisäksi harjoitamme kuljetusliiketoimintaa. Olemme osa arvostettuja **Mekonomen Autohuolto- ja Vianor-ketjuja**, mikä tarjoaa asiakkaillemme laadukkaat palvelut ja työntekijöillemme vahvan tuen päivittäiseen tekemiseen.

Liiketoimintamme kasvaa jatkuvasti, ja etsimme nyt motivoitunutta ammattilaista mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuttamme.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- Kokemusta autohuollon huoltoneuvojan tehtävistä tai korjaamotyöskentelystä

- Hyviä organisointi- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- Kykyä hallita useita asioita samanaikaisesti kiireisessäkin työympäristössä

- Sujuvaa tietokoneen ja erilaisten ohjelmistojen käyttöä

- Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa, sekä asiakaspalveluun riittävää englannin kielen osaamista

- Positiivista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- Kiinnostusta autoalaa ja sen jatkuvaa kehittymistä kohtaan

- Autoalan koulutus, tekninen osaaminen, sekä kokemus esimerkiksi AutoFutur korjaamojärjestelmästä katsotaan eduksi


**Mitä tarjoamme**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan

- Vakituisen työpaikan kasvavassa yrityksessä

- Mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työnkuvaasi ja yrityksen toimintatapojen kehittämiseen

- Joustavan työnantajan, joka arvostaa työntekijöidensä panosta

- Hyvät henkilöstöedut

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi autoalan ammattilaisena


**Arvostamme työn ja vapaa-ajan tasapainoa. Täysipäiväinen työ on mahdollista toteuttaa myös neljän arkipäivän työviikkona hieman pidemmillä työpäivillä. Lisäksi työskentelemme ainoastaan arkipäivisin, joten viikonloput jäävät vapaaksi.**

Meillä työtä tehdään hyvässä hengessä ja yhdessä joukkueena. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta, reipasta asennetta ja halua palvella asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

**Hae mukaan tiimiimme**

Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös palkkatoiveesi, jotta hakemus tulee huomioiduksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Santtu. Arjen kiireiden vuoksi pyydämme mahdolliset puhelintiedustelut arkipäivisin klo 17 jälkeen.

Hakemukset Santtu Niemiselle osoitteeseen etunimi.sukinimi@autosta.fi ja puhelintiedustelut numerosta nolla neljä nolla 555 29 23.

**Autosta Oy**_Pidetään autot liikkeellä, yhdessä._

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja, kotikuntoutus ja turva-auttamistiimi, Kirkkonummi
jobs.description:
Haemme lähihoitajia vakituisiin työsuhteisiin Kirkkonummen kotikuntoutustiimiin. Tehtävään kuuluu kotikuntoutuksen lisäksi vuoroja turva-auttamistehtävässä. Työskentelyalue voi tarpeen mukaan muuttua tai laajentua.

Kotikuntoutus toimii tiiviissä yhteistyössä muun muassa Läntisen sairaala-alueen, Seniori-infon ja alueellisen kotihoidon kanssa, vastateten sairaalasta kotiutuvien ikääntyneiden kotiutuksista, hoidosta ja kuntoutuksesta kotona, turva-auttamisen käynneistä, sekä palvelutarpeen arviosta yhdessä Seniori-infon kanssa.

Lähihoitajan työ kotikuntoutuksessa on asiakkaan kotona tapahtuvaa itsenäistä, asiakaslähtöistä ja kuntouttavaa hoitotyötä sisältäen perushoidon lisäksi sairaanhoidollisia tehtäviä. Tavoitteena on mahdollistaa asiakkaan toimivaa arkea ja tukea kotona asumista.

Lähihoitajan työhön kuuluvissa turva-auttamisvuoroissa keskeisiä vastuualueita ovat turva-auttamisasiakkaiden hälytystehtävien vastaanotto sähköisen hälytyskeskusjärjestelmän kautta ja vaihtuvien asiakkaiden kotiin jalkautuminen itsenäisesti. Asiakkaan luona tehdään tilannearvio ja arvio tämän kotikuntoisuudesta. Käynnillä annetaan asiakkaan tarvitsema välitön ensiapu ja muu tuki, arvioidaan lisäavun tarve ja tarvittaessa järjestetään se asiakkaalle. Käynneillä on mahdolisuus muiden ammattiryhmien konsutointiin.

Työhön kuuluu myös turvapuhelinten ja muiden turvalaitteiden asennus asiakkaille ja turvalaitteiden toiminnan tarkistaminen.

Kirjaaminen on iso osa niin kotikuntoutuksen kuin turva-auttamipalvelun työtä. Käynneillä tehdään kirjaukset Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmään sekä raportoidaan tarvittaessa eteenpäin toisille ammattilaisille. Yhteistyötä tehdään eri viranomaistahojen, kuten kotihoidon ja sosiaali- ja kriisipäivystyksen kanssa.

Työssä pääsee takuuvarmasti hyödyntämään monipuolisesti lähihoitajan osaamista!

Työssä korostuvat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot, vastuullisuus sekä tiimityöskentelytaidot. Työyksikkö ja esihenkilö ovat tukena ja varmistavat, että työ sujuu. Työ on moniammatillista. Tiimiin kuuluu lähihoitajien lisäksi sairaanhoitajia, fysioterapeutteja, sekä lääkäri.

Työ on jaksotyötä, johon kuuluu aamu- ja iltavuoroja sekä viikonlopputyötä.

Aloitamme haastattelut mahdollisesti jo hakuaikana, joten haethan pian - odotamme hakemustasi!

Työpaikan osoite: Jokiniityntie 2, 02400 Kirkkonummi
Työaika: 114h 45min/ 3 viikossa
Tehtävä on vakituinen.

Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus: Lähihoitajan nimikkeellä toimivalta edellytetään oikeutta käyttää tehtävään soveltuvaa nimikesuojattua ammattinimikettä. Eduksi katsotaan osaamisalana perustason ensihoito, sairaanhoito ja huolenpito tai pelastajatutkinnon perustason ensihoidon suuntautumisvaihtoehto.

Tehtävässä edellytetään:
- sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa
- ruotsin kielen taito on eduksi
- ajokortti on pakollinen
- lääkehoitolupa ei ole pakollinen, mutta se tulee suorittaa koeajan puitteissa

Toivomme, että
- ymmärrät kotona asumisen tuen palvelukokonaisuutta ja asiakastarpeita
- tunnet sote-alan päivystys- ja hätäkeskustoimintaa ja keskeisen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon lainsäädännön
- olet yhteistyötaitoinen: kohtaat ihmisiä rauhallisesti ja empaattisesti ja osaat arvioida asiakkaan tilanteen ja hoidon tarpeen nopeasti
- pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen yhteisten toimintamallien ja ohjeiden pohjalta
- sinulla on valmius itsenäiseen kenttätyöhön asiakkaiden kotona

Arvostamme
- ensiapuosaamista
- kokemusta ikääntyneiden hoitotyöstä ja voimassa olevat lääkeluvat
- uusien järjestelmien ketterä käyttöönottokyky
- aiempaa kokemusta työssä tarvittavista järjestelmistä (Lifecare potilastietojärjestelmä, hälytyskeskusjärjestelmä, turvalaitteiden hallintajärjestelmä ja sensoridatan analysointialusta)

Tehtävässä edellytetään myös tartuntatautilain 48§:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä tartuntatautilain §55 mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä.

Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.

1.1.2024 lukien tehtävään valitun on esitettävä itseään koskeva lain 741/2023 28 §:n mukainen iäkkäiden henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevän rikostaustan selvittämiseksi tarpeellinen rikosrekisteriote.


Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

jobs.title: Butcher / meat cutter
jobs.description:
Tenon Luonnontuote is looking for a skilled professional butcher for reindeer meat processing for autumn 2026.

The work starts at the beginning of October, when the reindeer season begins, and continues until the end of November.

Main duties: deboning and cutting reindeer meat, cutting and sawing meat, packing meat products, assisting in the production of meat products, other tasks related to meat processing.

We are looking for an experienced and reliable butcher with professional skills in meat cutting. Experience with reindeer meat is considered an advantage.

Language requirements: Finnish or English.

Free accommodation. We provide free accommodation next to the workplace for the entire duration of the employment.

Work in the beautiful Arctic North. Tenon Luonnontuote is located in Nuorgam, the northernmost village in Finland and the European Union, right next to the Norwegian border.

Working in Nuorgam offers a unique opportunity to experience the beautiful Arctic nature, spectacular landscapes, outdoor activities and, as autumn progresses, the possibility of seeing the Northern Lights.

jobs.title: Mechanical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Execute the TE systems works whilst coordinating closely and effectively with the involved (internal) stakeholders to optimize efficiency.

Plan, execute and register maintenance & repairs to the TE systems equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Thereby ensuring operational equipment in compliance with legislative-, safety- and user requirements.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Troubleshoot system during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle.

In the role of the Mechanical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, Operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

Qualifications:

The TE systems Mechanical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems technicians.

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connects the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

jobs.title: Electrical Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard (220m long, 9m high, 45m wide) and 10 special elements (38m long, 12,5m high, 50m wide) will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark.

To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

In the role of the Electrical Supervisor, there will be interface with subcontractors, operational departments of various disciplines and operations staff.

You will lead the team of technicians installing, maintaining and repairing the Tunnel Elements systems during the preparation, transport and installation phase of Tunnel Elements, and demobilization after immersion. Understand the functionality of the Tunnel Element systems. Supervise the installation of temporary TE systems in the Tunnel elements whilst planning and coordinating with other stakeholders to optimize the available time window. Troubleshoot during installation and operation. Maintain and organize the work area (workshop and yard facilities) to ensure an orderly and safe workplace in compliance with Danish regulation, company procedures, and good work practice. Set up, select and support the TE systems team of technicians to ensure effective and reliable production cycle. Procure small materials and equipment.

The Electrical Supervisor supervises the use and installation of the following equipment:

o Pumps / Piping / Valves

o Electrical components

o Subsea sensors

o Hydraulic cylinders / Powerpacks / manifolds

o Umbilical winches / Sliprings

o Rolling equipment

Qualifications:

The TE systems Electrical Supervisor:

- Has the ability to read and understand technical drawings, working methods and working procedures.

- Plans the work ahead.

- Manages daily interface with other TE outfitting parties.

- Communicates in English (minimum B2 level) both written and spoken.

- Optimizes the usage of the TE systems team capabilities.

- Supports and coaches the TE systems electricians and Commissioning Engineers

- Has excellent interpersonal skills

- Organizes daily toolbox / pre-start meetings.

- Connect the tasks to the bigger picture.

- Provides support and input on risk assessments for TE mobilization / demobilization, general tasks.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødbyhavn Denmark

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Requirements Engineer
jobs.description:
_Basemark | Automotive Software Projects_

_About the Role: Basemark is looking for a_**_Requirements Engineer_** _to join our automotive software engineering team. In this role, you will work within a customer-facing automotive project delivering advanced software solutions for a leading automotive manufacturer. You will play a key part in ensuring that customer and system requirements are accurately captured, structured, and maintained throughout the development lifecycle, in full compliance with ASPICE processes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical detail and cross-functional communication, working closely with automotive OEM stakeholders and internal engineering teams. What You'll Do:_

- _Gather, analyze, structure, and maintain functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR (Augmented Reality) projects._

- _Establish and maintain bi-directional traceability between customer requirements (SYS.2) and software requirements (SWE.1)._

- _Manage change requests, including impact analysis, throughout the requirements lifecycle._

- _Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10), supporting process assessments and audit readiness._

- _Act as a key point of contact with automotive OEM representatives to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into actionable engineering requirements._

- _Facilitate requirement reviews between engineering teams, ensuring alignment and clarity across disciplines._

- _Support problem resolution processes related to requirements and specifications._


_What We're Looking For_

- **_At least 5 years of hands-on experience_** _with ASPICE Software Engineering processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10)._

- _Solid knowledge of process assessments, audit readiness, and traceability compliance, as well as problem resolution and change request management._

- _Proven track record in gathering, analyzing, structuring, and maintaining functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR projects._

- _Proven experience establishing bi-directional traceability (Customer Requirements SYS.2 Software Requirements SWE.1) and managing change requests with impact analysis._

- _Proficiency with industry-standard tools for requirements lifecycle management (IBM DOORS, CodeBeamer, PTC Integrity, Jira, Confluence)._

- _Direct experience interacting with automotive OEMs to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into engineering requirements._

- _Experience facilitating requirement reviews between engineering teams._

- _Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives._

- _Fluent English; additional languages are a plus._


_Location & Compensation_

- **_Location:_** _Helsinki, Finland. The role is primarily based at our office, with on-site presence expected for most of the work week._

- **_Salary:_** **_EUR 33,500 - 33,700 per year_**_._


_Why Basemark? Basemark offers you the chance to work on cutting-edge automotive technology in a collaborative, international environment. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement — with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on projects used by major automotive manufacturers._

jobs.title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

jobs.description:
**Etsimme lastenvastaavaa ohjaamaan Allergia-, iho- ja astmaliiton perhekurssien lastenryhmän turvallista, tavoitteellista ja sujuvaa toimintaa.**

Lastenvastaavana työskentelet osana moniammatillista kurssitiimiä ja vastaat yhdessä lastenohjaajien kanssa lasten ryhmätoiminnan suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja sujuvuudesta kurssin aikana. Voit tutustua toimintaamme osoitteessa allergia.fi/kurssit.

Edellytämme hakijalta opettajan tai varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan pätevyyttä.

**Tehtävänkuva lastenvastaavana**

- huolehdit lasten turvallisesta, ikätasoisesta ja tavoitteellisesta ryhmätoiminnasta

- vastaat toiminnan suunnitelmallisuudesta ja tavoitteiden toteutumisesta

- koordinoit lasten toimintaa sekä lastenohjaajien työnjakoa

- toimit yhteyshenkilönä vanhemmille lasten toimintaan liittyvissä asioissa

- osallistut kurssien suunnitteluun ja tiimin työskentelyyn.


**Toivomme sinulta**

- joustavaa ja yhteistyökykyistä työotetta

- kokemusta kurssitoiminnasta sekä vastuutehtävistä

- kokemusta moniammatillisesta yhteistyöstä

- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä.


**Työsuhde**

Työ on määräaikaista ja kurssikohtaista. Työ sijoittuu pääasiassa viikonloppuihin, jolloin sinulle kustannetaan majoitus ja täysihoito. Viikonlopun kurssityö ajoittuu yleensä perjantaista klo 14.30 – sunnuntaihin klo 15.00. Kurssityötä voi tehdä mielenkiinnon mukaan keskimäärin 2–5 kurssia vuodessa. Työaika ja palkkio määräytyvät kurssin ohjelman mukaisesti.

Työt alkavat keväällä 2027 tai mahdollisuuksien mukaan jo 2026 aikana.

**_Vuoden 2027 kurssien toteutuspaikat määräytyvät julkisen kilpailutuksen perusteella. Vuoden 2027 kurssipaikat ovat tiedossa syksyn 2026 aikana._**

**Muuta huomioitavaa**

Tehtävässä työskennellään lasten kanssa, ja valitulta edellytetään rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä ennen työsuhteen alkua ja EA1®-todistuksen voimassaoloa. Tarvittaessa kustannamme ensiapukoulutuksen.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow / Yliopistotutkija (Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature, within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering)
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences)at Tampere University invites applications for a fixed-term Senior Research Fellow position in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature for a two-year period starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The position is open within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering (MePhiS), funded by the Research Council of Finland, and its research team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature. Among the five research teams of MePhiS, four are hosted by the Faculty of Theology at the University of Helsinki, while the team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature is hosted by the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University. The Centre offers a supportive and inspiring research environment and excellent opportunities for researchers to develop their careers in an international and interdisciplinary setting. More information about MePhiS is available at: www.helsinki.fi/mephis .

MePhiS engages in philosophical and interdisciplinary scholarship that places the concept of suffering at the centre of philosophical reflection and offers conceptual and argumentative tools for a deeper understanding of human engagement with affliction, starting from the meliorist (Lat. melior, better) idea that the world can and should be made better through active human efforts. According to meliorism, a positive outcome is neither guaranteed (optimism) nor impossible (pessimism).

The research group on Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature within MePhiS focuses on literary studies and the philosophy of literature as pathways to a meliorist philosophy of suffering. We take seriously the idea that literature can articulate philosophical questions and shape peoples ways of experiencing, expressing, and coping with suffering. The group critically examines writers and literary traditions associated with optimism, pessimism, and/or meliorism, and analyses literary works that reflect societal anxieties as well as human or non-human suffering arising from war, violence, poverty, marginalisation, the climate crisis, and related challenges. We also investigate how philosophers draw on literature in developing ethical responses to suffering.

Position

Towards these ends, we invite applications for a Senior Research Fellow with a background in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature with demonstrated interest in advancing research in these fields.

The Senior Research Fellow will be responsible for

- investigating representations of suffering and meliorism in literary and philosophical contexts;
- developing literary and philosophical analyses of ethical responses to suffering;
- authoring scholarly publications on the research topic;
- collaborating with other members of the Centre of Excellence, including through joint publications and other research activities; and
- contributing to teaching and administrative duties, amounting to approximately 5-10% of the working time.

Qualifications

We seek candidates with expertise in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature who are interested in advancing the research aims described above. Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in a relevant field within the humanities or social sciences (e.g., literary studies, philosophy) and have a demonstrated track record of high-quality research and international publications. A Senior Research Fellow typically has at least ca. five years of postdoctoral experience. In addition, applicants should possess the ability to lead a research group, a track record of securing external research funding, and the teaching skills required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position.

Familiarity with the topics of suffering, optimism, pessimism, or meliorism in literature and philosophy, as well as experience in combining literary studies with philosophical inquiry, will be considered an advantage.

The selected candidate should be capable of conducting independent research at a high international level and able to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of the research team. The working language of MePhiS is English, and excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Applicants should be prepared to provide proof of their qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated proposals.

We offer

The position is fixed-term for two years starting in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). The salary of a Senior Research Fellow is at levels 6-7. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us?navref=footer). International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

PORVOO

MYYJÄ, SALE HUHTINEN, 12 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös myymälän siisteydestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä tuotteiden esillepano ja saatavuuden varmistaminen.

Me Sale Huhtisessa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin!

- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä - myös juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.

-5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtuntitulospalkkioonyrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 30.8.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa apulaistoimipaikkapäällikkö Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***
