jobs.title: Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant
jobs.description:
Experienced Thai Cook for BanThai Restaurant

About the position

BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS in Ringsted is looking for an experienced and motivated cook with solid knowledge of authentic Thai and Asian cuisine.

You will become part of our kitchen team and work closely with the kitchen management and other employees to ensure efficient daily operations, consistent quality and a high standard of food preparation.

The position is full-time and includes both preparation and cooking duties. We are looking for a reliable and professional employee who can work independently, cooperate with colleagues and contribute positively to the development of our kitchen.

Main responsibilities

Your duties will include, among other things:

  • Preparing ingredients for daily kitchen operations, including washing, cutting, portioning and correct storage.

  • Preparing and cooking authentic Thai and Asian dishes according to the restaurant’s recipes and quality standards.

  • Ensuring consistent taste, quality, portion sizes and presentation.

  • Maintaining a clean, organised and efficient kitchen station.

  • Assisting with daily preparation and service in both smaller and larger kitchen operations.

  • Following instructions from kitchen management regarding production, preparation and daily priorities.

  • Monitoring stock levels and informing management when ingredients need to be ordered.

  • Receiving, checking and correctly storing food deliveries.

  • Ensuring proper labelling, date marking, storage and rotation of ingredients.

  • Following all hygiene, HACCP, food safety and workplace safety procedures.

  • Cleaning kitchen equipment, utensils and work areas.

  • Cooperating with the kitchen team to ensure efficient and smooth service.

  • Assisting with other naturally occurring kitchen duties when required.

The list of duties is not exhaustive, and tasks may vary depending on the restaurant’s operational needs. Opgaverne er baseret på arbejdsbeskrivelsen i den tidligere kontrakt.

Qualifications

We expect that you:

  • Have documented professional experience as a cook.

  • Have strong experience with Thai cuisine and other Asian cooking traditions.

  • Understand traditional Thai ingredients, preparation methods, flavours and presentation.

  • Have experience working in a professional restaurant kitchen.

  • Can work independently and as part of a team.

  • Can maintain quality and overview during busy service periods.

  • Have good knowledge of food hygiene and safe food handling.

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible.

  • Are willing to work mornings, evenings, weekends and public holidays when scheduled.

  • Can communicate in Thai and English.

  • Danish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

Relevant culinary education, certificates and documented work experience will be considered an advantage.

Employment conditions

  • Full-time employment.

  • Average working time: 37 hours per week, excluding breaks.

  • Working hours are primarily scheduled from Tuesday to Sunday between 9:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m.

  • Shifts may vary depending on operational needs and will generally be scheduled as morning or evening shifts.

  • Fixed monthly salary: DKK 37,500 before tax.

  • Annual fixed salary: DKK 450,000 before tax.

  • Holiday entitlement and holiday pay are provided in accordance with Danish legislation.

  • Workplace: BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS, Nørretorvet 22, 4100 Ringsted.

  • Expected starting date: by agreement and subject to any required Danish residence and work permit.

  • The employment is planned as a fixed-term position with the possibility of extension.

About BanThai

BanThai is a Thai restaurant and takeaway in Ringsted focusing on authentic Thai food, traditional preparation methods and dishes inspired by different regions of Thailand.

Our goal is to create genuine Thai food experiences based on quality ingredients, professional preparation and a strong respect for Thai food culture.

We offer a professional and multicultural working environment with a strong focus on cooperation, quality, responsibility and development.

  • The opportunity to learn from and work closely with our Head Chef, Chef Nie, winner of Thai Iron Chef.

  • Professional development through hands-on training in authentic Thai cuisine, traditional techniques and kitchen operations.

Application

Please send:

  • CV

  • Short application

  • Copies of relevant education or culinary certificates

  • Documentation of previous employment and professional experience

  • References, where available

Applications should be sent to:

job@banthai.dk

Please write “Application – Experienced Thai Cook” in the subject line.

BanThai Restaurant & TakeAway ApS
Nørretorvet 22
4100 Ringsted
CVR: 44185342

jobs.title: BŪVNIEKS
jobs.description:
Madonas novada Madonas apvienības pārvaldes (reģistrācijas numurs 40900040797) Īpašumu uzturēšanas nodaļa aicina darbā būvnieku uz nenoteiktu laiku.

Piedāvājam:

  • darbu uz nenoteiktu laiku ar trīs mēnešu pārbaudes laiku, normālu darba laiku (40 stundas nedēļā);
  • mēnešalgu 1093 eiro (pirms nodokļu nomaksas);
  • papildatvaļinājumu, atvaļinājuma pabalstu.

Galvenie amata pienākumi:

  • sistemātiski pārbaudīt Madonas pilsētas un Lazdonas pagasta teritorijā esošo Madonas novada pašvaldības ēku un telpu vispārējo stāvokli;
  • veikt un plānot būvdarbus un remontdarbus Madonas novada pašvaldības ēkās un telpās, kas atrodas Madonas pilsētas un Lazdonas pagasta teritorijā;
  • apsekot Madonas pilsētā esošos publiskos rotaļu laukumus, organizēt  nepieciešamo remontu.

Prasības:

  • profesionālā vidējā izglītība, kas atbilst vismaz Latvijas kvalifikācijas ietvarstruktūras 3. līmenim;
  • vismaz 3 gadu darba pieredze līdzīgā amatā;
  • pamata zināšanas būvdarbu veikšanā;
  • B kategorijas autovadītāja apliecība;
  • spēja pastāvīgi organizēt savu darbu;
  • pozitīva attieksme pret darbu, kārtīgums, precizitāte.

Iesniedzamie dokumenti:

  • CV;
  • Izglītību un kvalifikāciju apliecinošu dokumentu kopijas.

Dokumentus var iesniegt:

  • sūtot ar drošu elektronisko parakstu parakstītu dokumentu uz e-pasta adresi madona@madona.lv ar norādi “būvnieks/-ce”;
  • sūtot pa pastu adresātam Madonas novada Madonas apvienības pārvalde, adrese Saieta laukums 1, Madona, Madonas novads, LV – 4801;
  • personīgi slēgtā aploksnē Madonas novada Madonas apvienības pārvaldes Īpašumu uzturēšanas nodaļā, adrese Gaujas iela 37,

jobs.title: Julgestustöötaja-tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:
Töö asukoht Valga maakonnas Valga vallas (tööandja pakub majutust, hüvitab transpordikulud).

Tööülesanded: MTÜ Valga Abikeskus avab uue üksuse, kus pakutakse ööpäevaringset erihoolekandeteenust autismispektrihäirega inimestele.
Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Tööülesannete täitmine eeldab head füüsilist vormi ja aktiivset kaasamõtlemist teenuse arendamisel ning loomulikult kliente toetavat hoiakut.

Omalt poolt pakume: Motiveerivat töötasu; meeldivat meeskonda; vahetustega töögraafikut (paindlik tööaeg); vajadusel tasuta ööbimisvõimalust asutuses (tuba jagatakse); sõidukompensatsiooni igal kuul; tööalaseid koolitusi; kohapealset väljaõpet; tasuta toitlustust.

Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. Oluline on vähemalt keskhariduse olemasolu ja kasuks tuleb eelnev töökogemus sotsiaalvaldkonnas, loomulikult ka varasemalt läbitud vastav väljaõpe. NB! Isik ei tohi töötada tegevusjuhendajana, kui teda on karistatud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest, mis on suunatud isiku vastu (nt vägivald) või mis seab ohtu teiste inimeste elu ja tervise. Tööle asumisel kontrollitakse alati karistusregistri väljavõtet.

jobs.title: Puhastusteenindaja
jobs.description:
puhastusteenindaja

Tööülesanded: Igapäevased kohustused
- kontori- ja tootmisruumide põrandate puhastamine (kuiv- ja märgpuhastus). - prügikastide tühjendamine ja jäätmete sorteerimine vastavalt jäätmekäitluse korrale. - puhkeruumide korrashoid: laudade, köögipindade, valamute ja seadmete puhastus. - tualettide, riietusruumide, pesuruumide üldpuhastus ning sanitaartehnika puhastamine ja desinfitseerimine. - muude pindade (ukselingid, lauad, aknalauad, riiulid) puhastamine ja tolmu eemaldamine. Nädalased ja perioodilised kohustused - kohvimasinate põhjalik puhastus (iga kahe kuu tagant või vastavalt vajadusele). - akende pesu (vähemalt 2 korda aastas või vastavalt kokkuleppele). - välisterritooriumi korrastamine: prügi ja prahi koristamine, treppide ja sissepääsude korrashoid. - erakorralised koristustööd (nt pärast remonti või tootmisseadmete hooldust). Üldised kohustused - järgida tööohutus- ja tuleohutusnõudeid ning kasutada isikukaitsevahendeid. - hoolitseda puhastusseadmete ja -vahendite korrasoleku eest - suhtuda varasse heaperemehelikult ning vältida pindade või seadmete kahjustamist. - teha koostööd kolleegidega tagades ühtse ja kvaliteetse tulemuse. - vajadusel täita ka muid antud mõistlikke tööülesandeid, mis on seotud töökohtade puhtuse ja korrashoiuga.

Omalt poolt pakume: -mitmekesist, põnevat ja püsivat tööd Võru linnas
-unikaalset võimalust areneda koos tööstusettevõttega -tööalaseid koolitusi ja arenguvõimalusi -konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt kogemusele ja võimekusele -motiveerivat tulemustasu -kaasaegseid töötingimusi -täistööaega, kella 08:00 - 16:30-ni -kaasavat töökultuuri, ühtehoidvat meeskonda ja ühisüritusi -võimalusi terviseedendamiseks.

Muud nõuded: Soovituslik eelnev puhastusteenindaja töökogemus tootmises ja puhastusmasinaga opereerimise oskus (kuid võimalik ka kohapealne väljaõpe). Hea füüsiline vorm ja tahe teha tööd.

jobs.title: Pitsameister
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Tööülesandeks on Adavere Tuuliku Toidutänava pitsa suuna iseseisev käivitamine, korraldamine ja arendamine. Pitsameister vastutab pitsa kvaliteedi ja valmistamise eest, alustades taigna ja tooraine ettevalmistamisest kuni valmis pitsa serveerimiseni. Töö hõlmab kvaliteetse tooraine valimist, retseptide ja valmistamisstandardite väljatöötamist ning pitsa menüü koostamist ja arendamist.
Oluline on tagada ühtlane kõrge kvaliteet, hea maitse, kiirus ja korrektne töökorraldus ka suurema klientide arvu korral. Samuti tuleb jälgida tooraine varusid ja kvaliteeti, vähendada toidukadu ning hoida köök ja töövahendid puhtad ja korras. Pitsameister osaleb uute toodete ja ideede väljatöötamisel ning aitab arendada pitsa suunda vastavalt klientide tagasisidele ja müügitulemustele. Vajadusel tuleb juhendada teisi töötajaid ning tagada, et kõik pitsa valmistamisega seotud tööprotsessid vastaksid kokkulepitud kvaliteedistandarditele. Ootame iseseisvat ja ettevõtliku mõtteviisiga professionaali, kes ei tegele ainult pitsa valmistamisega, vaid soovib võtta vastutuse kogu pitsa suuna kvaliteedi, arendamise ja tulemuste eest.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume alustuseks kokkulepitud põhitöötasu vastavalt pitsa meistri kogemustele, oskustele ja professionaalsele tasemele. Töö ja tulemuste paranedes on võimalik töötasu on kuni 15 eurot/tund ning lisaks põhitöötasule teenida tulemustasu vastavalt pitsa suuna käibele, klientide rahulolule, positiivsele tagasisidele, reitingule ja püsikliendibaasi kasvule.
Meie eesmärk on, et tugeva ja tulemusliku töötaja sissetulek ei jääks pikaajaliselt ainult põhitöötasu tasemele. Mida suurem on inimese panus, vastutus ja saavutatud tulemus, seda suuremaks võib kujuneda ka tema teenistus. Pakume võimalust olla Adavere Tuuliku Toidutänava pitsa suuna ülesehitamisel oluline võtmeisik. Vajadusel on võimalik pakkuda majutust Adavere Tuuliku juures, kuid majutuskoht vajab eelnevalt remonti ja korrastamist. Parimatele töötajatele on võimalik pakkuda ka võimalust töötada Tenerifel ettevõtte baaris, kohvikus ja teistes toitlustusprojektides. Tenerifel töötamise korral on samuti võimalik pakkuda majutust. Töötajaga sõlmitakse tööleping Property Deals OÜga ning lähetatakse. Väga heade ja pikaajaliste tulemuste korral võib tulevikus avaneda võimalus saada ettevõttes suurem vastutus, võtmeroll või osalus ning osaleda ettevõtte edus sarnaselt partneriga.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: Külastuskogemuse spetsialist
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime oma meeskonda loovat ja ettevõtlikku külastuskogemuse spetsialisti, kelle peamine ülesanne on arendada Tallinna Loomaaia külastajakogemust ning toetada külastajate teadlikkust loodusest, liigikaitsest ja loomade heaolust.
Selles rollis lood ja arendad külastajatele suunatud lahendusi, programme ja keskkondi, mis muudavad loomaaia külastuse harivaks, kaasavaks ja meeldejäävaks. Oled oluline partner külastuskeskkonna kujundamisel ning aitad kaasa sellele, et iga külastus pakuks väärtuslikku kogemust ja inspireeriks loodust väärtustama ja hoidma. jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad (Dec 2026)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



To be eligible for this role, you need to graduate in December 2026 and be able to start full time by January/February 2027.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll work with others to plan, shape, and build new product features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance. For example, you might work on driving adoption, by instrumenting key onboarding moments and iterating on activation flows.

 - You'll help improve performance and reliability, or polish existing features. For example, you might update our spell checker to sync dictionaries across browsers or improve search to index file attachments.

 - You'll build internal tools to support simplicity and productivity for the whole team. This might include writing a script to import user feedback into Notion.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field.

 - To be eligible for this role, you need to graduate by Dec 2026 and be able to start FTE by January/February 2027.

 - Previous internship experience.

 - Working towards a proficiency of one or more programming languages such as TypeScript, Node.js, or Python.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Impact-driven approach to technology: You see technologies as tools to achieve user impact rather than ends in themselves. You care more about building successful systems that solve real problems than about using specific tech stacks or following trends.
   
   - You stay current with the latest tools like Codex, Claude Code, and other AI-assisted development environments. You're pragmatic about choosing the right tool for the job, focusing on what delivers the most value to users.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck. You think about the implications of what you're building and how it will impact real people's lives.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - Passion for web applications: You can work with others to build and maintain quality user interfaces for a big audience, using Web technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern UI framework like React.

 - Familiarity with backend systems: You understand how parts of a system fit together—from the user interface to the data model. Familiarity with database systems like Postgres, MySQL or MongoDB is a plus.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have experience with any part of our technology stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, and Elasticsearch.

 - You’re a builder who finds joy in building software solutions for yourself or others.

 - You care about the interaction between technology and society, the ways in which they inform each other, and our responsibility as technologists to be conscious of that relationship.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. jobs.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST

About the Company

Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels.

About the Role

Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues.

You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces.

  • Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers.

  • Classify sellers and verify their authorization status.

  • Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues.

  • Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content.

  • Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details.

  • Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records.

  • Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports.

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics.

  • Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes.

Competencies and Qualifications


Must-Have

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field.

  • Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables.

  • Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.

  • Strong written English and reporting skills.

  • Ability to work independently and follow SOPs.

  • Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.

Nice-to-Have

  • Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience.

  • Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools.

  • Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance.

  • Experience with dashboards and reporting.

  • Experience using AI research and translation tools.

Key Qualities

  • Detail-oriented

  • Analytical

  • Investigative

  • Highly organized

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

  • Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.

  • Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

Application Process

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.

jobs.title: Svensktalande Customer Service Consultant - Spanien
jobs.description:
Talar du svenska och tycker om att hjälpa människor? Bli en del av teamet i soliga Spanien.

Viking Assistance är en ledande leverantör av vägassistans i Norge, Sverige, Danmark och Finland. Genom sitt internationella partnernätverk hjälper de även bilister runt om i Europa.

De säkerställer snabb, trygg och pålitlig hjälp för både fordon och passagerare, oavsett var ett problem eller driftstopp inträffar. Deras team hjälper kunder på norska, svenska, finska och engelska.

Om rollen

Som Customer Service Consultant tar du emot och hanterar telefonsamtal från kunder som behöver vägassistans.

Kunderna kan befinna sig i utsatta eller stressande situationer, och din uppgift är att se till att de får rätt hjälp när de behöver den som mest.

Du är ofta den första personen kunden kommer i kontakt med när något oväntat händer ute på vägarna.

Vår kund söker dig som kan arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du har ett starkt fokus på att ge förstklassig kundservice. Du blir en del av ett större team där kollegorna stöttar och hjälper varandra när det behövs.

Du arbetar i flera olika system för att lösa situationer snabbt och effektivt. Du hjälper även samarbetspartners inom försäkrings- och fordonsbranschen med frågor och ärenden kopplade till vägassistans.

Kvalifikationer

• Erfarenhet av kundservice

• Flytande svenska i tal och skrift

• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift

• God datorvana och förmåga att arbeta med teknik och digitala system

• Ett rent belastningsregister är ett krav

Du kommer att passa bra hos Viking Assistance om du:

• Värdesätter en stark arbetsmoral

• Är bra på att samarbeta

• Trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra

• Har god kommunikationsförmåga

• Känner dig bekväm med att använda digitala verktyg och telefonen som dina främsta arbetsredskap

• Är van vid att arbeta i flera system samtidigt

• Är noggrann och tycker om att hantera komplexa arbetsuppgifter

• Är lösningsorienterad i kontakten med både kunder och kollegor

• Är nyfiken och vill lära dig nya saker

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect, France
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 - Fluency in English and French.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €106,000 - €119,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Handelselev til grossistvirksomhed
jobs.description:
Digital handelselev

  SETRONIC                                            

 

Drømmer du om en elevplads, hvor du skal løse en bred vifte af opgaver inden for handel?  Kan du se fordelene ved at blive oplært i alle aspekter af faget? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et godt læringsmiljø? Så har vi elevpladsen til dig.

Vi søger en elev med speciale inden for handel med opstart snarest muligt.

Setronic er en mindre handelsvirksomhed med speciale i industribatterier.
Virksomheden indgår i en gruppe af koncernforbundne selskaber i Sverige og Tyskland.
Vi markedsfører og sælger vores brede produktsortiment til et bredt udsnit af danske virksomheder og til den offentlige sektor.

For at trives i rollen forestiller vi os en serviceminded kollega, der er fleksibel i forhold til, hvilke opgaver, der skal løses. Vi ser en stor fordel i, at du er ansvarsbevidst, har en seriøs tilgang til dit arbejde og sørger for at afslutte dine opgaver inden for deadline.

Du har en adgangsgivende uddannelse, fx EUX, EUD, HHX eller lignende. Du er god til dansk i skrift og tale, og kan gerne kommunikere på tysk. 

Vi lægger vægt på, at du får et godt uddannelsesforløb, og derfor bliver du tilknyttet en elevansvarlig, som vil sørge for at lære dig op i de forskellige administrative opgaver og generelt støtte dig i din udvikling. Du kommer til at indgå på lige fod med dine tætteste kolleger i den daglige opgaveløsning. Du kan også være med til at præge dine arbejdsopgaver afhængig af dine interesser.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter som udgangspunkt:

·         Opsøgende og aktivt salg via telefon og pc

·         Identifikation og bearbejdning af potentielle kundeemner, som bliver til gode kunder

·         Udarbejdelse af tilbud samt opfølgning på disse.

·         Behandling af ordrer i SAP

·         Opfølgning på leverancer, restordrer mv.

·         Assistere med pakning af varer ved ferie og andet fravær

·         Udarbejdelse af indkøbsordre

·         Indhentning af fragtpriser og bookning af forsendelser

·         Udføre øvrige ad hoc-opgaver

 

Vi sørger naturligvis for grundig løbende introduktion og oplæring.

Har dette din interesse, så send din ansøgning og CV til info@setronic.dk. Tiltrædelse efter aftale.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at rette henvendelse til

Kirsten Petersen på telefon 27899061

Plantagevej 13, 6330 Padborg

jobs.title: Community Lead
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture and a natural instinct for bringing people together?

ONLY BRAND HOUSE is looking for a Community Lead to shape, grow and strengthen the communities around our brand.

From intimate community gatherings and creative partnerships to larger-scale events and brand activations, this role will create experiences that bring ONLY BRAND HOUSE into the real world and give people meaningful reasons to engage with and participate in the brand.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
As our Community Lead, you will develop meaningful relationships between ONLY BRAND HOUSE and the people, places and cultural communities surrounding our brand.
You will work across multiple European markets, building an international network of creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors, ambassadors and brand advocates who authentically connect with ONLY BRAND HOUSE. A particular focus will be on developing our community presence within French-speaking markets.

Working closely with Brand, Creative, Social, Communications and our local markets, you will turn cultural insights and relationships into relevant experiences, partnerships and activations. Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and execute ONLY's community strategy across key markets

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers, cultural connectors and brand advocates

  • Identify emerging communities, people and cultural movements relevant to ONLY

  • Develop and execute events, gatherings, launches, pop-ups and cultural activations from concept to delivery

  • Build ONLY's community presence within French-speaking markets

  • Develop creative partnerships with relevant talent, venues, organisations and complementary brands

  • Collaborate with Social and Communications on talent, seeding and organic brand relationships

  • Track community growth, engagement and impact while bringing relevant cultural insights back into the wider Brand team

WHY JOIN ONLY BRAND HOUSE?
This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how ONLY BRAND HOUSE builds communities and shows up in culture across international markets. You will have the opportunity to:

  • Shape and develop ONLY’s international community approach

  • Build long-term relationships with creatives, tastemakers and cultural connectors

  • Turn ideas and cultural opportunities into real-world experiences and activations

  • Work across markets and bring local insights and perspectives into the brand

  • Join a collaborative Brand team where new ideas and perspectives are encouraged

ABOUT YOU
You are a connector by nature. You genuinely enjoy meeting people, building relationships and bringing different communities together. At the same time, you know how to turn an idea into reality and are comfortable owning events and projects from concept through to execution. We imagine that you:

  • Have 3–5 years of experience in community, events, experiential marketing, cultural marketing, PR or a related field

  • Have a strong understanding of contemporary fashion and culture

  • Have experience developing and executing events, activations or community initiatives

  • Understand the difference between building a community and simply building an audience

  • Are proactive, highly organised and comfortable balancing relationship-building with execution

  • Are professionally fluent in both English and French

  • Experience working across European markets and an existing network within fashion, creative or cultural communities are both considered strong advantages.

INTERESTED?
If you have any questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact Head Of Creative, Joshua Mark Bredehoeft on +45 71990213. Otherwise, send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than September 10th, 2026. We review applications continuously and reserve the right to close the position once we have found the right candidate.

LOCATION: Brande, Denmark

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship for the project “Truth, Information, Democracy and Law”
jobs.description:
Job description

A Postdoctoral Research Fellowship (SKO 1352) is available as part of the project Truth, information, democracy and law (TIDAL) - Department of Private Law (TIDAL) funded by the Research Council of Norway (RCN) and Norid AS. 

The fellow will be responsible for their own research and work closely with the TIDAL team at the Norwegian Research Center for Computers and Law - Department of Private Law, UiO (NRCCL).

The project runs from April 2026 until March 2030. In addition to researchers at the NRCCL, the project team includes researchers at Queen Mary University of London, University of Bergen, University of Tromsø, Lund University, Bond University, BI Norwegian Business School, and Boston University. 

At the NRCCL, the core project team comprises four people, including the postdoctoral fellow. The project is led by Professor Lee A. Bygrave.

The appointment period lasts three years without teaching and administrative duties, or four years with teaching and administrative duties making up 25% of the total workload. 

A four-year fellowship requires that the candidate can contribute to the Faculty of Law's current teaching needs. 

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.


More about the position

The TIDAL project concerns the legal preconditions for a well-functioning democracy in an age marked by increasing generation and dissemination of disinformation, misinformation, and other forms of information disorder (ID). Drawing upon cross-disciplinary insights and approaches, including a policy field study of stakeholder viewpoints in Norway and the United Kingdom, the project tackles the fundamental question of whether the law needs to be reformed in order to tackle ID more effectively and, if yes, what avenue(s) of reform would be most sensible. It does so in light of the vexing problem that measures to combat ID in the name of securing or promoting democracy can end up undermining democracyʼs bedrock by tightening various freedoms and accountability frameworks that help buttress democracy and the rule of law. 

The TIDAL project not only examines how best to overcome the latter problem, but elucidates a range of other related matters. These include: the effects of recent legal initiatives by the European Union (EU) to curb ID; the interaction of hard law and soft law codes in this regulatory domain; and current geopolitical tensions at the global level over appropriate legal-regulatory strategies for tackling ID. 

At a more fundamental jurisprudential level, the project interrogates the relationship between law and the promotion of truth, analysing the borderlines between when law penalizes the dissemination of lies, “untruths” and other false or misleading information and when it abstains from doing so, along with the rationale(s) for either course of action.

As part of elucidating the relationship of ID and the law with a view to identifying optimal regulatory strategies for reducing the deleterious effects of ID, the project pursues five main sub-objectives:

(1) to map the non-legal structural factors causing ID, drawing upon scholarship in the social sciences and information sciences;

(2) to develop an holistic understanding of ID that bridges insights from the social sciences and information sciences with insights from legal-regulatory scholarship;

(3) to assess how the law, in light of these insights, currently facilitates and impedes ID;

(4) to evaluate what role law should play to remedy ID in the future and to develop and assess new norms, legal concepts, and regulatory frameworks, innovating legal treatment of ID;

(5) to assess the legal innovations within the wider geopolitical situation which Norway finds herself in, with a view to minimizing jurisdictional “overreach”.

The postdoctoral fellow is expected to work closely with TIDAL team members in pursuing the above-listed objectives. The postdoctoral fellow is also expected to engage in international dissemination activities and collaborate with key scholars in the field, outside the project group. Part of these activities will involve participation in the collection, coding, and analysis of data from policy field studies, writing research articles and other publications (e.g. book chapters, blogposts), participating in the ongoing reporting from the project, and assisting the project leader in the daily operation of the project.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree (PhD) in Law or another relevant social science discipline, such as Political Science or Sociology.
  • Applicants must have submitted their doctoral dissertation for evaluation at the time of application and the dissertation must be approved by the time of appointment.
  • Applicants must have an excellent command of English, necessary for publishing in high-level international journals and participating in international conferences, seminars, and similar events; additionally, an excellent command of Norwegian, alternatively Danish or Swedish, necessary for studying Norwegian policy discourse, is an advantage.
  • Applicants must have a demonstrated knowledge of, and experience with, research containing significant cross- and interdisciplinary elements.
  • Experience with carrying out policy field studies is desirable.
  • Experience with legal research containing significant cross-jurisdictional elements, especially in relation to the regulation of information flows, is desirable.

Personal skills
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should possess good collaborative skills and demonstrate the ability, willingness, and commitment to contribute to the development of the research field.
  • Applicants should be able to take initiative and actively participate in an international and multidisciplinary research team.

Assessment of the applicants

In assessing applicants, priority will be given to their academic achievements, previous relevant publications, the project description, and their professional and personal qualifications, especially regarding their ability to complete the proposed project within the specified timeframe.

Applicants who progress through the selection process will be invited to interview for the position, either in person or digitally.

Applicants are assessed by an assessment committee that ranks them according to the above criteria and interviews the most suitable candidates. A separate interview committee may be used. The final decision is made by the faculty’s appointment board.

The applicant must submit a project description but a final plan for the research of the postdoctoral fellow will be developed in consultation with the project leader following the appointment.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • Committed colleagues and an inspiring, friendly, and inclusive working environment.
  • Pension scheme in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (SKO 1352) in the range NOK 610 000 - 690 000 depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
     

The application must include
  • A cover letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position.
  • A project description of 4-7 pages (excluding the list of references) outlining how they would approach their research tasks within a 3-year project plan. This should include a description of the theoretical background, objectives, methodologies, and reflections on potential ethical challenges. The proposal must clearly demonstrate how the research will contribute to the aims of the TIDAL project. Further information on the project aims can be received from the project leader upon request.
  • A CV providing a comprehensive overview of education, previous positions, teaching experience, list of publications, and other relevant activities.
  • Copies of diplomas with all grades included in the degree and certificates (if the original language of diplomas/certificates is not English or a Scandinavian language, an English language translation must be provided in addition to a copy of the original). Foreign diplomas must include official documentation about the grading system, together with the official grading scale.
  • Up to three academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered. If a publication has been authored by multiple individuals, the division of work must be documented with a declaration from the co-author(s).
  • Names and contact details for at least two references.
  • A written assessment of the doctoral dissertation may also be submitted. If the assessment is not ready in time for the application deadline, the assessment can be submitted after deadline.

Please note that all documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. The application with attachments must be submitted through our electronic recruitment system; please follow the link “apply for this job”. The tentative starting date is January 2027.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


General information

Please see the guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at the University of Oslo. 

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

According to the Norwegian Freedom of Information Act §25 information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

Vi søger en engageret og struktureret Rengøringsleder til vores renseri hos Renserierne.DK ApS, ,Vester Farimagsgade 3 , 1606 København V

Som Rengøringsleder får du en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer, at arbejdsopgaver planlægges, koordineres og udføres effektivt. Du bliver bindeled mellem virksomhedens ejer og medarbejderne og bidrager til en høj kvalitet i både driften og kundeservicen.

Stillingen er en driftskoordinerende funktion uden personale- eller HR-ansvar. Du har ikke ansvar for ansættelser eller afskedigelser, men du har ansvar for at sikre en effektiv daglig drift, høj service og et godt samarbejde mellem medarbejderne.

Ansættelsen forudsætter, at du til enhver tid har gyldig arbejdstilladelse, hvis dette kræves.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Overvåge og koordinere virksomhedens daglige driftsaktiviteter for at sikre en smidig og effektiv arbejdsgang.

  • Koordinere medarbejdernes arbejdsplaner og sikre tilstrækkelig bemanding i forhold til den daglige drift og kundernes behov.

  • Vejlede og støtte medarbejderne i det daglige arbejde for at sikre høj kvalitet og effektiv kundeservice.

  • Modtage og betjene kunder, besvare henvendelser samt modtage servicebestillinger.

  • Håndtere kundefeedback og klager professionelt og sikre hurtig opfølgning.

  • Sikre en effektiv kommunikation mellem medarbejderne og virksomhedens ejer om den daglige drift.

  • Overvåge virksomhedens kundeservice og den samlede driftseffektivitet.

  • Følge kundetilfredsheden og komme med forslag til forbedringer af kundeoplevelsen.

  • Identificere daglige driftsmæssige udfordringer og foreslå praktiske løsninger, der styrker den operationelle effektivitet.

  • Bidrage med idéer til salgsfremmende aktiviteter og forretningsudvikling med henblik på at tiltrække nye kunder og understøtte virksomhedens vækst.

  • Sikre, at de daglige arbejdsopgaver udføres rettidigt og bidrage til et organiseret, sikkert og effektivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Repræsentere virksomheden professionelt i kontakten med kunder.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring fra renseri, vaskeri, rengøringsbranchen eller en anden servicevirksomhed.

  • Er struktureret og god til at koordinere den daglige drift.

  • Har stærke samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.

  • Er serviceminded og sætter en ære i at levere en høj kundeservice.

  • Er løsningsorienteret og arbejder selvstændigt.

  • Kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag og sikre, at opgaver bliver løst effektivt.

Vi tilbyder

  • Mulighed for at bidrage til udviklingen af virksomhedens arbejdsgange og kundeoplevelse.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til vores kontaktperson, da vi akut har brug for en medarbejder i teamet.

Qualifications

  • Has strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Is customer-focused and committed to delivering excellent service.

  • Is proactive, reliable and solution-oriented.

  • Can work independently while maintaining an overview in a busy working environment.

We Offer

  • A varied and responsible position with a key role in daily operations.

  • The opportunity to contribute to improving operational processes and customer satisfaction.

  • A friendly working environment with short decision-making processes.

  • Close collaboration with the business owner.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

How to Apply

Please submit your application and CV as soon as possible to our contact person as we have an immediate need of getting the position filled.

jobs.description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Infantry Soldiers are the Armyâs primary combat fighters and are responsible for closing with and destroying the enemy. They are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armour Soldiers.

Infantry Soldiers are capable of operating anywhere in the world in any environment â Arctic tundra, mountains, jungle or desert â and in any combination of arms, including airmobile and amphibious operations. The primary duties of Infantry Soldiers are to:

  • Expertly operate and maintain a wide range of weapons, including rifle, hand-grenades, light, medium and heavy machine-guns, and anti-tank weapons
  • Use sophisticated equipment for field communications, navigation and night-vision surveillance
  • Inspect and maintain weapon systems, vehicles, survival gear and personal defensive equipment
  • Participate in airborne operations
  • Operate with support elements such as fighter aircraft, tactical and artillery
  • Engage in unarmed combat
  • Employ camouflage and concealment, patrol, assault, defence, and escape-and-evasion tactics.


Work environment


Infantry Soldiers normally work outdoors. Both in training and on operations they live and work in conditions that would resemble those in the field. Infantry Soldiers will be posted to a battalion in Canada, but there are employment opportunities across Canada and on deployed operations around the world.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options

No previous work experience or career related skills are required. CAF recruiters can help you decide if your personal interests and attributes match the criteria for this occupation.

The minimum required education to apply for this occupation is the completion of the provincial requirements for Grade 10 or Secondary 4 in Quebec.

Foreign education may be accepted.

Training

The first stage of training is the Basic Military Qualification course, or Basic Training, held at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec. This training provides the basic core skills and knowledge common to all trades. A goal of this course is to ensure that all recruits maintain the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) physical fitness standard; as a result, the training is physically demanding.

Infantry Soldiers attend one of three Military Training Centres: The Royal Canadian Regiment in Meaford, Ontario; Princess Patriciaâs Canadian Light Infantry in Wainwright, Alberta; and the Royal 22 e RÃ©giment in Valcartier, Quebec. The training takes 17 weeks and includes the following topics:

  • Use and care of personal and section-level weapons, including rifles, machine guns and anti-tank weapons
  • Field-craft, including personal hygiene and meal preparation, camouflage, sentry duties, signalling, selecting firing positions, tactical movements and lines of advance
  • Construction of field defences, such as trenches and roadblocks, and laying and marking of minefields
  • Navigation by day and by night
  • Patrolling operations
  • Infantry section and platoon tactics, including offensive, defensive and transitional operations

Infantry Soldiers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including:

  • Basic Parachutist
  • Parachute Jumpmaster
  • Para Instructor
  • Mountain Warfare
  • Instructional Techniques
  • First Aid Instructor
  • Rappelmaster
  • Nuclear, Biological and Chemical Defence Instructor
  • Urban Operations
  • Close Quarter Combat Instructor

As they progress in their career, Infantry Soldiers who demonstrate the required ability and potential will be offered advanced training. Available courses include:

  • Instructional Techniques
  • Primary Army Leadership
  • Infantry Section Commander
  • Infantry Platoon Second in Command
  • Infantry Company Sergeant-Major
  • Communicator
  • Reconnaissance Patrolling
  • Anti-Armour Gunner
  • Sniper
  • Machinegunner (Heavy and General Purpose)
  • Small Arms Coach
  • 25mm Gunner and light armoured vehicle Crew Commander
  • Winter (Arctic) and Jungle Operations
  • Patrol Pathfinder
  • Tactical Intelligence Operator

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at a Unit in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Infantry Soldiers serve with the Canadian Army. They are the Armyâs primary combat fighters, are responsible for engaging the enemy and are the core members of the Combat Arms team, which includes Artillery and Armoured Soldiers. When they are employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve at a Forces Infantry unit located within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards. Following basic training, Infantry Soldiers attend one of three CAF training centres for 7 weeks of Infantry training.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. They are paid 92.8% of Regular Force rates of pay, receive a reasonable benefits package and may qualify to contribute to a pension plan.

Are you ready to combine professional development with a new work environment?

Duration

jobs.title: Engineer Officer
jobs.employer: Canadian Armed Forces | Forces armÃ©es canadiennes
jobs.description:
Overview

As a member of the military, Engineer Officers help the army live, move and fight. They are members of the Corps of Royal Canadian Engineers. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms.

The primary responsibility of Engineer Officers is combat readiness. Either working within Canada during an emergency or on international missions, Engineer Officers are responsible for:

  • Constructing habitable camps
  • Breaching minefields
  • Using explosives to destroy a road or bridge
  • Constructing a bridge or ferry
  • Building a combat road
  • Disposing explosives
  • Constructing obstacles


Work environment


Engineer Officers are employed at bases and stations across Canada and on deployed operations around the world. They experience the unique adventures and challenges that come with working in different environments and various terrains â Arctic tundra, tropical jungle, desert, mountains, urban complex â and various climates.

If you chose a career in the Regular Force, upon completion of all required training, you will be assigned to your first base. While there is some flexibility with regards to postings (relocations), accommodations canât always be made, and therefore, you can likely expect to move at some point in your career. However, if you decide to join the Primary Reserve Force, you will do so through a specific Reserve unit. Outside of training, your chosen Reserve unit will be your workplace on a part time basis, and you will not be obligated to relocate to a different base. As part of the Primary Reserve Force, you typically work one night per week and some weekends as a minimum with possibilities of full-time employment.

Entry plans

  • Direct Entry Options
  • Paid Education Options

If you already have a university degree, the Forces will decide if your academic program matches the criteria for this job and may place you directly into the required on-the-job training program following basic training. Basic training and military officer qualification training are required before being assigned.

Regular Officer Training Plan

Due to the requirement for CAF officer to obtain a university degree, the CAF will pay successful recruits to complete a bachelor degree program in the Royal Military College System. Recruits will receive full-time salary including medical and dental care, as well as vacation time with full pay in exchange for working in the CAF for a period of time. Typically, candidates enter the Canadian Military College System as an Officer Cadet where they study subjects relevant to both their military and academic career. In rare instances, based on the needs of the CAF, candidates may be approved attend another Canadian University. A determination will be made on a case by case basis. If you are applying for this program, you must apply to the CAF and it is recommended to apply to other Canadian universities of your choice should you not be accepted for ROTP.

Training

After enrolment, you start basic officer training at the Canadian Forces Leadership and Recruit School in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, Quebec, for 12 weeks. Topics covered include general military knowledge, the principles of leadership, regulations and customs of the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF), basic weapons handling, and first aid. Opportunities will also be provided to apply such newly acquired military skills in training exercises involving force protection, field training, navigation and leadership. A rigorous physical fitness program is also a vital part of basic training. Basic officer training is provided in English or French and successful completion is a prerequisite for further training.

Following basic officer training, official second language training may be offered to you. Training could take from two to nine months to complete depending on your ability in your second language.

Common army phase

After basic training, you will go to the Infantry School at the Combat Training Centre in Gagetown, New Brunswick. You will build upon the leadership training you received in basic officer training in addition to learning the skills required of all Combat Arms Soldiers, including more advanced weapons-handling, field-craft, and section-level tactics.

Engineer Officers attend the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick. For the first two and a half months, training focuses on basic combat engineering skills and includes subjects such as:

  • Basic demolitions
  • Mine warfare
  • Obstacle construction
  • Field fortifications
  • Dismounted infantry tactics at the platoon level

It ends with a three-week field deployment where the Engineer Officerâs ability to lead a Troop is assessed. The final nine months of training concentrates on reconnaissance, planning, and Troop-level combat engineer tasks. Subjects included are:

  • Bridge building
  • Minefield construction
  • Booby-trap clearance
  • Route denial
  • Bridge demolition
  • Combat road repair and construction
  • Defensive works
  • Timber and rope field machines
  • Destruction of battlefield munitions
  • Construction of temporary camps
  • Breaching various obstacles in the face of the enemy

At the end of the last phase, during a comprehensive four-week field deployment, the skills acquired are assessed.

Engineer Officers may be offered the opportunity to develop specialized skills through formal courses and on-the-job training, including after the first tour of duty with a first line unit, they may choose to specialize in one of the following areas:

  • Combat diving
  • Counter explosive threat
  • Mapping and geodesic support to joint operations
  • Infrastructure engineering to both garrison and deployed installations
  • Technical engineering to support the procurement and management of equipment

Part time options

This position is available for part-time employment with the Primary Reserve at certain locations across Canada. Reserve Force members usually serve part time at an Army Base or armoury in their community, and may serve while going to school or working at a civilian job. They are paid during their training. They are not posted or required to do a military move. However, they can volunteer to move to another base. They may also volunteer for deployment on a military mission within or outside Canada.

Engineer Officers serve with the Canadian Army. Their primary responsibility is combat readiness â to help the army live, move and fight. Together with the Armour, Infantry and Artillery, Engineer Officers are an integral part of the Combat Arms team. When employed on a part-time or casual full-time basis they usually serve with Canadian Army units at locations within Canada.

Find a Recruiting Centre

Reserve Force members are trained to the same level as their Regular Force counterparts. They usually begin training with their home unit to ensure that they meet the required basic professional military standards.

After completing basic officer training, Engineer Officers attend approximately three months of specialized instruction at the Canadian Forces School of Military Engineering in Gagetown, New Brunswick, where they earn their Engineer Officer qualification.

Reserve Force members usually serve part-time with their home unit for scheduled evenings and weekends, although they may also serve in full-time positions at some units for fixed terms, depending on the type of work that they do. They are paid 92.8% of Regular Force rates of pay, receive a reasonable benefits package and may qualify to contribute to a pension plan.

Related Careers

jobs.description:
On behalf of municipalities in the Vestland region in Western Norway, we are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions within local healthcare services.

Vestland is a well-known region on Norway’s west coast, famous for its fjords, mountains and beautiful coastline. The municipalities have a continuous need for qualified nurses in both home care services and nursing homes, where you will play an important role in providing safe and reliable care to patients of all ages.

These positions offer a stable job, a meaningful everyday working life and good opportunities for professional development within the Norwegian public healthcare system. You will work in well-organised teams that focus on cooperation, clear routines and high professional standards.

Your responsibilities

    Clinical nursing in home care, nursing homes or assisted living facilities
    Observation, assessment, medication management and accurate documentation
    Follow-up of patients with diverse medical conditions and functional levels
    Collaboration with relatives, coordinating units and external partners
    Interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, therapists and other health professionals
    Contributing to service development, improvement work and quality assurance

Most of the available roles are within core municipal services, particularly home nursing and long-term care. Here, you will play a key role in the daily follow-up of patients, whether providing support in their homes or offering comprehensive care in an institutional setting.

Depending on your background and interests, you may also be considered for roles in other municipal healthcare services, such as assisted living facilities, public health clinics or GP practices. This gives you the opportunity to grow in different directions and contribute where your skills are most valuable.

We are looking for nurses who:

    Hold a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country
    Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)
    Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course
    Feel confident in their clinical skills and can manage varied and unpredictable situations
    Work well both independently and as part of a team
    Holds a driver’s license (preferred)

We offer:

    A full-time permanent position in the Norwegian public healthcare system
    Competitive salary and working conditions
    A supportive work environment that values cooperation and professional confidence
    Opportunities for further development and specialization
    Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
    Relocation assistance and help with housing
    Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Life in Vestland

Vestland is a region shaped by fjords, mountains and a long coastline, where nature is a natural part of everyday life. People live in smaller towns and communities with short distances and a calm, well-organised pace of life. The surroundings offer easy access to outdoor activities all year round, without being far from modern services and infrastructure. På grund af stor efterspørgsel udvider vi nu på tværs af Danmark.

Flere af os har selv siddet på klientsiden og mærket, hvor svært det kan være at finde den rette og rettidige hjælp – det er den oplevelse, der driver os til at gøre hjælpen mere personlig, mere menneskelig og langt mere tilgængelig.

Om stillingen

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver psykoterapeutiske samtaleforløb med individuelle klienter – særligt unge med angst eller depression.   • Ønsker at arbejde primært med samtaleterapi i klinisk praksis

jobs.title: Barcelona Elsäljare
jobs.description:
Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Är du kvicktänkt, utåtriktad och vill jobba utomlands på ett nytt fräscht kontor med härliga kollegor? Då är du rätt person för oss.

Vi söker nya motiverade säljare av fasta elavtal till vårt kontor i Barcelona. Fast grundlön & provision utan tak!

Har du ingen tidigare erfarenhet? Det är inget krav! Hos oss får du lära dig försäljning från grunden samt hur du använder dig av dina färdigheter för att nå din fulla potential.

Vilka är vi?

Vi jobbar med de största varumärkena inom försäljning och har gjort det i över 10 år. Därför kan vi erbjuda branschens mest attraktiva provisionsmodeller som dem flesta säljare går igång på, utöver en grundlön.

Konnect är Sveriges största säljbolag med kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona. Vi ger våra medarbetare det absolut bästa och vad kan vara bättre än att vara omgiven av likasinnade människor i en stad som Barcelona? Inget, tycker vi!

Vi är störst och vi är bäst på det vi gör men vilka är vi på riktigt? Vi är 300 säljare som alla jobbar för samma sak - att ha kul och njuta av livet. Vi är kollegor men vi är också vänner. Vi jobbar ihop, kämpar och har riktigt kul! Oavsett om vi jobbar eller hänger på stranden så har vi ett gemensamt mål - att vara vårt bästa jag och sälja bra produkter och avtal för de bästa varumärkena inom branschen.

Om tjänsten:

Vi söker dig som är sugen på att arbeta i en stor och snabbväxande koncern och är redo att kavla upp ärmarna när det behövs. I rollen som säljare hos oss vill vi se vilja, driv, kreativitet och ett ”outside-of-the-box” tänk. Vi jobbar på ett ett strukturerat och noggrant tillvägagångssätt för att sälja in en produkt eller ett avtal till företagare och privatpersoner. Du kommer utöver det delta i utbildningar och feedbacksamtal från din teamleader, detta för att ständigt utvecklas och växa i rollen som säljare hos oss.

Vi söker dig som:

Drivs mot uppsatta mål, resultatinriktad och utöver det är en social person som har lätt att ta kontakt med nya människor. Viktigt att du vågar utmana dig själv!

Vad erbjuder vi?

    Hög provision för varje avtal du säljer och spanskt kollektivavtal.
    Daglig coaching och löpande utbildningar för att du ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete.
    Fantastiska teamleaders som leder gruppen mot ständig utveckling, motiverar och anordnar tävlingar med otroliga priser varje månad.
    Vi ser till att kombinera arbete med roliga aktiviteter så att gruppen stärks i positiv anda.

Vid flytt till Barcelona:

    Ersättning av flygbiljett.
    Stöd vid letande utav boende.
    Allmänna tips för en utomlandsflytt.
    Stora utvecklingsmöjligheter.
    Ett fantastiskt kontor med ljusa och öppna ytor, 10 minuters lugn promenad från en av Barcelonas vackraste stränder.

Har du fler frågor? Du är varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.

Ansök idag. Vi rekryterar löpande.

Hemsida: https://www.konnect.se/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/konnectse/ Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@konnectse

Vi hjälper många av Sveriges vassaste varumärken i deras försäljning. Under tio års tid har vi byggt upp vår verksamhet och breddat vårt tjänsteutbud för att alltid ligga i framkant. Vårt team består idag av över trehundra drivna och talangfulla medarbetare på våra kontor i Stockholm och Barcelona.

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Essential Functions

  • Apply polishing paints and coatings to various surfaces throughout the hotel, including floors, walls, and furniture.

  • Supporting colleagues with tasks as needed.

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member.

Specific Job Knowledge, Skills And Ability

The individual must possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and demonstrate that he or she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.

  • Proven experience and expertise in polishing, with a thorough understanding of techniques and methods for different surfaces.
  • Proficient in using hand tools and power tools relevant to polishing work.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to achieve high-quality finishes.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team.

LICENSES OR CERTIFICATE

  • Manufacturer Training Certification
  • Hazardous Materials Handling Certification
  • CPR Certification and/or First Aid Training is an advantageous

Kunnossapidon suunnittelijana vastaat rikastamon huoltoseisokkien pitkäjänteisestä valmistelusta ja toteutuksesta. Työskentelet osana 15 hengen tiimiä, jossa painotetaan ennakoivaa otetta ja sujuvaa yhteistyötä niin sisäisten osastojen kuin ulkopuolisten urakoitsijoidenkin kanssa.

Tarjoamme
Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan vuosibonuksen lisäksi laajat edut kuten: Epassin, edullisen kuntosalikortin, kattavan sairauskuluvakuutuksen sekä mahdollisuuden osallistua osakeohjelmaan. Autamme tarvittaessa myös asunnon löytämisessä.

Työtehtävät

Tehtävä keskittyy rikastamon huoltoseisokkien kokonaisvaltaiseen hallintaan suunnittelusta raportointiin saakka.

- Varaosahankintojen koordinointi seisokkeja varten
- Urakoitsijoiden kilpailutus ja valinta
- Seisokkien aikainen tilanneseuranta ja valvonta kentällä
- Raportointi suoritetuista huoltotoimenpiteistä ja niiden onnistumisesta
- Tiivis yhteistyö rikastamon tuotannon ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
- Kunnossapidon prosessien ja työturvallisuuden jatkuva kehittäminen

Etsimme

- Korkeakoulututkinto soveltuvalta tekniseltä alalta, kuten kone- tai prosessitekniikasta
- Vahva osaaminen teollisuuden kunnossapidon työnsuunnittelusta
- Systemaattinen työote ja kyky hallita suuria kokonaisuuksia
- Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito
- Hyvät yhteistyötaidot ja rohkeus toimia aktiivisesti eri sidosryhmien kanssa

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on
- Kokemus laajojen huoltoseisokkien projektinhallinnasta
- Aiempi kokemus raskaan teollisuuden tai kaivosalan tehtävistä

- Rohkea
- Aktiivinen
- Hyvä ihmisten kanssa
