jobs.title: ein wissenschaftlicher Referent / eine wissenschaftliche Referentin (m/w/d) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Bauforscher*in

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der internationalen Forschung

Das Deutsche Archäologische Institut (DAI) ist eine weltweit führende Forschungseinrichtung im Bereich der Archäologie und Altertumswissenschaften. Es ist dem Auswärtigen Amt, einer obersten Bundesbehörde, nachgeordnet und leistet an seinen insgesamt 20 Standorten europa- und weltweit einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Schutz und Erhalt sowie zur Vermittlung von kulturellem Erbe. Sie finden uns im Internet unter http://www.dainst.org (http://www.dainst.org) .

An der Abteilung Madrid des Deutschen Archäologischen Instituts (DAI) ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt die Stelle

eines wissenschaftlichen Referenten / einer wissenschaftlichen Referentin (m/w/d)

(Kennziffer: 08/2026)

in Vollzeit im Rahmen eines unbefristeten Beschäftigungs- bzw. Dienstverhältnisses. Eine Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Gehen entsprechende Bewerbungen ein, wird für den Arbeitsplatz geprüft, ob den Teilzeitwünschen im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten (insbesondere hinsichtlich der Anforderungen des Arbeitsplatzes und der gewünschten Gestaltung der Teilzeit) entsprochen werden kann.

Für Tarifbeschäftigte richtet sich das Entgelt beim Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen bis Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD Bund. Bei Vorliegen der laufbahn- und haushaltsrechtlichen Voraussetzungen besteht die Möglichkeit der Ernennung in das Beamtenverhältnis. Für Beamt*innen erfolgt die Besoldung bis Besoldungsgruppe A 13 BBesO. Bei Tarifbeschäftigten des Bundes sowie Beamtinnen und Beamten ist zunächst eine Abordnung mit dem Ziel der Versetzung zum DAI vorgesehen. Der Dienstort ist Madrid.

Das Arbeitsgebiet der Abteilung Madrid umfasst Spanien, Portugal und Marokko. Dieser geografische Raum bildet mit der Meerenge von Gibraltar eine zentrale Brücke zwischen Europa und Afrika sowie zwischen der Mittelmeerwelt und der Atlantikküste. Die Abteilung widmet sich der Erforschung von rund 7.000 Jahren Archäologie in diesen Kulturzonen, vom Neolithikum bis zum Beginn der Neuzeit. Seit ihrem Bestehen hat die Abteilung Madrid leistungsfähige Forschungsinfrastrukturen aufgebaut. Dazu zählen eine der größten archäologischen Fachbibliotheken der Iberischen Halbinsel mit mehr als 90.000 Bänden, umfangreiche Archiv- und Fototheksbestände sowie eine Forschungsstelle in Lissabon.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Der Aufgabenbereich umfasst insbesondere:

- Entwicklung eigener Forschungsfragen im westlichen Mittelmeerraum (mit Fokus auf Austausch- und Entwicklungsprozesse zwischen Nordafrika und der Iberischen Halbinsel).
- Konzeption und Leitung eines eigenen Forschungsprojektes in Nordafrika (in Marokko und/oder Algerien).
- Leitung und Koordination des Forschungsdatenmanagements und des Archivs/Fotothek der Abteilung
- Capacity building und Netzwerkarbeit, z. B. Durchführung von Schulungen und/oder Summerschools und Mitwirkung in der Verbundforschung des DAI, (z. B. TANA-Netzwerk, TANMed).
- Eigenverantwortliche Budgetplanung und Mittelabrechnung für die betreuten Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche.
- Fachliche Leitung unterstellter Mitarbeiter sowie Anleitung von Hilfskräften und Praktikanten.
- Einwerbung von Drittmitteln.

Ihr Profil

Vorausgesetzt werden:

- Ein mit hervorragender Promotion abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium auf dem Gebiet der Archäologie (Ur- und Frühgeschichte/Vor- und Frühgeschichte, Klassischen Archäologie, Archäologie der römischen Provinzen, Spätantike und frühes Christentum/Christliche Archäologie) oder Bauforschung.
- Deutsch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau C2).
- Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Forschungs- und/oder Feldforschungsprojekten in Nordafrika.
- Erfahrung im Bereich Forschungsdatenmanagement und/oder in der Arbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Archiven/Fototheken.
- Vorlage eines überzeugenden Konzeptes zu den wissenschaftlichen Perspektiven und Capacity building für die ersten drei Jahre der Anstellung.

Wir freuen uns über:

- Kenntnisse einer für den Forschungsraum relevanten Sprachen bzw. Bereitschaft zum Erlernen dieser Sprachen.
- Bereitschaft zur Koordinierung von Arbeitsgruppen, Kolloquien und Mitarbeit in internationalen Kooperationen.
- Bereitschaft zum aktiven Auslandsdienst, d. h. internationale Kontaktpflege in Spanien und Nordafrika, enge Zusammenarbeit mit den deutschen Auslandsvertretungen in den Gastländern, Teilnahme an institutseigenen Kolloquien, Tagungen usw.

Als Mitarbeiterin oder Mitarbeiter des DAI bringen Sie eine hohe Sensibilität für Gleichstellung und Antidiskriminierung mit. Sie verfügen über interkulturelle Kompetenz und sind in der Lage, mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft respektvoll und offen zu kommunizieren und zu kooperieren.

Ihre Vorteile:

Abwechslungsreiche und kulturnahe und Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten in einer national wie international angesehenen Forschungseinrichtung des Bundes, die die weltweite Forschung und Nachwuchsförderung, den Schutz von kulturellem Erbe sowie die kulturelle Verständigung und Zusammenarbeit zum Ziel hat.

Arbeitsplatzsicherheit

Auch in Krisenzeiten bieten wir Ihnen ein sicheres Beschäftigungsverhältnis im öffentlichen Dienst.

Flexibles und familienfreundliches Umfeld

Wir fördern eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Pflege durch:

• flexible Arbeitszeiten (Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6:00 bis 22:00 Uhr)

• Gleitzeit mit Stundenausgleich (z. B. durch Gleittage)

• Möglichkeiten zur Teilzeit und mobilen Arbeit

• kostenfreien Familienservice mit Beratungs- und Vermittlungsangeboten.

Motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld

Unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von gegenseitigem Respekt, Vertrauen, flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Eigeninitiative, Mitgestaltung und kreative Ideen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Entwicklungs- und Karriereperspektiven

Wir bieten Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Fort- und Weiterbildungen sowie individuelle Maßnahmen zur Personalentwicklung.

Urlaubsregelung

Sie erhalten 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub (bei einer Teilzeitbeschäftigung wird der Urlaubsanspruch entsprechend der tariflichen/gesetzlichen Vorgaben gewährt). Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit von Sonder- und Bildungsurlaub.

Mobilitätszuschuss

Sie erhalten bei einem Dienstort in Deutschland von uns einen Zuschuss zu einem ÖPNV-Ticket (DeutschlandJobTicket o.a.).

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Sozialwerk des Auswärtigen Amtes an und ermöglichen so den Zugang zu vergünstigten Freizeit- und Erholungsangeboten. Zusätzlich profitieren Sie von der Kooperation mit Wellhub und erhalten über diese Wellness-Plattform Zugang zu zahlreichen Fitness-Studios, Online-Kursen zu Themen wie z. B. Meditation oder Ernährung und weiteren Angeboten.

Interessenvertretungen

Ihre Interessen werden bei uns von den Personalräten, der Schwerbehindertenvertretung und der Gleichstellungsbeauftragten vertreten.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Senden Sie Ihre Unterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Ausbildungsnachweis, Arbeitszeugnisse etc.) bis zum

26.08.2026

in einer zusammengefassten PDF-Datei unter Angabe der Kennziffer 08/2026 an bewerbung@dainst.de. (https://mailto:bewerbung@dainst.de) Bitte fügen Sie Ihren Bewerbungsunterlagen weiterhin den auf der Homepage des DAI unter https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai (https://www.dainst.org/karriere/bewerben-am-dai) (Formularcenter) eingestellten Bewerbungsbogen „Wissenschaft“ ausgefüllt sowie, sofern Sie bereits im öffentlichen Dienst tätig sind, eine Einverständniserklärung zur Einsicht in Ihre Personalakte bei.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir nur vollständige Bewerbungen berücksichtigen können.

Haben Sie noch Fragen zu unserem Stellenangebot?

Dann kontaktieren Sie uns für weitere Auskünfte. Schreiben Sie eine E-Mail an bewerbung@dainst.de oder rufen Sie Herrn Sternbeck unter 030/187711-295 an. Für fachliche Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Paul Scheding, Leitender Direktor der Abteilung Madrid, E-Mail: paul.scheding@dainst.de.

Weitere Hinweise:

Bewerber*innen (m/w/d) mit Schwerbehinderung oder diesen gleichgestellte Personen werden bei gleicher Eignung entsprechend den gesetzlichen Grundlagen bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Das DAI gewährleistet gemäß BGleiG die berufliche Gleichstellung unabhängig vom Geschlecht und unterstützt die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie, indem flexible Arbeitszeiten gelebt und Teilzeitmodelle im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten realisiert werden.

Vielfalt ist einer unserer zentralen Organisationswerte. Deshalb begrüßen wir Bewerbungen unabhängig von Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Im Zusammenhang mit Ihrer Bewerbung behandeln wir Ihre personenbezogenen Daten mit größter Sorgfalt und Diskretion. Unsere Datenschutzinformation finden Sie auf unserer Webseite unter www.dainst.org/datenschutz (http://www.dainst.org/datenschutz) . Diese informiert Sie gemäß Art. 13 DSGVO über den Umfang und die Art und Weise der Verarbeitung sowie über Ihre diesbezüglichen Rechte.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Zwingend erforderlich: Forschung, Archäologie, Ausgrabungen, Quellenmaterial auswerten (Geschichte)

jobs.title: Vice President Turbo Charging Research & Development (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, strategic and innovative Vice President R&D to lead and manage the research and development of new turbocharging products, components, and technologies within our organization.

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire R&D process, including product performance testing, validation, and ensuring product safety and reliability. You will lead a team of ca 120 R&D employees and manage a budget of over 50 MUSD. You will collaborate closely with the division presidents and other senior leaders to ensure that all product releases meet the highest standards before launch. You and your experts will also support the process of technology scouting beyond turbocharging. Located in Baden, you will report to the CEO and be part of the extended management team.  

Your Responsibilities:

1. R&D Strategy and Leadership:

Lead and manage the turbocharging R&D department to drive the development of new products, components, technologies and engineering methodologies aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
Define and execute the TC R&D strategy ensuring it supports the company's vision and objectives.
Foster an innovative environment that encourages creative solutions, research breakthroughs, and efficient development processes.
Secure that the R&D budget is spent efficiently on related projects and initiatives.
Represent the company in industry organizations and initiatives, (eg. CIMAC Greenhouse Gas Strategy Group, Swissmem industry sector for the internal combustion engine industry), and support the Swiss IMO delegation.
2. Product Development and Innovation:

Oversee the development of new products from concept through to prototype, ensuring that each product meets performance, safety, and reliability standards.
Manage the research and design process to ensure efficient, cost-effective product development that reflects the customer needs and is in line with Accelleron Product Market Strategy.

3. Product Performance Testing and Validation:

Ensure that robust testing and validation processes are in place to assess product performance and reliability with adherence to safety and quality standards.
Maintain and continuously develop testing and computing infrastructure.
Focus on improving product performance, reliability and safety.
Identify potential risks and implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Collaboration with Management:

Work closely with the Division Presidents and senior management to ensure alignment on product development goals and timelines.
Jointly approve and sign-off on all product releases with the Division Presidents to ensure that all products meet the required standards before market launch.
Enhance the opportunities that AI provides in collaboration with AI organization.
Collaborate with Vice President Strategy and Investor Relations on scouting of new technologies.

5. Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities for process improvements within the R&D department and across the organization to optimize efficiency and productivity.
Stay current on industry trends, research methodologies, AI and emerging technologies to maintain competitive advantage and drive innovation.
Build and maintain networks with diverse stakeholders such as universities, research institutions and associations to gain broad perspective of development and to represent the company.

6. Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage the R&D team, ensuring that each member is supported in their professional development and empowered to contribute to the team’s success.
Secure that competences needed now and in the future are acquired and developed.
Foster a collaborative, high-performance and effective safety culture within the department.

​Your Qualifications:

In depth and proven knowledge of turbocharging technologies and research methodologies including an advanced degree in mechanical engineering.
Robust experience of leading R&D operations and engineering globally across a complex technology portfolio.
Strong track record of creating and leading technology strategies, investment prioritization and innovation portfolios, preferably on enterprise level and closely aligned with business strategy.
Experience of repeatedly leading technology development from concept through validation to market introduction, especially leading turbocharger programs successfully converting innovation into commercial outcomes.
Deep understanding of product performance testing, validation, safety, and reliability assessments as well as regulatory compliance.
Exceptional stakeholder and influencing skills based on having regularly interfaced with executive leadership, government agencies, universities, industry consortia and regulatory bodies while advising on technology and policy topics.
Excellent leadership skills with collaborative and people-focused leadership style proven in successfully leading sizable global teams.
Future technology and innovation orientation combined with strong business and investment acumen.
Curiosity, learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset.

Your benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program
Global parental leave program
Flexible working models
We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

jobs.title: Har du erfaring med autisme, angst og PTSD – og motiveres du af at skabe udvikling gennem en stabil, tillidsfuld og fagligt funderet relation?
jobs.description:
Vi søger medarbejdere til en længerevarende § 85-indsats omkring en ung mand i Aarhus. 
Målet er at etablere et lille, fast team, som kan skabe kontinuitet, genkendelighed og tryghed omkring borgeren.

Om indsatsen

Borgeren har autisme, angst og svær PTSD og har behov for struktureret og forudsigelig støtte i hverdagen.

Han kan opleve svære angstanfald, som i perioder påvirker hans evne til at handle og gennemføre almindelige hverdagsaktiviteter. En central del af opgaven er derfor at kunne bevare roen, skabe tryghed og støtte ham i at udvikle og anvende mestringsstrategier, når angsten fylder.

Samtidig er han selv motiveret for udvikling og progression. Der er derfor gode muligheder for at arbejde målrettet med små, men betydningsfulde skridt mod større mestring og selvstændighed.

Hvad skal du arbejde med?

Den socialpædagogiske støtte har blandt andet fokus på:

  • mestringsstrategier i forbindelse med angst og angstanfald
  • støtte til at finde ro og genvinde handlekraft i belastende situationer
  • struktur og opretholdelse af en stabil døgnrytme
  • støtte til hensigtsmæssige rutiner omkring søvn
  • social færdighedstræning
  • gradvis træning i at færdes uden for hjemmet, eksempelvis gennem gåture
  • støtte til aktiviteter uden for hjemmet og øget selvstændighed i hverdagen.

Opgaven kræver, at du kan arbejde roligt, tålmodigt og relationsorienteret. Du skal kunne møde borgeren dér, hvor han er, uden at forcere processen – samtidig med at du har blik for hans ressourcer, motivation og muligheder for progression.

 

Du bliver en del af et fast team

Kontinuitet er en vigtig del af indsatsen. Derfor søger vi medarbejdere, som ønsker at blive en del af et lille og fast team omkring borgeren.

Teamet skal så vidt muligt være selvdækkende og sammen skabe den stabilitet og genkendelighed, som borgeren har behov for.

I teamet deler I faglige perspektiver, metoder, observationer og erfaringer, så der skabes en fælles og sammenhængende tilgang til indsatsen. Der afholdes desuden løbende teammøder med mulighed for faglig sparring og koordinering.

 

Arbejdstider

Indsatsen leveres på faste tidspunkter:

Mandag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Tirsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Onsdag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Torsdag: kl. 8.00-12.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Fredag: kl. 8.00-11.00 og kl. 21.00-23.00

Søndag: kl. 21.00-23.00

 

Fra 1. september øges dagvagterne til fire timer og placeres kl. 8.00-12.00 eller kl. 9.00-13.00.

Vagttidspunkterne ligger fast og kan ikke flyttes.

Du behøver ikke kunne dække alle vagterne. Vi hører også gerne fra dig, hvis du kan varetage én eller flere faste vagter og dermed indgå stabilt i teamet.

 

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, som har de faglige og personlige kompetencer til at arbejde med en borger med autisme, angst og svær PTSD.

Det er en klar fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af områderne og eksempelvis har en social-, pædagogisk- eller sundhedsfaglig baggrund.

Vi lægger særligt vægt på, at du:

  • kan skabe ro, tryghed og forudsigelighed
  • kan bevare ro og overblik, når angsten fylder
  • arbejder respektfuldt og relationsorienteret
  • forstår betydningen af struktur og kontinuitet
  • kan arbejde udviklingsorienteret med respekt for borgerens tempo
  • er stabil og kan forpligte dig på faste vagter
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig sparring og et tæt teamsamarbejde.

Af hensyn til borgerens konkrete behov kan indsatsen udelukkende varetages af kvindelige medarbejdere.

Der er aktuelt ingen fastsat slutdato på indsatsen, og vi søger derfor medarbejdere, som har mulighed for at skabe kontinuitet over tid.

 

Kan du se dig selv i opgaven?

Hvis du har erfaring med autisme, angst og/eller PTSD og trives i et tæt relationsarbejde, hvor udvikling sker gennem tryghed, struktur og vedholdenhed, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Ved interesse får du naturligvis yderligere information om borgeren, støttebehovet og de faglige rammer som en del af den videre rekrutteringsproces.

 

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Teammøder, supervision og konflikthåndteringskurser
  • Faglig udvikling og sparring med kolleger
  • Attraktiv løn iflg. overenskomst

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV samt dine uddannelsesbeviser ved at klikke "Søg Stillingen" længere nede på siden.

Technically grounded
Possess strong leadership and people management skills
Structured and organized

-Innovation & Continuous Improvement: Support the ongoing development of DESMI's automation portfolio by promoting a solution-oriented mindset and identifying opportunities for innovation and standardization.

You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and are motivated by creating structure, driving progress, and delivering high-quality results together with your team.

Have experience working in a dynamic environment where priorities can shift, and where adaptability is key to success

Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development.
A chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact.

Sustainability is highly appreciated while developing high-performance and long-lasting technologies that help industries adapt to evolving markets while reducing environmental impact.

Ready to apply?

jobs.title: Store Manager - dubbu
jobs.description:
About the job

dubbu is expanding in Copenhagen, and we are looking for a Store Manager (37 hours/week) to lead our upcoming store — a new version of a familiar location, now including a small serving area inspired by Korean café culture.

As Store Manager, you will be responsible for the daily operations, the team, and ensuring that both the retail space and the serving area run smoothly every day.

You will work closely with the founder team and have significant influence on how the store develops in the coming years.

Your responsibilities

Leadership & team

  • Daily leadership of the team (scheduling, onboarding, training, and feedback)

  • Ensuring a high standard of customer service and sales

  • Coaching the team to improve performance on the sales floor

Store operations

  • Overseeing daily operations (opening/closing, stock deliveries, inventory, routines)

  • Ensuring the store always appears well-organized and ready for customers

  • Working with simple KPIs (sales, conversion rate, AOV)

Serving area

  • Responsible for the operation of the store’s small café area

  • Ensuring consistent quality and service speed

  • Daily cleaning, hygiene, and maintenance of equipment

  • Training staff in workflow and standards

  • Contributing to the development of new drinks inspired by Korean café culture

We are looking for someone who

  • Has 2–3 years of experience in retail or café environments, preferably with operational responsibility

  • Is structured and comfortable working with routines, checklists, and clear standards

  • Can lead a team and maintain calm and overview in a busy environment

  • Is hands-on and takes ownership of both people and operations

  • Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of a well-executed customer experience

It is a plus if you

  • Have experience with barista work, matcha, or espresso

  • Have worked with food hygiene or basic food safety procedures

  • Have experience with merchandising or retail visuals

  • Have an interest in Korean culture, cafés, or beauty

What we offer

  • A central role in a growing company

  • Close collaboration with the founder team

  • Significant influence on the store’s development

  • A strong team and an ambitious brand universe

  • Staff discount across our entire product range

Application

Start date: as soon as possible

Please send your CV and a short application to:

job@dubbu.dk

jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is the fastest way to turn ideas into software. With our powerful AI-powered Agent and Assistant, anyone can create and launch apps from natural language in just one click. Build and deploy full-stack applications directly from your browser—no setup required. Never written a line of code in your life? No problem. Replit makes software creation accessible, collaborative, and lightning-fast. Join us in our mission to empower the next generation of builders.

We are seeking a Strategic Finance professional to join Replit's growing team in Foster City, CA. In this critical role, you'll work in a lean team supporting high-impact strategic and operational initiatives across the business to drive data-driven decision making. You’ll partner directly with executive leadership and the Board to align financial strategies with our ambitious growth objectives. This role reports to the Head of Finance.




ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

You'll contribute to critical projects across three main core areas:

Internal Strategic & Operational Initiatives

 - Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, and Engineering teams to build financial models and analyses that drive organizational decision-making

 - New product launches: Build and present financial models, business cases, and investment analyses for new product launches

 - GTM Finance: Partner with go-to-market leadership to drive growth through sales capacity planning, funnel and pipeline analytics, pricing strategy and resource allocation

 - Pricing & Packaging: Analyze pricing and packaging strategies using quantitative and qualitative frameworks to recommend optimal approaches

 - Unit Economics: Recommend strategies that balance growth investments with operational efficiency to achieve long-term margin targets

 - International Growth: Analyze global expansion opportunities including localization, regional pricing strategies, go-to-market approaches, and commercial partnerships

 - Enterprise Sales: Partner with sales leadership to scale enterprise sales operations and strategy

Corporate Strategy & Planning

 - Long-Range Planning: Collaborate with FP&A team on forecasting, financial planning, long-range planning, growth headcount planning, and overall financial strategy

 - Board Reporting: Assist in preparing quarterly board materials and presentations

 - Market Insights: Conduct competitive analysis and industry research to inform strategic planning

Corporate Development & Investor Relations

 - Corporate Development: Support corporate development initiatives including M&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships from initial sourcing through execution and integration

 - Investor Relations & Fundraising: Support investor relations activities including fundraising, investor communications, and preparation of materials for investors



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3-6 years in investment banking, private equity, consulting, business operations, and/or strategic finance

 - Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis tools

 - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

 - Self-directed with a strong work ethic and ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines

 - Expert-level financial modeling skills and proficiency with business intelligence tools

 - Strong presence and communication skills

 - Exceptional business judgment with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable strategic insights

Join Replit and help shape the financial future of a platform that's revolutionizing how people learn, build, and deploy software with AI.




BONUS POINTS: 

 - Experience in strategic finance or related field at a scaling technology company

 - Current Replit user

 - Background in AI or enterprise technology companies

 - Understanding of compute and infrastructure costs in tech environments


This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Hyderabad Infra team builds and maintains Notion's internal async task runner and configuration management platform. The async task runner plays a critical role in ensuring our millions of users have a fast, reliable, and secure experience. The configuration management platform enables safe, explicit configuration management for Notion's product and infrastructure engineers.



As part of the Hyderabad Infra Team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape how Notion manages and scales its async task runner and configuration management platform, enabling innovation across the company.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - You will contribute to the evolution and maintenance of our async task runner to meet the needs of over 100 million global users and support the rapid growth of our product and business. 

 - With guidance from senior team members, you'll help ensure our systems remain reliable, efficient, and scalable. You'll evaluate and integrate new technologies to keep us ahead of emerging challenges. 

 - Your work will empower our engineering team to build features confidently while you grow your skills in distributed systems and infrastructure.

 - You will develop the skills and confidence to debug live production systems with minimal disruption, whether replacing components or managing failovers. You will participate in an on-call rotation, responding to incidents to uphold service reliability and quickly restore normal operations.

 - You will partner with product engineers and other infra teams to ensure our platforms align with evolving business needs and product goals.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - A software developer with at least 4 years of experience and the ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.

 - Systems thinker: You understand distributed systems and can design solutions that account for tradeoffs like consistency, latency, and scalability.

 - Pragmatic problem-solver: You prioritize business impact and understand the balance between craft, speed, and long-term maintainability. You’re opinionated but not ideological, and you learn new technologies as you go.

 - Ownership and initiative: You thrive in a fast-moving, unstructured environment and are comfortable taking ownership of ambiguous problems. You act with a bias toward action and focus on results.

 - Customer Empathy: You excel at collaborating across teams, offering guidance and solutions to unblock engineers and support them in building reliable systems. With empathy at the core of your approach, you focus on addressing the needs of those who depend on the async task runner.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

jobs.title: Production Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Designer with strong visual taste to help scale Linear’s creative work across web, brand, and marketing. You’ll create polished, high-quality designs across a wide range of surfaces — from landing pages and ad campaigns to sales decks and launch materials — helping bring Linear’s visual language to life everywhere people experience our brand.

When it comes to design, we’re looking to work with people who can pick up any problem and solve it. For us, it’s both how it works and how it looks. At its core, Linear is a developer tool where speed, interactions, and small details matter. We expect a broad set of design skills and the ability to create high-quality designs, interactions, and prototypes.

Previous experience with international VAT reporting and knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Brand Designer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



TEAM

Brand & Creative defines how Replit shows up in the world and leads the creative work that brings it to market. On the Brand side, the function sets company-level direction: defining the brand, shaping the narrative, and establishing how Replit is understood and expressed in the market. On the Creative side, the function leads the planning, development, and execution of creative work across campaigns, launches, events, and major company initiatives; translating strategy into high-quality outputs across every touchpoint. Brand & Creative ensures that what Replit is and what Replit makes remain aligned. Resulting in a clear, consistent, and differentiated brand experience across the company.




ROLE

The Brand Designer is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining the Replit brand system. The role focuses on core brand foundations and their application across key surfaces, including product and marketing. In partnership with internal and external partners, this role ensures the brand is clear, consistent, and scalable across all touchpoints. This role reports to the Brand & Creative Lead.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and evolve the Replit visual brand system

 - Design and maintain core brand assets, guidelines, and documentation

 - Apply the brand system across key surfaces including product, web, and primary marketing channels

 - Partner with Product and Design to ensure consistent brand expression within the product experience

 - Provide guidance and feedback to internal teams and external partners on brand usage

 - Partner with external design studios and agencies to develop and extend the brand system

 - Review and direct external work to ensure alignment with brand standards

 - Ensure consistency and quality across all brand-critical touchpoints

 - Develop scalable design frameworks that support long-term brand growth

 - Contribute hands-on design work on high-visibility and foundational projects




REQUIREMENTS

 - 5-7+ years of experience in brand design, visual systems, or identity design

 - Strong portfolio demonstrating brand systems, identity work, and application across multiple touchpoints

 - Expertise in typography, layout, and visual systems

 - Experience building and maintaining design systems at scale

 - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite

 - Ability to balance conceptual thinking with executional rigor

 - Experience working with external agencies or design partners

 - Strong attention to detail and consistency

 - Experience collaborating with Product and cross-functional teams



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.

jobs.title: Part-time Veterinary Nurse
jobs.description:
Veterinary Nurse (Part-Time) - MyPeterinarian, Copenhagen

Are you an Authorised Veterinary Nurse with strong anaesthesia and surgical nursing experience?

MyPeterinarian is looking for an experienced Veterinary Nurse to join our Copenhagen team in a part-time role with a strong focus on anaesthesia, surgical nursing and high-quality patient care.

Founded in 2017, MyPeterinarian is an established independent veterinary clinic, grooming salon and pet-sitting company. We are a close-knit team focused on excellent patient care, strong client relationships and creating a positive working environment.

About the Role

The core responsibility of this role is independently managing anaesthesia monitoring - from patient preparation and induction through to recovery. You will play an important role in ensuring safe, calm and well-managed surgical procedures while working closely with the veterinary team.

This role is ideal for a nurse who enjoys surgical nursing, values careful patient monitoring and is confident taking responsibility within their area of expertise.

Please note: MyPeterinarian is planning to relocate to a new Copenhagen location between now and the end of September 2026 -the exact address will be shared during the interview process 

Schedule

Approximately 21 hours per week

  • Tuesday and Wednesday: 09:00-15:00

  • Monday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00-13:00

  • Exact schedule to be agreed with the successful candidate

This is a weekday-only position, with no evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard, supporting a healthy work-life balance.

Expected start date: 15 September 2026

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently monitoring anaesthesia, including induction and recovery

  • Preparing patients for surgery and providing surgical assistance

  • Supporting blood sample collection and other clinical procedures

  • Providing routine patient care, including nail clipping

  • Handling and supporting patients throughout their visit

  • Maintaining clinical hygiene standards and sterilising equipment

  • Supporting reception and administrative tasks when required

  • Assisting with stock checks and inventory management

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an Authorised Veterinary Nurse

  • Has proven experience of independently monitoring anaesthesia

  • Is comfortable working independently during surgical procedures

  • Has excellent patient handling skills and a calm, professional approach

  • Has a good standard of spoken and written English (Danish is an advantage but not essential)

  • Enjoys being part of a small, collaborative team

What We Offer

  • A friendly and professional team environment

  • A varied clinical role with genuine responsibility

  • No evenings, weekends or night shifts scheduled as standard 

  • Salary: 200dkk/hr

  • Regular team gatherings and a supportive workplace culture

  • Opportunity to increase working hours over time, by mutual agreement

  • Staff discounts on MyPeterinarian veterinary, grooming and pet-sitting services for your own pets

Application Process

Application deadline: 15 August 2026

To apply, please send your CV to: jobs@mypeterinarian.com

Please note that applicants must already have the right to work in Denmark. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

If you have any questions, please contact us at: hej@mypeterinarian.com

By submitting your application, you consent to MyPeterinarian processing your personal data for the purpose of recruitment. Your information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection legislation.

jobs.title: CHEFE DE COZINHA
jobs.description:
Pretende se recrutar um a Chef de Cozinha para integrar um novo projeto de restauração privilegiando candidatos com forte motivação sentido de responsabilidade e vontade de crescer profissionalmente.

Será responsável pela preparação confeção e empratamento dos produtos garantindo elevados padrões de qualidade apresentação e consistência. Deverá colaborar na organização da cozinha gestão de stocks receção e armazenamento de mercadorias controlo de desperdícios e cumprimento rigoroso das normas de higiene e segurança alimentar HACCP.

Procura se um profissional organizado dinâmico com capacidade para trabalhar em equipa gerir o tempo de forma eficiente e manter um bom desempenho em períodos de maior exigência. Valoriza se uma atitude proativa atenção ao detalhe capacidade de aprendizagem e compromisso com a melhoria contínua.

É valorizada formação na área da cozinha e restauração e ou experiência profissional em funções semelhantes. No entanto serão igualmente considerados candidatos com potencial de desenvolvimento desde que demonstrem interesse pela profissão vontade de aprender e capacidade de integração numa equipa orientada para a qualidade e excelência no serviço.

O profissional terá a oportunidade de participar no desenvolvimento e crescimento de um novo conceito de restauração beneficiando de acompanhamento contínuo formação em contexto de trabalho e possibilidade de integração futura na empresa de acordo com o desempenho demonstrado.

jobs.title: Manager, Solutions Consultants, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.



This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.



This role will be based in Munich, Germany. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Fluency in English and German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €260,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energized by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.



This role is based in Dublin, Ireland. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritize based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

 - Fluency in Swedish or Norwegian

jobs.title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us.

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)
  • Collaborate with our diverse international team to push us on the leading edge of our fields
  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects
  • Discover how to be an expert in SaaS for recognition programs
  • Master our sales technology stack
  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close
  • Skillfully navigate consultative sales discussions and live demos

Essentials

 

  • Applications are open to all experience levels, with a minimum of 1 year proven success in SaaS sales or a similar role
  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement
  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions
  • Meet and exceed measurable performance goals to succeed and progress in this role

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 38 hour work week, Monday to Friday (your weekends are yours)
  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)
  • Your birthday is a holiday every year

Personal development and wellbeing

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

jobs.title: Solutions Consultants Manager, Enterprise - Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the commercial performance of your team across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, and UBP outcomes—accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Partner with the regional BDR manager on pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, and qualification standards to ensure the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Outcomes leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy—owning the overall commercial arc for the region while collaborating on the execution that follows close

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you have a strong interest in the evolving AI landscape, stay closely attuned to industry trends and developments, and are curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - Native or bilingual level fluency Japanese and business-level English proficiency across speaking, listening, and reading, including the ability to support team members with global communication




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model—able to navigate the SC/CSA hand-offs and hold the commercial arc across the full customer lifecycle




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
